Har du hjertet på rette sted, lyst til at være sammen med børn og mod på at blive en del af et lille børnehus med masser af historie og personlighed? Så er det måske dig, vi søger!

Bag den grønne port i Helsingørs gågade ligger vores lille private børnehave med 27 børn og fem medarbejdere, herunder vores leder. Vi holder til i et skævt bindingsværkshus med mere end 190 års historie, en hyggelig legeplads, bålfad og vildtvoksende gemmesteder. Her er der plads til leg, fantasi, nærvær og fællesskab – og vi elsker at være ude i al slags vejr.

Vi søger en engageret og omsorgsfuld timelønnet medarbejder, der har lyst til at blive en fast del af vores hverdag. Vi ser gerne, at du har erfaring med børn og lyst til at arbejde pædagogisk.

Vi leder efter dig, der:

·        er nærværende, omsorgsfuld og god til at skabe relationer til børn

·        møder børn med respekt, nysgerrighed og blik for deres perspektiver

·        kan tage initiativ og indgå i husets rammer og rutiner

·        er mødestabil, fleksibel og ansvarsbevidst

·        kan træde til med kort varsel og tage både åbne- og lukkevagter

Hos os får du

·        27 skønne børn og en hverdag fyldt med leg og oplevelser

·        engagerede kollegaer, der vægter samarbejde og faglighed

·        mulighed for at få erfaring med pædagogisk arbejde

·        mulighed for at blive en tryg og genkendelig voksen i børnenes hverdag

Praktisk information

Vi søger en timelønnet medarbejder. Vi forventer, at du er fleksibel og har mulighed for at træde til med kort varsel ved sygdom og andre akut opståede situationer. Ved i forvejen planlagt fravær blandt personalet, vil arbejdstiderne være fastlagt på forhånd, så du i god tid ved hvornår du skal arbejde.

title: PhD in In-Operando Diagnostics of Li-ion and Post-Li-ion Batteries Using Acoustic Technology
description:
At AAU Energy, a PhD stipend position is available within the general study program. The stipend is open for appointment from 15 November 2026 or soon hereafter. The duration of the position is three years.

Your work tasksBattery performance assessment and diagnostics rely today on standardised electrical measurements complemented by post-mortem analysis. None of these methods is suited for in-operando diagnostics, as they are either destructive or require the battery to be taken out of its daily operation. Acoustic techniques, based either on passive listening to acoustic emissions or on active ultrasound signal injection, have recently been proposed as an alternative; however, further research is needed to establish the relationship between materials degradation and the sensed acoustic signals. The aim of this PhD project is to establish a mechanistic understanding of the coupling between battery ageing mechanisms and measured acoustic signals, and to translate this understanding into a diagnostic method applicable to both Li-ion and post-Li-ion chemistries.

You will start by reviewing the state of the art in acoustic-based battery diagnostics, and you will then design and build a set-up for sensing acoustic emissions in coin cells. Using this set-up, you will carry out degradation tests over a wide range of operating conditions with simultaneous acoustic and electrical measurements, and you will analyse how the acoustic signatures relate to the electrical ones and to the underlying degradation mechanisms. On this basis, you will develop an acoustic-based, physics-validated model for battery diagnostics; the resulting algorithm is targeted to be at least 25% more accurate than conventional impedance-based estimation and at least 50% less energy demanding than traditional diagnostic approaches. While most of the experimental work will be carried out at coin-cell level, a proof of concept at single-layer pouch-cell level is expected, which will facilitate further demonstration towards innovation.

The work will be supported by critical analysis of the results, benchmarking against the state of the art, and high-quality publications and conference presentations. In addition to the research activities, you will contribute to teaching and to the supervision of student projects, as well as to broader dissemination activities within the department.

The position is offered in relation to the research group Batteries, and the PhD Student will be positioned to the section for Power Electronics Systems Integration and Materials.

Your competencies We are looking for a motivated PhD candidate who is eager to work at the intersection of battery testing, sensing instrumentation and signal processing, and who enjoys combining fundamental understanding with hands-on experimental work. The ideal candidate is curious and persistent in the laboratory, excels at troubleshooting, can plan and execute experiments independently, and motivated to collaborate closely with colleagues in an international and interdisciplinary environment.

Applicants must hold an M.Sc. degree in electrical engineering, energy engineering or mechatronics. Experience with one or more of the following will be considered an advantage: electrical characterisation of batteries, acoustic or ultrasonic sensing and laboratory instrumentation, and signal processing and data-driven modelling (e.g., in MATLAB or Python). Experience with Problem Based Learning (PBL) is required, as the PhD student will be involved in the supervision of BSc and MSc student projects. Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken, are required, as the project will be carried out in an international research environment. Danish language skills are highly desirable and will support co-supervision of BSc student projects; however, they are not a formal requirement.

Qualification requirementsPhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 1124 of September 19, 2025 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we are    AAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners, utilities and other academic environments to address real world energy challenges.

Aalborg University has been ranked as the best university in Europe within energy research and is among the very best universities worldwide in this field. At AAU Energy you will be part of a top international environment where research, innovation and collaboration are used to develop solutions to global challenges such as the green transition and future energy systems.

The department is located in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg campus. AAU Energy employs around 250 staff members at different career stages and with diverse national and disciplinary backgrounds, which creates an international and interdisciplinary research environment with many opportunities for collaboration and knowledge sharing. English is widely used as working language in both research and teaching, which supports the integration of international colleagues.

We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday work.

New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters. Aalborg University offers general onboarding support to all new employees, as well as dedicated support for international staff through its International Staff Unit (ISU). You can read more about relocation support and services here: https://www.en.hr.aau.dk/relocation-support

Aalborg University also offers Danish language courses to support international employees in settling into both the workplace and Danish society. International employees typically can attend Danish language courses during their first years in Denmark (depending on individual eligibility and national schemes).

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk.

How to applyYour application must include the following:

  • Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
  • Other relevant documents

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Do you have any questions?     If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information  Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

Salary and terms of employmentThe employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement). 

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “PhD Fellow”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the worldAalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

title: Cruise Consultant til MyCruise
description:
Brænder du for salg, rejser og gode kundeoplevelser?

Vil du rådgive kunder om nogle af verdens mest spændende rejser og samtidig være en del af en virksomhed i vækst?

Hos MyCruise søger vi en Cruise Consultant til vores salgsteam på hovedkontoret i Vanløse.

Som Cruise Consultant får du ansvaret for at rådgive vores kunder og sammensætte den helt rigtige krydstogtrejse. Det handler ikke bare om at finde en kahyt og en afrejsedato, men også om alt det uden om, som fly, hotel, udflugter og meget mere. Du skal forstå kundens ønsker, inspirere, rådgive og skabe en rejse, der passer til den enkelte kunde.

Du bliver en del af et ambitiøst salgsteam, hvor vi arbejder professionelt med salg, konvertering og kundeoplevelse, men hvor der samtidig er plads til personlighed, godt humør og forskellige måder at være en dygtig sælger på.

Om jobbet

Dine kunder kontakter os, fordi de allerede drømmer om at komme ud at rejse. Din opgave er at omsætte drømmen til den rigtige rejse.

Du kommer blandt andet til at:

• Rådgive kunder om krydstogter, destinationer, rederier og rejsemuligheder

• Sælge og sammensætte individuelle krydstogtsrejser

• Afdække kundens behov og finde den løsning, der passer bedst

• Følge op på tilbud og kundehenvendelser

• Arbejde aktivt med mersalg og muligheder for at gøre kundens samlede rejse endnu bedre

• Opbygge relationer til både nye og eksisterende kunder

• Arbejde med nogle af verdens største og mest spændende krydstogtsrederier

• Holde dig opdateret på produkter, destinationer og nye muligheder i markedet

Du får naturligvis en grundig introduktion til vores produkter, systemer og rederier.

Hvem er du?

Det vigtigste for os er, at du kan lide at sælge og motiveres af at skabe gode resultater sammen med kunden.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

• Har erfaring med salg, rådgivning eller kundekontakt

• Er god til at lytte og hurtigt kan forstå kundens ønsker og behov

• Har et naturligt kommercielt mindset og trives med mål og resultater

• Er serviceminded og forstår, at den gode kundeoplevelse og det gode salg går hånd i hånd

• Har energi, drive og lyst til at tage ansvar for dine egne kunder

• Trives i en hverdag med tempo og mange forskellige kundehenvendelser

• Er struktureret og følger dine tilbud og kunder helt til dørs

• Er fortrolig med IT og har nemt ved at lære nye systemer

Har du erfaring fra rejsebranchen eller kendskab til krydstogter, er det naturligvis en fordel, men det er ikke et krav. Resten kan vi lære dig.

Hvem er MyCruise?

MyCruise er et af Skandinaviens førende specialiserede krydstogtsrejsebureauer. Vi samarbejder med en lang række af verdens største krydstogtsrederier og hjælper hvert år vores kunder med at finde den helt rigtige rejse.

Vi sælger både klassiske ocean cruises, Exclusive cruises samt River cruises.

Vi har kontorer i Danmark, Norge, Sverige og Storbritannien, mens vores danske hovedkontor ligger i Vanløse. Her arbejder salg tæt sammen med blandt andet Concierge &  Product Marketing

Vi er i vækst og har store ambitioner for de kommende år. Derfor leder vi også efter mennesker, der har lyst til at udvikle sig sammen med os.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

• En spændende salgsrolle i en branche, hvor produktet virkelig kan begejstre

• Grundig oplæring i krydstogter, rederier, destinationer og vores systemer

• Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling

• Studieture og mulighed for selv at opleve nogle af de produkter, vi sælger

• Personalepriser på rejser

• Pension og sundhedsordning

• Frokostordning, frugt, kaffe og sodavand

• Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med dygtige og engagerede kolleger

• En organisation med korte beslutningsveje og mulighed for selv at gøre en forskel

• Arbejdsplads på vores hovedkontor i Vanløse tæt på metro og S tog

Lyder det som dig?

Send dit CV og din ansøgning til job@mycruise.dk.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Stillingen er på fuld tid og med arbejdssted på vores hovedkontor i Vanløse.

title: Production Worker - Nakskov (Day/night)
description:
Would you like to help ensure a more sustainable future? Vestas is currently looking for unskilled workers with experience in production work. We are looking for someone who wants to help ensure quality and prioritize safety and well-being in the workplace. Being hired as a production worker at Vestas is not just about experience, it's about motivation, curiosity, and interest in learning new things. Through thorough training and instruction, we will provide you with all the tools to become skilled at making wind turbines.The Nakskov factory produces blades for our offshore wind turbines; the factory is an epoxy workplace, so everyone must complete an epoxy course or have a certificate no older than 5 years.This posting is for those who thrive on working 12-hour shifts, either day or night. Responsibilities

  • Safety: At Vestas, safety is the first priority, which means you must prioritize your own and your colleagues' safety, both physically and mentally.

  • Quality: Our next priority is top-notch quality, so we expect you to take pride in producing a product that meets standards.

  • Production Plan: At Vestas, we also have some plans that need to be met to deliver on time. So, we expect an employee who is diligent and strives to meet deadlines without compromising safety or quality.

Qualifications

  • You are in good physical shape and accustomed to standing and walking throughout the workday.

  • It is advantageous if you have experience with 5S and Lean.

  • It is advantageous if you have experience with production work, but if you are willing to learn, we would like to hear from you.

Competencies

  • You are quality-conscious and focus on safety.

  • You contribute to creating a good atmosphere at work.

  • You don't mind changing tasks.

  • You have an interest in learning new things and are curious.

We OfferA workplace with a focus on employees, their safety, and providing them with the tools to create quality in their work. We offer an attractive salary package with health insurance, dental insurance, and a canteen arrangement. Additional Information

  • Workplace: Nakskov

  • Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis.

  • Reference check will occur after interviews. Please state in your application if you have a reference. 

Our commitment to a fair hiring. At Vestas, we evaluate all candidates solely based on their professional experience, education, and relevant skills. To support a fair recruitment process, we kindly ask that you remove any photos, dates of birth or graduation, gender pronouns, marital status, or other personal information not relevant to the role before submitting your CV/resume. Your CV/resume should focus on your professional and educational background, along with the necessary contact details (email and phone number). We train our hiring teams in inclusive evaluation and regularly review process outcomes to ensure fairness.DEIB Statement At Vestas, we recognize the value of diversity, equity, and inclusion in driving innovation and success. We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, particularly those who may hesitate due to their identity or feel they do not meet every criterion. As our CEO states, "Expertise and talent come in many forms, and a diverse workforce enhances our ability to think differently and solve the complex challenges of our industry". Your unique perspective is what will help us powering the solution for a sustainable, green energy future.BEWARE – RECRUITMENT FRAUDIt has come to our attention that there are a number of fraudulent emails from people pretending to work for Vestas. Read more via this link, https://www.vestas.com/en/careers/our-recruitment-process About VestasVestas is the energy industry’s global partner on sustainable energy solutions. We are specialised in designing, manufacturing, installing, and servicing wind turbines, both onshore and offshore. Across the globe, we have installed more wind power than anyone else. We consider ourselves pioneers within the industry, as we continuously aim to design new solutions and technologies to create a more sustainable future for all of us. title: Bogholder
description:

title: Rengøring 30-37 timer
description:

title: Manager søges til restaurant Abigail i Axeltowers
description:

title: Tenure track assistant professor/Associate professor positions in Veterinary medicine
employer: Technical Sciences - Institut for Husdyr- og Veter
description:
The Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences (ANIVET) is seeking three new staff members for teaching and research in veterinary medicine. The positions are available from 1 August 2027 or soon thereafter.The educational activities for these positions are aimed at students in veterinary medicine at both the bachelor’s and master’s levels.The veterinary medicine programme is organised into courses covering educationally relevant themes and integrates a range of disciplines, and this is done with the vision to create a professional engagement while ensuring scientific depth for the students of veterinary medicine.ANIVET is part of the Faculty of Technical Sciences at Aarhus University. The department is located near Viborg (Campus AU Viborg – Research Centre Foulum) and encompasses five research units with approximately 200 dedicated employees of which 50% are scientific staff. The AU Viborg campus will gradually grow to a student population of 800 – 900. The positions will be integrated into the department’s existing scientific research units, in which scientists at all career stages work together with skilled technical staff such as laboratory technicians and data analysts.The positions
  1. Clinical veterinary science – livestock
  2. Veterinary public health
  3. Veterinary pathology
If you wish to apply for more than one position, please apply for each position separately. Please read more down below in “How to apply”.1. Tenure track assistant professor or Associated Professor in Clinical veterinary science – livestockWe are seeking a candidate with a clinical background in veterinary science within production animals - Livestock.Research tasksThe focus of the position is to:
  • Perform clinical veterinary science within production animals, with emphasis on individual or group-level animal diagnostics, clinical decision-making, and evidence-based treatment and prevention strategies.
  • Research in major production diseases in cattle and/or pigs of significant importance in Europe, including development of clinically applicable knowledge and tools supporting veterinary decision-making in practice.
  • Integrate clinical findings with herd-level data to improve disease prevention and health management in modern production systems.
Within his/her area of expertise, it is expected that in addition the candidate will:
  • Conduct research-based advisory work for authorities and have an active role in externally funded research projects.
  • Contribute to the development and delivery of teaching in clinical veterinary science for production animals, with emphasis on case-based and hands-on learning.
  • Provide academic leadership within the clinical production animal field, including mentoring and coordination of junior teaching staff (e.g., assistant lecturers/teaching assistants).
  • Contribute to strengthening collaboration with the veterinary profession and industry stakeholders in Denmark.
Your profileThe preferred candidate should demonstrate:
  • The ability to independently conduct research within veterinary clinical science related to pig or cattle production
  • Danish authorization as a veterinarian or can achieve it
  • Preferably experiences within obstetrics
2. Tenure track assistant professor or Associated Professor in Veterinary Public HealthWe are seeking a candidate with strong expertise in veterinary public health, including popu-lation-level animal health, food safety/meat inspection, and the role of veterinarians in society.Research tasksThe focus of the position is to:
  • Conduct research within veterinary public health, including epidemiology, zoonoses, food safety/meat inspection, disease dynamics, risk assessment or animal welfare.
  • Contribute to interdisciplinary One Health research integrating animal, human and environmental health on population level.
  • Support evidence-based policy and advisory work for authorities.
  • Participate in externally funded research projects.
Within his/her area of expertise, it is expected that in addition the candidate will:
  • Develop and deliver teaching in Veterinary Public Health for example to apply case-based and problem-oriented teaching methods with focus on real-world scenarios in veterinary services.
  • Do research within monitoring of animal welfare issues across the EU.
  • Contribute to teaching across the veterinary curriculum where public health perspectives are relevant.
Your profileThe preferred candidate should demonstrate:
  • The ability to independently conduct research within veterinary public health preferably with an interdisciplinary research profile integrating biological, social and economic aspects in projects
  • Danish authorization as a veterinarian or can achieve it. Experience with Danish conditions is an advantage.
  • Preferably, experience with antimicrobial use at the population level.
3. Tenure track assistant professor or Associated Professor in Veterinary PathologyWe are seeking a candidate with a broad background in veterinary pathology, encompassing both gross and histopathological examinations for diagnostic purposes with a strong interest in developing and innovating teaching within veterinary pathology.Research tasksThe focus of the position is:
  • General and comparative veterinary pathology, including the mechanisms, diagnosis, and characterization of disease processes across animal species.
  • Diagnostic pathology, encompassing post-mortem investigations, histopathology, and the integration of pathological findings into veterinary practice and meat inspection.
  • Pathological assessment of animal welfare aspects of mortality in livestock
Within his/her area of expertise, it is expected that in addition the candidate will:
  • Teach and supervise students and early-career researchers at bachelor, master, and PhD levels.
  • Conduct research-based advisory work for authorities and have an active role in externally funded research projects.
  • Contribute to the collection and curation of pathological specimens for teaching purposes and reporting of findings to referring veterinarians and animal owners.
  • Contribute to the continued development of the department's digital histopathology teaching platform, TUTOR.
  • Support in the administration and further development of the department's animal donor programme for anatomy and pathology.
Your profileThe preferred candidate should have experience with:
  • Post-mortem examinations, including diagnostic necropsies, case reporting, and communication of findings.
  • Diagnostic histopathology.
Your profle as Tenure Track assistant professorYou are a skilled researcher with a solid background within your specific field of research, and you possess:
  • Documented research qualifications at a high international level
  • Teaching and supervision experience
  • Qualifications for the Tenure-Track assistant professor level at Aarhus University must include postdoctoral training or similar with a relevant research profile and a strong scientific publication record in one or more of the areas of the position you are applying for.
Please refer to the tenure track guidelines for the tenure review criteria and for the tenure review process.Your profile as Associate professorYou are established as a prominent researcher within your specific field of research, and you possess:
  • The ability to carry out independent and well-organized research work, as well as work as part of an interdisciplinary team.
  • Documented teaching qualifications at a high international level.
  • Experience with project management
In order to be assessed as qualified as associate professor, you must meet the academic criteria as outlined hereHow to apply
  • You must indicate the specific position you are applying for by selecting it in the menu. You may only select one position. If you wish to apply for one of the other positions, you must submit a separate application for each position.
  • Please also indicate in your written application which position you are applying for.
  • Furthermore, please indicate whether you are applying for a tenure-track assistant professor position, an associate professor position, or both by ticking the box. .
Who we areThe Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences is well-known for its skilled and very innovative interdisciplinary research environments with a high international impact. We perform world-class research, which contributes with solutions to address essential societal challenges within the green transition; the food production and veterinary medicine – nationally and globally.The department generates novel research at the highest international level within sustainable food production, the environment, climate, and the health and welfare for animals and humans. The activities form the basis for our research-based public authority consultancy and degree programmes covering bachelor’s, master’s and PhD degree programmes within animal science and veterinary medicine. We offer a lively, engaged and innovative learning and study environment, which is closely integrated with the research environment.Our department has unique and advanced animal experimental research facilities and technologies located close to the research environment, and a comprehensive national and international research network and strong industrial and professional collaborations.What we offer
  • A well-developed research infrastructure, laboratories and access to shared equipment and animal experimental facilities.
  • An informal and multicultural research environment with high professionalism and close collaboration and networking activities.
  • A workplace characterised by equality and a good work-life balance, and open discussions across different fields of research.
Living in DenmarkPlease visit the international staff https://internationalstaff.au.dk/prearrival/ for information about arriving to and living in Denmark for both the applicants and their potential families.Area of employment and place of workThe area of employment is Aarhus University (AU), with related departments The place of work is AU Viborg, Research Centre Foulum, Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences, Blichers Allé 20, DK-8830 Tjele.AU Viborg is approximately 10 km from Viborg. You can read more about it here: https://international.viborg.dk/ContactFor further information, please contact Deputy head of department, Professor Henrik Callesen (henrik.callesen@anivet.au.dk)or Head of department, Professor Charlotte Lauridsen (charlotte.lauridsen@anivet.au.dk)Technical Sciences Tenure TrackAarhus University offers talented scientists from around the world attractive career perspectives via the Technical Sciences Tenure Track Programme. Highly qualified candidates are appointed as Assistant Professors for a period of six years with the prospect of performance- based advancement to a tenured Associate Professorship. The aim of the Technical Sciences Tenure Track Programme is to:
  • attract outstanding talented individuals that are competitive at an international level
  • to promote the early development of independent research success early in the career of scientists
  • to create transparency in the academic career path
As part of the tenure track position, the candidate is offered:
  • access to research infrastructure
  • capability development, including postgraduate teacher training
  • a mentoring programme
  • support to develop scientific networks and to secure interdisciplinary research at the highest level
As part of the Aarhus University Tenure Track Programme, the University carries out a mid-way evaluation to review the progress of the tenure track candidate after three years, according to the same criteria used in the final tenure review. The final tenure review is conducted after five and a half years. If the review is positive, the candidate will be offered a tenured position as Associate Professor at Aarhus University.Please refer to the tenure track guidelines for the tenure review criteria and for the tenure review process.Application procedureShortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the assessment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. The selection is made on the basis of an assessment of who of the candidates are most relevant considering the requirements of the advertisement. All applicants will be notified within 6 weeks whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee and will receive his/her assessment. Read the full text and apply online

title: Are you studying for an IT degree and looking for a student job where you'll gain hands-on experience with modern workplace technology, cloud services, cybersecurity, and IT operations? Then join us!
employer: International Council for The Exploration Of The Sea
description:
We have an exciting opportunity for a service-minded IT student to join our team as a Student Assistant in Copenhagen.

About ICES

The International Council for the Exploration of the Sea (ICES) is an intergovernmental organization which advances marine science and promotes sustainable use of the seas. Our Secretariat is located in central Copenhagen and consists of approximately 85 staff representing more than 30 nationalities.

We are a small, collaborative workplace with an international outlook and a strong focus on learning, innovation, and knowledge sharing.

Your role

As our new Student Assistant, you'll help support the day-to-day IT needs of colleagues across an international workplace. Working alongside four other members of the IT team, you'll gain practical experience with modern workplace technologies while helping ensure that staff can work securely and effectively both in the office and remotely.

ResponsibilitiesYou will help with:

  • IT support and troubleshooting

  • Device setup and user administration

  • Microsoft 365 services and workplace technology

  • Meeting room and conferencing equipment

  • IT improvements, documentation, and security activities

  • Support cybersecurity and compliance activities, including CIS controls, using cloud and Microsoft 365 security solutions.

Who we are looking for

We are looking for a student who has completed at least 3 years of education within IT, computer science, business informatics, technical engineering, or a related field, and who is currently pursuing further studies.

You do not need to know everything already. We are more interested in your curiosity, motivation, and willingness to learn.

For this role, we expect you to have:

  • A strong interest in IT support and workplace technology

  • Good understanding of Windows and Microsoft 365

  • Confidence troubleshooting common technical issues

  • Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken

  • A structured and detail-oriented approach to your work

  • The ability to work independently while also being a strong team player

Experience with Microsoft 365 administration, cloud technologies, device management, cybersecurity, or scripting is an advantage, but not required.

Why join ICES?

At ICES, you'll do more than provide IT support. You'll gain practical experience with modern workplace technology, work closely with experienced colleagues, and help support an international community of staff and scientists. We offer flexible working hours to fit around your studies, along with plenty of opportunities to learn and develop your skills.

Terms of Appointment

This is a paid student role, and the working hours are 15 hours per week. This position will be established with an initial duration of 6 months, with a starting date as soon as possible (preferably January 2027).

Apply Now!

Don’t miss out on this opportunity to kickstart your IT career with us! Submit your application (CV and letter of motivation) by clicking the following link: Student Assistant (IT Support and Cybersecurity) Vacancy - ICES

Deadline for application submission is midnight 28 October 2026.

Questions about the role can be directed to IT Team Lead and Enterprise Architect, Nasrullah Iqbal (nas@ices.dk)

For more information about ICES, please visit our website:  www.ices.dk

title: 4 chauffører/montører søges til hvidevarer og TV – søg alene eller med din makker!
description:
4 chauffører/montører søges – fast makker, egen rute og kundeservice i topklasse!

N & S Transport Denmark ApS søger 4 dygtige og ansvarsbevidste chauffører/montører til levering, indbæring og montering af hvidevarer og TV.

I bliver fordelt på to teams med to medarbejdere i hver 8-pallers liftbil. Vi søger medarbejdere, der kan samarbejde, tage ansvar og sikre, at kunden får en god oplevelse fra ankomst til færdig montering.

Har du allerede en makker, som du arbejder godt sammen med? Så er I meget velkomne til at søge sammen! Du kan også søge alene, så sammensætter vi de rette teams.

Arbejdssted og arbejdstid

• Ruterne starter og slutter i Fredericia.• Arbejdsdagene er mandag til fredag.• Mødetid kl. 06.00 med forventet afslutning omkring kl. 15.00. Sluttidspunktet kan variere efter dagens opgaver.• Forventet opstart den 2. november 2026 – den endelige dato aftales.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Sammen med din makker står du for sikker transport, indbæring, udpakning, placering og montering hos kunderne. Opgaverne omfatter:

• Opstilling og tilslutning af vaskemaskiner.• Opstilling og tilslutning af opvaskemaskiner.• Montering af integrerede opvaskemaskiner, herunder tilpasning og montering af frontlåge.• Montering af integrerede køleskabe.• Tilslutning af ovne og tørretumblere.• Lednings- og tilslutningsopgaver, hvor de nødvendige kompetencer og eventuelle autorisationskrav er opfyldt.• Vending af døre på køle- og fryseskabe.• Montering af TV på væg, fod og stativ.• Montering af udsugning/emhætte.• Kontrol af, at leveringen og monteringen er udført korrekt.• Registrering af leveringer, billeder og dokumentation i chaufførappen.• Oprydning og håndtering af emballage samt eventuelle returvarer efter aftale.

Alle monterings- og tilslutningsopgaver skal udføres fagligt korrekt og efter gældende regler og producentens anvisninger.

Vi forventer, at du

• Har praktisk erfaring med levering og montering af hvidevarer og TV og kan arbejde selvstændigt med opgaverne.• Har gyldigt kørekort til bilen og de nødvendige chaufførbeviser.• Kan håndtere en liftbil og sikre godset forsvarligt.• Trives med fysisk arbejde, herunder indbæring på trapper, og bruger hjælpemidler korrekt.• Er mødestabil, omhyggelig og tager ansvar for både varer, bil og kundens hjem.• Kan kommunikere med kunderne på dansk og forstå arbejdsinstruktioner.• Er fortrolig med smartphone, navigation og registrering af leveringer.• Er løsningsorienteret og bevarer en professionel tone, også når en opgave er krævende.

Vi søger medarbejdere med erfaring fra starten. Beskriv derfor tydeligt, hvilke monteringsopgaver du selv har udført, og hvilke du kan løse selvstændigt.

Vi tilbyder

• Fast kørsel mandag til fredag.• Arbejde i et fast team med to medarbejdere pr. bil.• En varieret hverdag med både kørsel, kundekontakt og praktiske opgaver.• Løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter overenskomst.• En arbejdsplads med direkte kontakt til ledelsen, tæt samarbejde og fokus på kvalitet.

Søg alene – eller sammen med din makker

Send en kort ansøgning og dit CV til info@nstransportdk.dk med emnet: “Chauffør/montør – Fredericia”.

Fortæl os:

• Hvilken erfaring du har med kørsel, hvidevarer og TV-montering.• Hvilke kørekort og chaufførbeviser du har.• Hvornår du kan starte.• Om du søger alene eller sammen med en makker.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet de rette fire medarbejdere.

title: Pædagogiske og sundhedsfaglige medarbejdere samt en sygeplejerske med fokus på kvalitet og undervisning
description:
Vil du bruge din faglighed til at skabe tryghed og udviklingsmuligheder for børn og unge? Hos MerVib søger vi både medarbejdere til det daglige arbejde på vores børne- og ungehjem i Herrestrup og Grevinge og en sygeplejerske til sundhedsfaglig kvalitet, medicinhåndtering og undervisning. Vores tilgang Et barn eller en ung kommer med erfaringer, interesser og håb – og ofte med andres fortællinger, der med tiden kan være blevet til faste sandheder om, hvem de er. Hos MerVib er vi nysgerrige på barnets egen oplevelse: Hvad er vigtigt? Hvad lykkes? Og hvad kan vi voksne have overset? På vores fire børne- og ungehjem arbejder vi for, at børn og unge oplever tryghed, tilhørsforhold og indflydelse på eget liv. Vores narrative tilgang præger, hvordan vi taler med og om børnene. Vi undersøger vores egne antagelser og får sammen med barnet øje på færdigheder, initiativer og håb. Barnets perspektiv er med til at forme vores støtte. Pædagogiske og sundhedsfaglige medarbejdere til Herrestrup og Grevinge Du arbejder med tydelig struktur, professionel omsorg og relationer – både i fællesskaber og i individuelle opgaver med 1:1-støtte. Du tilpasser støtten til det enkelte barn og bidrager til en tryg og forudsigelig hverdag. Vi søger dig der
  • Har en relevant faglig uddannelse og erfaring med børn og unge i sårbare positioner.
  • Har viden om og erfaring med autisme, ADHD og omsorgssvigt.
  • Har erfaring med eller interesse for narrativ praksis og TEACCH.
  • Er nysgerrig på barnets perspektiv og kan tilpasse støtten inden for trygge, tydelige rammer.
  • Arbejder ud fra en Low Arousal-tilgang, tager ansvar, dokumenterer systematisk og er åben for faglig sparring.
Du kan eksempelvis være uddannet pædagog, socialpædagog, pædagogisk assistent, social- og sundhedsassistent, sygeplejerske, socialrådgiver, skolelærer, fysioterapeut eller ergoterapeut. Du kan også have en anden relevant socialfaglig, sundhedsfaglig eller pædagogisk uddannelse. Der er tale om faste fuldtidsstillinger med 12-timers dagvagter, 24-timers døgnvagter og weekendarbejde. Arbejdsstederne er vores børne- og ungehjem i Herrestrup og Grevinge. Sygeplejerske til sundhedsfaglig kvalitet medicinhåndtering og undervisning Som sygeplejerske skal du have et solidt fagligt og lovgivningsmæssigt fundament. Du kombinerer praktiske medicinopgaver med undervisning og kvalitetsudvikling og hjælper ledelsen og medarbejderne med at omsætte gældende regler til tydelige og forsvarlige arbejdsgange. Dine opgaver omfatter at
  • Varetage medicinopgaver, herunder dispensering efter gældende ordinationer og instrukser.
  • Undervise og vejlede medarbejderne i medicinhåndtering og følge op på oplæring og kompetencer.
  • Gennemgå, opdatere og versionsstyre sundhedsfaglige instrukser i overensstemmelse med gældende regler og vejledninger samt følge op på, at de anvendes korrekt i hverdagen.
  • Omsætte faglige krav til brugbare arbejdsgange inden for blandt andet ansvar og kompetencer, journalføring, samtykke, hygiejne, utilsigtede hændelser og egenkontrol.
  • Indgå i det pædagogiske arbejde i husene i dagtimerne eller i weekender. Tilrettelæggelsen aftales med udgangspunkt i dine interesser og stillingens øvrige opgaver.
Vi søger dig der
  • Er uddannet og autoriseret sygeplejerske med solid erfaring med medicinhåndtering, dispensering og sundhedsfaglig dokumentation.
  • Har solidt kendskab til relevant sundhedslovgivning, herunder regler om medicinhåndtering, journalføring, samtykke, tavshedspligt og delegation af sundhedsfaglige opgaver.
  • Kender og kan anvende relevante vejledninger fra Sundhedsstyrelsen og Styrelsen for Patientsikkerhed og holder dig ajour med ændringer.
  • Kan underbygge din vejledning med gældende regler og faglige kilder og afklarer tvivlsspørgsmål, før du vejleder eller ændrer en instruks.
  • Kan skrive klare instrukser og gøre faglig viden anvendelig for medarbejdere med forskellige uddannelsesbaggrunde.
  • Kan undervise og vejlede præcist og praksisnært samt følge op på, at medarbejderne forstår deres opgaver, ansvar og kompetencegrænser.
  • Arbejder systematisk og selvstændigt og trives i et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde.
  • Møder børn og unge med respekt, nysgerrighed og blik for deres perspektiv.
Erfaring fra et børne- og ungehjem eller et andet socialt tilbud er en fordel. Stillingen er en fast fuldtidsstilling med opgaver på MerVibs børne- og ungehjem i Herrestrup, Grevinge og Jyderup. Vi har desuden undervisningslokaler i Herlev. Du skal være villig til at bruge egen bil. Hos MerVib får du Et arbejdsfællesskab med varme, engagement og høj faglig standard. Du introduceres til vores hverdag, værdier og metoder og deltager fra start med støtte fra kolleger og ledelse. Vores årshjul rummer intern og ekstern undervisning samt faglige oplæg gennem hele året. Derudover får du tæt ledelsesmæssig sparring og supervision. For begge stillingsprofiler gælder:
  • Løn og tiltrædelse efter aftale.
  • Pension og sundhedsforsikring.
  • Kørekort til almindelig bil (B) er et krav.

title: Software Architect for Research Cloud Services at the SDU eScience Center
description:
The eScience Center at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) develops and operates large-scale IT infrastructure dedicated to research in all fields. The center is a leading national provider of supercomputing resources and facilities, often provided in close collaboration with other Danish universities. 

Our mission is to support research via the development of advanced IT infrastructure and by providing support and expertise to researchers. The key areas of the center are High Performance Computing (HPC), Cloud Services, Data Analytics and Data Management Services. We assist a large research community, educational and government institutions, as well as commercial companies. The center has developed a user-friendly and advanced private cloud system called UCloud, which is the core of the DeiC national system for interactive HPC and cloud computing.

We address stimulating new technological challenges. The SDU eScience Center offers a research-like environment where we encourage the study of innovative solutions and personal growth. We firmly believe in open-source and web technology as means to reach our goals.

Job description:The center is expanding its staff in one of its core areas: research cloud services. 

We seek an expert in the following areas:

  • Distributed and concurrent systems

  • SQL databases

  • Software development for HPC environments

  • Experience with Slurm, Kubernetes or OpenStack

  • Software development experience using Go, C or C++

  • Container and virtualization technology

Experience in at least two of the above areas is required, and candidates with previous experience with Go, Kubernetes and distributed systems will be strongly preferred.

The successful candidate will become part of the cloud team at the eScience Center. Tasks under the user cloud team include, but are not limited to: Designing, developing, and maintaining high-performance distributed systems and services. Integrating with HPC schedulers such as Slurm and container orchestration platforms like Kubernetes. Participating in the full feature lifecycle, from requirements gathering and architectural design to coding, automated testing, deployment, and ongoing monitoring of production environments.

The cloud team at the eScience Center currently consists of four employees with long expertise in building cloud computing infrastructure, programming and software engineering. 

Required qualifications for the position: 

  • Proven experience in at least two of the areas in the job description.

  • Strong background in Linux systems.

  • Programming skills (e.g. in Go, C, C++, bash, …).

  • Proven ability to work productively both independently and as part of an interdisciplinary team balancing divergent objectives involving research, code development, supporting software and consulting with scientists.

Other relevant qualifications (not required):

  • MSc or PhD in a relevant field of science or engineering.

  • Experience with DevOps practices (e.g. git and GitHub, continuous integration and deployment, software documentation).

While the positions offer flexibility and the possibility of remote work, the candidates are expected to be on-site in Odense.

Condition of Employment

The starting date for the positions is 15 January 2027 or as soon as possible. Appointments are for full time positions for a limited time period of at least 1 year based on the candidate’s profile with the possibility of extension. 

All inquiries are welcome. Please contact:

Prof. Director Claudio PicaSDU eScience CenterDept. of Mathematics and Computer ScienceUniversity of Southern Denmarkemail: pica@cp3.sdu.dk

title: Egebjerg rengøring søger medarbejder, til den private hjemmehjælp ( praktisk hjælp ) i Odsherred kommune
description:
Egebjerg rengøring søger en stabil og servicminded medarbejder med hjertet på rette sted. Du skal have lyst til at hjælpe ældre og svage medborger med almindelig rengøring og andre små praktiske ting i deres hjem.

title: RE-ADVERTISEMENT - Senior Team Leader for Research Support at the SDU eScience Center for National Research Infrastructure
description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Team Leader to lead the Research Support team at the SDU eScience Center. The team plays a central role in helping researchers, research groups, and institutions across Denmark leverage advanced computing, cloud, AI, and data services to accelerate scientific discovery and innovation.

As Senior Team Leader, you will combine scientific insight, technical understanding, and leadership skills to guide a highly skilled team of research support specialists. Working closely with researchers across all disciplines, you will help shape how next-generation digital infrastructure is adopted and utilized within Danish research.

The position offers a unique opportunity to influence both the strategic development of national research services and the day-to-day support provided to tens of thousands of researchers using the center's infrastructure and platforms.

We are looking for a collaborative and forward-looking team leader who is passionate about enabling excellent research through advanced digital technologies. The ideal candidate combines scientific and technical credibility with strong leadership skills and enjoys working at the intersection of research, technology, and service development.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead and develop the Research Support team, including strategic planning, prioritization, and staff development as part of the management group for the eScience center.

  • Ensure high-quality support and consultancy services for researchers and customers from the public and private sector using the center's computing, cloud, AI, and data platforms.

  • Build strong relationships with researchers, departments, external customers, and research infrastructures across SDU and nationally.

  • Identify emerging research and customers’ needs and contribute to the development of new services, tools, and support initiatives.

  • Collaborate with the center's technical teams to ensure that infrastructure and services align with user requirements and scientific developments.

Required qualifications

  • Relevant university degree at Master's level or higher in computer science, engineering, natural sciences, data science, computational science, or a related discipline.

  • Demonstrated leadership experience, including responsibility for teams, projects, or complex research initiatives.

  • Strong understanding of computational research, scientific computing, data-intensive research, AI, or digital research infrastructure.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills in both Danish and English.

  • The ability to engage effectively with researchers, technical specialists, customers from the private and public sector.

  • Proven ability to translate scientific and customers’ needs into practical solutions and service developments.

Desired qualifications

  • At least 3 years of experience from a university, research organization, national research infrastructure, or technology-oriented organization, including experience leading projects, teams, or research support activities. 

  • Familiarity with high-performance computing, cloud computing, AI platforms, research data management, or research software engineering.

  • Experience developing research support services, training activities, or scientific user communities.

  • Knowledge of the Danish or European research infrastructure landscape.

While the positions offer flexibility and the possibility of remote work, the candidate is expected to be on-site in Odense.

About the SDU eScience Center

The SDU eScience Center is a national center for advanced digital research infrastructure at the University of Southern Denmark. The center develops, operates, and continuously advances large-scale computing, cloud, data, and AI services that support research across all scientific disciplines.

As Denmark's leading provider of research cyberinfrastructure, the center plays a central role in the national ecosystem for research computing and digital services. Through close collaborations with Danish universities, public institutions, and international partners, the center helps researchers access the computational resources and digital platforms needed to address some of society's most complex scientific and technological challenges.

The center is the primary developer and operator of UCloud, Denmark's national research cloud, which provides researchers with seamless access to advanced computing resources, AI and machine learning environments, data-intensive workflows, and scientific applications. Today, the platform serves tens of thousands of users across the Danish research community and forms a key component of the national e-infrastructure landscape.

At the SDU eScience Center, we combine the mindset of a research environment with the professionalism of a modern technology organization. Our teams work at the intersection of cloud computing, high-performance computing, AI infrastructure, data management, software engineering, and digital platform development. We actively contribute to open-source technologies and collaborate closely with researchers to transform emerging technologies into robust services with national impact.

At our center, you will be joining a highly collaborative community where brilliant minds—from IT professionals and data specialists to world-class researchers—converge to drive research innovation. We don’t just maintain servers; we build the foundational digital platforms that empower researchers, students and innovators to solve global challenges.

title: Entrepriseleder til tømrer afdeling
description:

Som entrepriseleder får du ansvaret for vores egenproduktion på en række spændende byggeprojekter. Du sikrer fremdrift, kvalitet, økonomi og sikkerhed og bliver en vigtig del af samarbejdet mellem byggeplads, projektledelse, bygherre og rådgivere.

Dine opgaver omfatter blandt andet:

• Opfølgning på tidsplaner, kvalitet og økonomi.

Stillingen kan tilgås fra flere faglige baggrunde. Vi ser gerne, at du har en baggrund som tømrer, suppleret med en uddannelse som bygningskonstruktør, byggetekniker eller lignende. Det vigtigste er dog din erfaring med styring af tømrerentrepriser, dit engagement og dine samarbejdsevner.

Som person er du:

• Tydelig, involverende og god til at skabe tillid.

• Målrettet, resultatorienteret og vedholdende.

• Motiverende, positiv og samarbejdsvillig.

• Ordholdende, loyal og løsningsorienteret.

• I stand til at læse og forstå tegninger og projektmateriale.

• Opmærksom på sikkerhed og arbejdsmiljø.

• En dygtig kommunikator med en tydelig, saglig og tillidsskabende kommunikationsstil.

EMR udfører projekter i hele Danmark i både fag-, hoved- og totalentrepriser. Du vil derfor indgå som en del af byggeledelsen på EMR’s egne projekter med ansvar for tømrerentreprisen, ligesom du vil stå i spidsen for selvstændige fagentrepriser for eksterne bygherrer og samarbejdspartnere.

title: Experienced High Voltage Specialist wanted for Bravida El-Infrastruktur Øst
description:
Do you have at least three years of high voltage experience? At Bravida, you will install circuit breakers, disconnectors and switchboards and help build substations. Here, you will put your experience to use on critical electrical infrastructure projects that help secure Denmark’s power supply and support the green transition.

On behalf of Bravida El-Infrastruktur Øst, Career | a JKS Company is recruiting experienced High Voltage Specialists for projects across Zealand and Lolland-Falster.

Bravida El-Infrastruktur Øst has secured the framework agreement with Energinet, becoming a regular supplier of high voltage installation work across Zealand and Lolland-Falster. With this agreement and a strong order book, Bravida is expanding the department. You will join the team responsible for building, expanding, refurbishing and maintaining the infrastructure that the power grid of the future relies on.

Installation and construction of high voltage installationsYou will work at substations and other high voltage installations, putting your experience into practice. You will take responsibility for your own tasks and work alongside your team to deliver safe, high-quality work.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Installing and replacing circuit breakers, disconnectors and other substation components

  • Carrying out cable work and working on earthing systems

  • Working on switchboards, electrical installations and dismantling tasks

  • Contributing to the construction, refurbishment and maintenance of high voltage installations

  • Carrying out quality assurance and maintaining documentation

Over time, you will also share your knowledge by helping apprentices and new colleagues get to grips with their tasks.

You bring solid high voltage experience and take responsibilityYou are a qualified electrician or have an equivalent electrical qualification, with at least three years of hands-on experience in high voltage work. You are familiar with the tasks described and comfortable working independently. You take initiative, recognise what needs doing and understand that safety is integral to every task.

We are looking for someone who:

  • Works independently and takes a structured approach

  • Takes responsibility for the safety and quality of their work

  • Is proactive, well-presented and works well with others

  • Is physically fit and comfortable with hands-on work outdoors and at height

  • Holds a category B driving licence and can provide a criminal record certificate

You must be able to communicate clearly in English and have a valid work permit for Denmark.

A company vehicle to take home and no on-call dutiesAt Bravida, you will join a team of skilled, dedicated technicians who take pride in their work.

You will work daytime hours with no on-call duties, normally five days a week. Start times depend on the project, and the working week can be discussed. The role is paid hourly, with pay based on qualifications, plus pension contributions and a flexible benefits allowance under the Danish “fritvalgsordning” scheme.

You will have a company vehicle equipped with the tools and equipment you need, which you can take home. Your exact location is therefore less important, provided you are willing to work at different sites across Zealand and Lolland-Falster.

We look forward to hearing from youIf this sounds like the right role for you, please send us your CV. We review applications and invite suitable candidates to interviews on an ongoing basis, and will close the vacancy once the right candidates have been found.

If you have any questions about the role that are not covered in this advertisement, please contact Recruitment Specialist Kristine Askjær on +45 3085 1302.

Please note that, for GDPR reasons, applications submitted directly by email will not be processed or receive a response.

title: Studieadjunkt i bygningskonstruktioner til Bygningsingeniøruddannelsen ved AAU Energi Esbjerg
description:
Vil du være med til at uddanne fremtidens diplomingeniører inden for byggeri og anlæg, hvor konstruktioner, bæredygtighed og energioptimering tænkes sammen fra første semester? På Campus AAU Esbjerg får du en central rolle i undervisning, vejledning og koordination på bygningsingeniøruddannelsen i et tæt fagligt miljø med korte veje mellem undervisere og studerende. Stillingen er en varig fuldtidsstilling med tiltrædelse 1. januar 2027 eller snarest derefter.

Dine arbejdsopgaverSom studieadjunkt i bygningskonstruktioner bliver du en nøgleperson i udviklingen af bygningsingeniøruddannelsen på Campus AAU Esbjerg. Uddannelsen er forankret i Institut for Energi, og du bliver derfor en del af et fagligt miljø, hvor byggeri, energi, klima og bæredygtighed tænkes sammen på tværs af kursusaktiviteter og projektforløb. Bygningsingeniøruddannelsen i Esbjerg giver de studerende mulighed for at arbejde både eksperimentelt og digitalt, herunder med numeriske beregninger f.eks. FEM.

En væsentlig del af din hverdag kommer til at bestå af vejledning af diplomingeniørstuderende på bygningsingeniøruddannelsen fra første til syvende semester. Du følger hold og projektgrupper tæt, giver faglig og metodisk sparring og hjælper de studerende med at koble teori om konstruktioner, materialer og belastninger til konkrete ingeniørprojekter. I vejledningen indgår både den generelle udvikling af de studerendes ingeniørfaglige dømmekraft og arbejdet med specifikke problemstillinger inden for bygningskonstruktioner i beton, stål og træ.

Stillingen omfatter desuden faglig ansvarlighed i relation til konstruktionsingeniørprofilen, hvor der arbejdes med statisk kontrol af etagebygninger, stålkonstruktioner, betonkonstruktioner og trækonstruktioner. Du vil bidrage til, at de studerende lærer at tilrettelægge og dokumentere statiske beregninger i overensstemmelse med relevante standarder og normer, og du vil indgå i dialogen om, hvordan bæredygtighed, klimahensyn og energioptimering tænkes ind i projekteringen af bygningskonstruktioner.

En central del af jobbet er koordinering på tværs af uddannelsens semestre. Du medvirker til at skabe sammenhæng mellem kursusaktiviteter, projektarbejde og praktik, så uddannelsens faglige progression bliver tydelig for både studerende og undervisere. Det indebærer blandt andet semestrets planlægning, løbende opfølgning i semesterforløbet og samarbejde med kolleger om justeringer og udviklingstiltag. Derudover får du ansvar for praktikkoordinering, hvor du bidrager til dialogen mellem uddannelsen, de studerende og virksomhederne om indholdet i praktikforløb og om samspillet mellem praktik og resten af studiet.

Afhængigt af din faglige profil kan der også indgå konfrontationsundervisning i centrale kurser inden for konstruktion, for eksempel statik og styrkelære på både grundlæggende og videregående niveau, kurser i last og sikkerhed, bygningsmaterialer, betonteknologi og -konstruktion samt emner relateret til spændbeton, elementbyggeri og midlertidige konstruktioner. Her vil du arbejde med at skabe sammenhæng mellem de analytiske beregninger, materialeforståelse og de praktiske forhold, som konstruktionsingeniører møder i praksis.

Hvis du har interesse og dokumenteret erfaring inden for forskningsområder relateret til byggeri og risikobaserede tilgange, vil der kunne åbnes for en kobling til forskningsaktiviteter. Det kan for eksempel være emner som robusthed og modstandsdygtighed i den byggede masse, risikobaseret drift og vedligehold, samspil mellem livscyklusvurdering, økonomi og ”resilience” eller mere specifikke problemstillinger i relation til konstruktioner, klima og energiforsyning. Omfanget heraf vil afhænge af din profil og instituttes behov.

Dine kompetencerDu har en uddannelsesbaggrund som bygningsingeniør på kandidatniveau eller civilingeniørniveau, eller du kan på anden måde dokumentere en faglig tyngde, der svarer hertil. Du har solid erfaring som konstruktionsingeniør med statisk dokumentation af bygningskonstruktioner, og du er vant til at arbejde systematisk med normer, standarder og projekteringsgrundlag. Det er vigtigt, at du kan dokumentere flere års relevant erfaring med statisk dokumentation, som typisk vil svare til arbejde på niveau med en statiker i konstruktionsklasse 2.

Du har flere års erfaring med statiske beregninger, herunder bestemmelse af laster og lastnedføring, grænsetilstandsberegninger og dokumentation af enten etagebygninger eller brokonstruktioner. Du kan arbejde selvstændigt med opbygning af beregningsmodeller og dokumentation af resultater, og du er fortrolig med at omsætte komplekse tekniske krav til robuste og forståelige løsninger. Har du erfaring med betonteknologi og grænsetilstandsberegninger i beton, vil det være en klar fordel. Det samme gælder erfaring med træteknologi og beregninger i træ samt eventuel erfaring med funderingsberegninger og anvendelse af geotekniske forundersøgelser.

Kendskab til og anvendelse af metoder baseret på FEM i forbindelse med statisk dokumentation af etagebygninger eller brokonstruktioner vil være meget relevant i stillingen. Du er tryg ved at bruge digitale beregningsværktøjer som en integreret del af dit arbejde og kan hjælpe de studerende med at forstå både muligheder og begrænsninger ved sådanne værktøjer. Samtidig har du en interesse i, hvordan bæredygtighed, klimahensyn og energioptimering kan indarbejdes som naturlige parametre i projekteringen af bygningskonstruktioner.

Det er en forudsætning for stillingen, at du kan undervise, vejlede og eksaminere på dansk. Du kan formidle komplekse tekniske problemstillinger på en måde, der gør det muligt for studerende at opbygge både forståelse og sikkerhed i faget, og du er nysgerrig på, hvordan undervisning, øvelser og projekter kan udvikles, så de afspejler ingeniørarbejdet i praksis.

Som person trives du med at have tæt kontakt til studerende og kolleger, og du har lyst til at tage et samlet ansvar for undervisningsforløb, semesterkoordinering og praktik. Du arbejder struktureret og kan skabe overblik på tværs af kurser, projekter og årgange, og du følger opgaver til dørs i et miljø, hvor der er mange parallelle aktiviteter. Du bidrager konstruktivt til samarbejdet i det lokale fagmiljø og er villig til at dele viden og erfaringer, så uddannelsen og de studerendes læring hele tiden kan udvikles.

Hvem er viDu bliver en del af bygningsingeniøruddannelsen på Campus AAU Esbjerg, som er forankret i Institut for Energi ved Aalborg Universitet. Uddannelsen er kendetegnet ved et tæt og overskueligt studiemiljø, hvor der er kort afstand mellem studerende og undervisere, og hvor der er gode muligheder for løbende dialog om både det faglige indhold og tilrettelæggelsen af undervisningen. I det lokale miljø indgår du i et samarbejde med kolleger, der både har erfaring fra praksis og fra universitetsverdenen, og som har et fælles fokus på at uddanne ingeniører, der kan løse konkrete udfordringer i byggeriet.

Miljøet på Campus AAU Esbjerg er præget af et tæt samarbejde mellem forskellige uddannelser og forskningsområder inden for energi, byggeri og relaterede tekniske felter. Det giver gode muligheder for at trække på erfaringer og perspektiver på tværs af faggrupper, og for at udvikle undervisningsforløb, hvor de studerende arbejder med problemstillinger, der går på tværs af klassiske faggrænser. Uddannelsen arbejder løbende med at inddrage forsøg, laboratorieaktiviteter og digitalisering i undervisningen.

Som medarbejder på Campus AAU Esbjerg får du et arbejdsliv, hvor der er fokus på både kvalitet i undervisningen og på et bæredygtigt arbejdsliv for medarbejderne. Planlægningen af undervisning og vejledning sker med blik for at skabe sammenhæng mellem kursusaktiviteter, projektarbejde og perioder med forberedelse, så der i de mindre undervisningstunge perioder også kan være mulighed for koncentreret fordybelse i udvikling af undervisning eller andre opgaver. Du bliver samtidig en del af Aalborg Universitet som helhed, hvor der er adgang til pædagogisk opkvalificering, adjunktforløb og kollegial sparring på tværs af campusser og institutter.

Kvalifikationskrav Kvalifikationskravet til stillingen er en kandidateksamen eller kvalifikationer på tilsvarende niveau. Der skal desuden foreligge en positiv bedømmelse af ansøgerens undervisningskvalifikationer. Ansøgning Din ansøgning skal indeholde følgende:  

  • Ansøgning, hvori begrundelser for at ansøge, kvalifikationer i forhold til stillingen samt intentioner og visioner for stillingen angives 
  • CV  
  • Eksamensbeviser (Kandidatbevis) 
  • Dokumentation for undervisningsmæssige kvalifikationer. 
  • Publikationsliste (valgfri) med angivelse af de vedhæftede publikationer, du ønsker tages i betragtning ved bedømmelsen. Du må maksimalt vedhæfte 5 publikationer.

Du kan læse mere om krav til din ansøgning her.  

Ansøgning sendes via Aalborg Universitets rekrutteringssystem, som kan tilgås under stillingsopslaget på Aalborg Universitets hjemmeside. 

Aalborg Universitet ønsker at afspejle det omgivende samfund og har diversitet som en kerneværdi. Derfor opfordres alle uanset personlig baggrund og orientering til at søge stillingen.   Har du spørgsmål?  Hvis du har spørgsmål, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte os. Se kontaktpersoner nederst i opslaget. 

Øvrige informationer  Du kan læse mere om vores rekrutteringsproces her.  

Vi anbefaler, at du gemmer en kopi af stillingsopslaget, da opslaget bliver fjernet, når ansøgningsfristen er udløbet. 

Ansættelsesprocessen på Aalborg Universitet indebærer en shortlistingsproces. Du kan læse mere om det her. 

Ansættelsesprocessen på Aalborg Universitet kan omfatte en risikovurdering som et værktøj til at identificere potentielle risici forbundet med nyansættelser, der sikrer arbejdspladsens sikkerhed, compliance og integritet.  Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår Ansættelse sker i henhold til bekendtgørelse om ansættelse af videnskabeligt personale ved universiteter og bekendtgørelse om stillingsstruktur for videnskabeligt personale ved universiteter samt protokollat om visse ansættelsesvilkår for videnskabeligt personale ved universiteter. 

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår er i henhold til overenskomst for akademikere i staten og protokollat om visse ansættelsesvilkår for videnskabeligt personale ved universiteter.  Der er 3 måneders gensidig prøvetid i stillingen.

Aalborg Universitet - Viden for verdenAalborg Universitet er en international arbejdsplads med mere end 3700 ansatte. Vi udbyder virkelighedsnære uddannelser og skaber forskningsresultater i verdensklasse gennem samarbejde mellem forskere, studerende og offentlige og private virksomheder. Sådan opnås erkendelser, nye løsninger på samfundets problemer og viden, der forandrer verden. Vores hovedcampus ligger i Aalborg, men vi har også campus i Esbjerg og København.

title: Chef - Zoku Copenhagen
description:
Are you a passionate chef with great cooking skills who loves to work in an open kitchen? Then keep reading.

Zoku provides a home for business travellers who want to live in a city for between a few days and a few months. We’re a new type of hotel offering a relaxed place to live, co-work and socialize – while wiring residents into the local scene. Join an international team of driven, proactive and fun-loving Zokus who all have one thing in common: a passion for connecting people across the globe.

TELL ME MORE

Life doesn’t become more social than through sharing food. That’s our founding food philosophy and it can be yours too. The food that comes out of our Living Kitchen is fresh, simple, honest, healthy and local. With short-end preparation times, simple ingredients and limited preparation steps, our assortment is incredibly intelligent and facilitates fast service.As our new chef you'll be responsible for any food that comes out of our Living Kitchen. You'll plate beautiful dishes and at times make creative buffets that not only look good, but also taste amazing.

You’ll work closely together with our team of chefs, to develop menu offerings and forecast supply needs. You like to take on responsibility, thrive with independence in your work and function as a substitute for our chefs. 

WHAT MAKES OUR KITCHEN UNIQUE?

  • You won’t hide in the background. You'll get to work in an open kitchen environment with plenty of space and natural daylight.

  • You'll get the ultimate flexibility. You can come up with your own dishes and let your creativity run wild.

  • You can have good conversations with visitors. You’re the face of the kitchen and you'll get to directly chat with guests.

  • You get to be independent in your work. You like doing your own thing and can cook solo when you need to.

  • You can get to know the entire team. You'll be in close contact with our front of house and the entire Zoku team.

  • You can work in a unique kitchen setup. We’re not like your average kitchen (feel free to stop by our rooftop to see for yourself!).

  • You are encouraged to work with fresh and seasonal ingredients. We put a strong emphasis on incorporating vegetables into our dishes.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

  • A market conform salary package including pension and health insurance.

  • Cool benefits like an after-work drink, access to all community events, various discounts like 40% discount on F&B for you and 4 friends, plus Employee and Friends & Family rates in all Zoku Locations.  

  • A free night stay for you and your +1 in your first 3 months at your Zoku (dinner & breakfast) and a free night at any Zoku location for your birthday, including welcome drink & breakfast to experience Zoku as a true guest. 

  • No boring canteen!! Staff meals enjoyed from our Living Kitchen.

  • A personal budget unlocked after 1 year at Zoku to spend on extra days off, learning & development, extra cash or discounted vouchers. 

  • A fun, young, and international team to grow with. Plus, exciting training and events to celebrate every step of the journey!

  • A job at one of the 25 coolest hotels in the world, that feels like a second home and is purpose-driven.

WE LOVE PEOPLE WHO...

  • Show their creativity through their passion for food and never settle for less.

  • Can juggle many tasks at the same time while remaining cool headed and warm hearted.

  • Enjoy variety in their day and are happy to switch things up, whether that means breakfast, brunch, lunch buffets, a la carte dinners or cheffing up something special for our Meetings & Events.

  • Have experience in working independently and don't believe in traditional kitchen hierarchies.

  • Enjoy working in an open kitchen and love to chat up a storm with our residents.

  • Have experience in healthy homestyle cooking – vegetarian cooking skills are a plus.

  • Have provable knowledge of various cooking techniques.

A FEW MUST HAVES

  • You have a minimum of 1 year working experience in a kitchen or restaurant environment. 

  • You have experience with implementing the local HACCP guidelines (Hygiejnebevis).

  • You are fluent in English – Danish and other languages are a plus.

  • You are an EU resident or have a working and living permit valid for Denmark including a CPR.

  • You are fully flexible, as there won't be fixed working days / hours, including availability on some weekends. Shifts include AM, Mid-shifts, and PM.

  • You love to work as we'll need you Full Time (37 hours- 5 shifts weekly)

  • Available to start As Soon As Possible.

WHAT WE ARE PROUD OF 

Our fresh take on hospitality has been recognized around the world with plenty of press attention and design awards.

We’re also proudly B Corp certified at all four of our locations (Amsterdam, Copenhagen, Paris and Vienna), which means we hold ourselves to high standards when it comes to social and environmental impact, transparency and accountability.

WHAT IS ZOKU

Zoku is a new type of hotel that offers a place to live, co-work and socialize in Europe's most livable cities: Amsterdam, Vienna, Copenhagen & Paris. 

Designed for the new generation of travellers, Zoku is so much more than a long stay hotel. It is a place you can call your second home, even on your first visit. Zoku is a hive of private Lofts and rooftop Social Spaces, so travellers can stay connected and well rested as they live and work throughout Europe. Throw yourself into your work and play, and effortlessly discover one of our home cities.
