title: Associate Professor in Radiography
description:
A position as associate professor (10% time) is vacant at the Research Unit of Radiology (Odense), the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark.

UNIFY – Research and Innovation Unit of Radiology, Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), in collaboration with University College Lillebælt (UCL) and Odense Universitetshospital (OUH), invites applications for a position as Associate Professor in Radiography, with 10% research time at the Department of Radiology, OUH. The position is offered for a five-year period with the possibility of extension. The starting date is subject to agreement.

About the research unit

UNIFY – Research and Innovation Unit of Radiology conducts high-quality research across all radiological specialties and contributes significantly to the education and development of highly qualified staff for both clinical and academic work.

The unit values researchers with diverse professional backgrounds and has approximately 20 affiliated members, including a professor, associate professors, PhD students, adjunct professors and others.

The unit has a well-established research environment and organises a number of regular activities and meetings throughout the year, including research retreats combining academic and social activities.

Research and Teaching ResponsibilitiesThe position involves research, academic development, research training, teaching, including examinations, supervision and assessment activities.

Qualifications and ExpectationsThe Associate Professor must hold a primary position at UCL.

The successful applicant must have documented research and teaching experience within radiography and a particular interest in ultrasound.

Furthermore, strong collaborative skills are required in order to further develop research in radiography, both across disciplines and at national and international level. Having international research collaborators is considered an advantage but is not a requirement.

Joint Research Strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and OUH

The joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and OUH sets the direction for our shared research activities in the coming years.

Based on the vision, “We conduct research together to create the patient care of the future,” particular emphasis is placed on:

  • Research across disciplines, with people at the centre

  • Strong research environments as a driving force for development

  • The research pathway from idea to impact

Further information about the joint research strategy is available on the SDU website.

Applicants Must Document

  • A PhD degree or equivalent postgraduate research qualifications

  • Relevant research experience documented through publications in international peer-reviewed journals

  • Relevant clinical experience

  • Relevant experience in educational administration

  • A successful track record in obtaining research funding

Applicants must meet the qualifications required at Associate Professor level in accordance with the applicable Danish Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities.

Reporting

The Associate Professor will report to Head of Research Bo Mussmann on matters relating to the associate professorship.

Contact

For further information about the position, please contact Head of Research Bo Mussmann, Department of Clinical Research/OUH: Email: bo.mussmann@rsyd.dk, Telephone: +45 20 59 88 56

Application deadline

01.11.2026 at 23:59 CET

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Associate Professor is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed associate professor allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated.

The work location will be at Kløvervænget 10, 2nd floor, 5000 Odense C, Denmark.  

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below. 

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply. 

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation. 

Your application must include the following as PDF files:

Please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total).

  • a motivation letter 

  • a detailed CV 

  • degree certificates (including a Ph.D.-diploma)

  • a complete and numbered list of publications 

  • 6 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file. 

  • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • a research plan

  • a detailed description of research experience 

  • an explanation of other qualifications relevant to the position

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application

Incomplete applications regarding the above-mentioned requirements will not be assessed.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark.

title: Purchaser - Global Supply Chain
description:
Do you have experience with technical or project procurement in a larger international company? Would you like to help develop a global supply chain in an international project-driven organization? Then you may be the Purchaser we are looking for.

We are upgrading, servicing, and operating engine- and biomass-based power plants around the world. This creates a continuous need to source goods and services from subcontractors and ensure reliable transport for our customers.

For our Global Supply Chain department, we are looking for an outgoing and internationally minded colleague with commitment, determination, and a positive attitude. The department consists of 20 employees responsible for procurement, warehousing, and transport of goods and services.

BWSC – Ever better energy! 

Join us in our mission of building a world of sustainable energy and make a meaningful impact on the world of power generation and energy conversion.

BWSC is a leading player in the power generation industry, specializing in the service, operations, and maintenance of power plants. We are seeking to always provide Ever Better Energy whether it comes to optimizing a conventional power plant, operating a biomass power plant or constructing new energy facilities. Our commitment to excellence, innovation, and environmental stewardship sets us apart in the industry.

Your responsibilities

  • Support Project Procurement Managers with procurement tasks related to the execution of upgrading, service- and maintenance projects for engine and biomass power plants globally.
  • Obtain quotations from suppliers and place purchase orders within a defined area of responsibility.
  • Participate in broader departmental activities such as category management, supplier relationship development, negotiations, and implementation of supplier agreements.
  • Contribute to identifying and evaluating potential suppliers.
  • Convert purchase requisitions into purchase orders.
  • Maintain and update various data, including supplier data, in the ERP system.
  • Follow up on purchase orders, deliveries and invoice approvals.
  • Assist with various development-oriented Global Supply Chain tasks within BWSC, including work instructions and new workflows.

The work is carried out in close collaboration with other departments in a dynamic and project-oriented organization. A flexible, cooperative, and positive attitude is therefore essential.

Desired Background and Qualifications

  • Experience within procurement, including purchase order placement and follow-up.
  • Completed education as an office assistant and/or relevant higher education qualification.
  • Minimum 3 years of practical experience with technical or project procurement.
  • Strong written and spoken English skills.
  • Good IT skills and experience with ERP systems, preferably Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.
  • Ability to work in a structured manner and meet deadlines.

What do we offer? 

At BWSC we build inspiring careers locally and internationally and give you access to a great network of possibilities. 

We offer you a position with great colleagues and the opportunity to bring your skills into play and grow professionally and personally. As a Purchaser at BWSC, you will receive a competitive starting salary and a strong reward package.

We offer an exciting position in a skilled, collaborative, and project-driven work environment, with opportunities for professional development and growth.

We have a good canteen, fitness facilities, and an active Staff Club that organizes various events and activities. Our HQ is located in Allerød, close to the train station and only a 30-minute ride from central Copenhagen.

Ready for a challenge?

We welcome applications from candidates who are already qualified to participate in a PCI on-call service, as well as experienced PCI operators who are motivated to develop the additional competencies required for on-call duties.The position is available as soon as possible or by mutual agreement.This is an opportunity to work in a busy interventional cardiology environment, contribute to the development of specialised cardiac care and collaborate with highly skilled colleagues across cardiology, cardiac surgery and other disciplines.The positionYour primary clinical responsibilities will be within interventional cardiology, particularly percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI).The position includes participation in the department's PCI on-call service.You will be part of a multidisciplinary team providing specialised care for patients with ischaemic heart disease, including patients requiring urgent and complex coronary interventions.Depending on your experience, qualifications and the department's clinical needs, there may also be opportunities to contribute to the development of other specialised interventional services, including transcatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVI) and chronic total occlusion (CTO) procedures.Alongside your clinical responsibilities, you will contribute to the department's research, teaching and professional development activities, as well as relevant administrative and organisational tasks.What we offer

  • Professional development: Opportunities to further develop your interventional skills and, where appropriate, expand your expertise into complex PCI, TAVI or CTO procedures.
  • A strong multidisciplinary team: Close collaboration with cardiologists across subspecialties, cardiothoracic anaesthetists and cardiac surgeons.

title: Postdoctoral position in computational modeling of visual perception
description:
The Department of Psychology, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a fully funded postdoctoral position in computational modeling of visual perception. The position is available for up to 36 months and is part of a project led by Dr. Gregory Scott Francis that is supported by the SDU Department of Psychology. The starting date is March 15, 2026, or as soon as possible thereafter.

Research environment

The postdoc will be affiliated with the Research Unit of Health and Cognitive Psychology. The position is at the SDU Esbjerg campus but will also involve interaction with staff at the SDU Odense campus. 

Project description

A basic process of the visual system is to monitor the location and characteristics of objects in a scene, and the multiple object tracking (MOT) paradigm has identified many fundamental aspects of this process. With a rich literature of empirical results, this paradigm is ready for theoretical development, which this project intends to pursue using an integrate-and-fire neural network model known as LAMINART. A key aspect of the model is the ability to select/segment visual objects, which may explain how people can (seemingly) effortlessly track multiple objects in a dynamic visual scene. 

The successful candidate will be required to design, program and analyze an integrate-and-fire neural network model of visual perception. Good programming (Python) skills are required along with a good understanding of empirical methods and ways to connect empirical findings with model behavior. The position also involves teaching duties.

The project involves collaboration with Prof. Søren Krogh Andersen, also at SDU.

Qualifications

Ideally, applicants for the position should satisfy the following requirements:

  • PhD level in psychology, cognitive (neuro)science, vision science, or a related field

  • Research experience as evidenced by conference contributions and peer-reviewed journal articles in a field related to the offered position

  • Expertise in visual attention and perception

  • Strong analytical skills, including the ability to design, implement, and analyze complex experiments

  • Be willing and able to teach for the Department of Psychology

  • Prior experience with neural network modeling is a plus

  • Prior experience with cognitive modelling is a plus

  • Good command of statistics

  • Good command of Python (or similar programming languages and a willingness to learn)

  • Very good command of the English language in spoken and written form

  • Some knowledge of the Danish language is a plus

Candidates who are about to obtain these qualifications are also encouraged to apply. 

Contact information

For further information about the position, please contact Dr. Greg Francis, SDU (email: gfrancis@health.sdu.dk; phone: +45 65 50 16 98), or Professor Søren Krogh Andersen (email: skandersen@health.sdu.dk; phone: +45 65 50 49 57)

Application deadline

The application deadline is November 08, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. CET.

Salary and terms of employment

The base salary for a postdoctoral researcher is DKK 36,877.42, with an additional job structure supplement of DKK 5,230.75. This brings the total monthly salary to DKK 42,108.16.

The successful applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Application

Attached files must be in Adobe PDF format.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

  • Three scientific publications (or preprints) considered to be most important for the advertised position (please note that one file per publication must be submitted)

  • Contact details of at least two university supervisors or employers who can provide references

If you experience technical problems, you must contact hcm-support@sdu.dk.

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application. 

Incomplete applications and applications received after the application deadline will not be considered. 

Shortlisting of applications may be used in the initial selection process.

Living and working in Denmark

title: Senior Security Consultant – Incident Response
description:
Do you want to be on the frontline when serious cyber incidents hit? You will lead complex investigations, guide customers through crises, and help shape our incident response services. You will join a highly skilled, collaborative team working with some of the most interesting and challenging cyber cases in the market. 

 

Make a real impact in high‑stakes incidents 

You will be part of a small, expert Incident Response team handling everything from ransomware to targeted attacks across large, complex environments. You will work closely with customers, helping them stay calm, informed and in control during critical situations. You will collaborate with specialists across MDR, Intelligence and Consulting, learn from unique cases, and contribute to the development of tools, methodologies and publications. At CSIS, we invest in your growth with dedicated training time, certifications, and peer learning - in an open, diverse and friendly culture built on “We commit, We care, We succeed together.” 

When you join CSIS, you will get an interesting job in a company and an industry which is growing. You will get interesting challenges, that truly make a difference for our customers, and you will be able to take ownership for your work from start to finish. And you will not least get 130+ fantastic colleagues from all over the world. Besides that, you will get: 

  • Flexible work from home arrangements 

  • A competitive salary and personal benefit package 

  • 5 weeks holiday, plus 5 extra days off each year 

  • Health Insurance, a pension, plus life and disability insurance 

  • Healthy, varied lunches (incl. vegetarian and allergy options) 

  • Home-baked goods, healthy snacks, coffee, tea and sodas in the office

  • Social activities and company events throughout the year

  • Paid mobile phone subscription and home internet 

 

Your new job 

In this client-facing role, you will lead major incident response engagements, support multiple customers, guide junior responders, and help clients strengthen their detection and response capabilities. You will work across diverse environments, industries, and technologies, making adaptability and strong communication essential.  

Your responsibilities will be: 

  • Incident Response & Investigations (Client-Facing) 

  • Lead complex and high-severity incident response engagements for customers across varied infrastructures (on-prem, cloud, hybrid). 

  • Perform advanced forensic analysis across a variety of data sources (disk, memory, network, malware, cloud) and provide clients with clear, actionable findings. 

  • Coordinate response activities with client technical teams, management, and legal/compliance contacts. 

  • Develop accurate incident timelines, attribution assessments (where possible), and root-cause analyses. 

  • Customer Communication & Advisory 

  • Act as a trusted advisor to clients during and after incidents, providing guidance on containment, recovery, and long-term improvements. 

  • Deliver polished, professional technical reports and executive summaries for clients. 

  • Present findings to technical teams as well as to senior leadership and non-technical stakeholders. 

  • Preparedness, Consulting & Continuous Improvement 

  • Assist clients with incident readiness assessments, IR playbook creation, tabletop exercises, and contribute to CSIS’s MDR detection engineering. 

  • Contribute to development of internal incident response methodologies, tooling, and best practices. 

  • Mentor and guide junior team members during engagements and internal training. 

 

About you 

You are an experienced incident responder who remains calm and structured under pressure. You enjoy working closely with customers, translating complex technical issues into clear business language, and you value collaboration and knowledge sharing. You are curious, proactive and driven by making a real difference in the fight against cybercrime. 

You bring most of the following: 

Qualifications & Technical Expertise 

  • Hands-on incident response experience, ideally in a consultancy, MSSP, DFIR, or CSIRT environment. 

  • Proven track record leading multi-client or multi-environment incident investigations. 

  • Deep knowledge of Windows, Linux, and Active Directory security.  

  • Strong knowledge of network protocols and security 

  • Strong experience with SIEM and EDR tools, including detection logic, log correlation, and threat analysis. Hands-on experience with Sentinel/Defender and CrowdStrike a plus. 

  • Advanced digital forensics experience (memory, disk, log, network). 

  • Familiarity with evidence handling, chain-of-custody standards, and forensic reporting. 

  • Strong understanding of attack techniques and threat actor behaviours (MITRE ATT&CK). 

  • Experience in cloud investigations (Azure/AWS/GCP logs, identity, telemetry). 

 

Consultancy-Specific Requirements 

  • Ability to manage multiple parallel client engagements and prioritize effectively. 

  • Excellent client-facing communication: confident, calm, and credible during crises. 

  • Strong written documentation skills for both highly technical and non-technical readers. 

  • Ability to scope engagements, set expectations, and represent the company professionally. 

 

Regulatory & Governance Knowledge 

  • Familiarity with European cybersecurity requirements, especially NIS2, GDPR breach handling, and relevant ISO standards. 

  • Ability to advise clients on improving governance, detection maturity, and incident readiness. 

 

Preferred Skills 

  • Danish speaker – English only can be accomodated. 

  • Threat hunting experience or development of hunting hypotheses. 

  • Scripting/automation (Python, PowerShell, Bash). 

  • Experience in red team/purple team activities or adversary emulation. 

  • Experience providing IR training or running tabletop exercises. 

 

Relevant Certifications  

  • GIAC: GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, GCFE, GPEN, GNFA. 

  • OSCP, CISSP, CISM, or cloud security certs (Azure/AWS/GCP). 

  • Equivalent real-world experience also highly considered and appriciated. 

 

Personal Competencies 

  • Professional, customer-oriented communication style. 

  • Ability to remain composed and decisive under pressure. 

  • Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail. 

  • Leadership qualities and ability to mentor junior responders. 

  • Curiosity and passion for threat research, attacker behaviour, and continuous learning. 

 

This is a 24/7/365 function — flexibility, out-of-hours work, on-call coverage and occasional travel is required. 

 

Other conditions

title: Postdoc in environmental medicine
description:
The translational pharmacology research group at Clinical Pharmacology, Pharmacy and Environmental Medicine (CPPEM), Department of Public Health, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark, invites applications for a fully funded 18 months postdoctoral position. The position is to be filled from January 1st, 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.About the Research Environment

The research areas of CPPEM span from pharmacoepidemiology to clinical studies, and cell-based basic pharmacology and environmental medicine. Collectively, CPPEM has a strong background in exposure to environmental chemicals, pharmacoepidemiology, pharmacogenetics, pharmacokinetics, drug-drug interactions, and therapeutic drug monitoring. Specifically, the translational pharmacology group aims to understand variability in drug toxicity, drug metabolism and drug transport. Examples of this include cell-based models such as induced-pluripotent stem cells, primary human hepatocytes, and clinical studies. The pharmacoepidemiological research group utilizes the world-class Danish registries as well as international data sources to assess pharmacological questions in large populations. The environmental medicine group studies the impact of early life exposures to environmental chemicals. In particular PFAS is a focus area, with studies of the adverse health effects of exposure, biomonitoring and advising national and international authorities. The analytical chemistry laboratory analyzes concentrations of drugs or environmental chemicals in various matrices. 

In the Environmental Medicine group we are looking for a post doc funded by Novo Nordic Foundation and ERC advanced grant. The projects focus on the Odense Child Cohort and study the impact of early life exposures to environmental chemicals. Especially PFAS and their adverse effects on maternal and child health (e.g. the brain, immune, metabolic and reproductive system). In addition, we aim to identify toxicity of short PFAS including trifluoroacetic acid, widely used but considered less toxic due to their short half-life. 

We are seeking a candidate with a PhD in medicine, pharmacology, public health, or a related discipline. Work within environmental medicine is an advance, and epidemiological and statistical skills are essential. Motivation, curiosity, and a strong drive to excel in environmental research are very important. Excellent communication skills in written and spoken English is a requirement. The position includes independent scientific writing, clinical project leading, and supervision of students. You should be interested in contributing both to the scientific armamentarium in our department and to our collegial culture. It is also expected that the post doc contributes to additional fundraising for the projects as well as research collaborations and the continuation of the Odense Child Cohort, and takes on teaching responsibilities within the department. You will, in your daily work, refer to Professor Tina Kold Jensen, but also engage in a very active collaboration with the full research group.

Your qualifications

  • PhD in medicine, pharmacology, public health, or a related discipline.

  • Experience within environmental medicine is considered an advantage

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

  • Ability to work independently with scientific writing and publication

  • Interest in and experience with supervision of students

  • Commitment to contributing to both scientific excellence and a positive collegial culture within the department

  • Interest in establishing and maintaining national and international research collaboration 

Further information

Interviews can be performed online if needed. If you will need to relocate to Denmark for the position, both the University and the research group will provide ample support.

Additional information about the position can be obtained from Tina Kold Jensen (tkjensen@health.sdu.dk; 0045 29464350).Salary and terms of employment

title: PhD Position in Data-driven Critical Raw Material Supply Chain Resilience
description:
Do you want to investigate the resilience of critical raw material supply chains supporting low-carbon and digital technologies? Join us as a PhD student at SDU Life Cycle Engineering, University of Southern Denmark.

The Department of Green Technology at the University of Southern Denmark invites applications for a three-year PhD position in data-driven critical raw material supply chain resilience.

The position will be based at SDU Life Cycle Engineering, Department of Green Technology, Faculty of Engineering, at the SDU Odense campus. The expected starting date is 15 February 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

 

Project Overview

The deployment of low-carbon technologies, electrification and digital infrastructure is increasing global demand for critical raw materials. At the same time, the production and processing of many of these materials are geographically concentrated and exposed to geopolitical, economic, environmental and logistical disruptions.

Understanding how technology development affects material demand, in-use stocks, end-of-life flows and global supply dependencies is therefore important for assessing and strengthening the resilience of critical raw material supply chains.

The PhD position is jointly funded through research projects on critical raw material supply chains and material requirements for Denmark’s climate-neutral transition. The project will be embedded in an interdisciplinary research environment combining environmental systems analysis, supply-chain research and data science.

 

PhD Topic Description

The PhD project will develop modular and data-driven approaches for analysing critical raw material demand, supply-chain dependencies and resilience.

A central methodological contribution will be the development of transparent, reusable and reproducible computational modules for dynamic material flow analysis. The modules will support the integration of technology deployment scenarios, material intensities, product lifetimes, stocks and flows, end-of-life management, recycling, production, trade, facility and ownership data.

The developed approaches will be applied to selected technology systems, including Denmark’s wind-energy infrastructure and the rapidly expanding infrastructure supporting data centres and AI computing. These cases will be analysed within a common methodological framework to examine how infrastructure expansion and technological change influence demand for critical and scarce materials, in-use stocks, future waste flows, recycling potential and global supply-chain dependencies.

The project may also investigate overlapping material requirements and competition for materials across low-carbon and digital technologies. Particular attention may be given to supply concentration, host–by-product dependencies, trade and ownership structures, supply bottlenecks, cascading risks and potential resilience strategies.

Depending on the candidate’s academic background and the specific research questions, the project may include network analysis, geospatial analysis, scenario modelling, uncertainty analysis, machine learning and other AI-supported approaches.

The candidate will build on selected existing models, datasets and research activities in the group and further develop scientifically robust and reusable methods that improve transparency, comparability and reproducibility in material-system research.

The exact research focus and detailed PhD plan will be developed jointly with the successful candidate, taking into account the project objectives, academic background and research interests.

In addition to a PhD dissertation and high-quality scientific publications, the project is expected to produce reusable modelling methods, documented datasets and reproducible computational workflows.

 

PhD Position and Research Environment

As a PhD student, you will conduct independent research under the supervision of an interdisciplinary team, contribute to high-quality scientific publications and participate actively in a collaborative research environment.

You will join SDU Life Cycle Engineering, where research covers industrial ecology, material flow analysis, life cycle assessment, circular economy, resource systems and sustainability transitions.

The project connects expertise in engineering, data science, mathematics, business, supply-chain research and geological resources. The wider research environment includes competences in material flow analysis, critical raw material systems, data mining, network analysis, supply-chain science, finance, investment, ownership structures, geological resources and technology systems.

The position provides opportunities for collaboration across SDU faculties and with external research partners. It may also include participation in international conferences, research visits and collaboration with relevant industrial and public-sector stakeholders.

The PhD programme follows the Danish PhD framework and includes coursework, participation in active research environments, dissemination activities, and teaching or other knowledge-dissemination duties.

 

What We Expect

We are looking for a highly motivated, independent and collaborative candidate with a strong interest in critical raw materials, quantitative modelling, data-driven research and sustainability.

Applicants must hold a relevant master’s degree or equivalent by the time of enrolment. Relevant academic backgrounds may include engineering, industrial ecology, sustainability science, resource management, data science, computer science, applied mathematics, operations research, supply-chain management, geoinformatics, mining or geological sciences, or another relevant natural science or quantitative discipline.

The successful candidate should demonstrate:

  • A solid academic foundation in quantitative analysis, system modelling, data science or related methods. 

  • Experience with programming and data analysis, preferably using Python or a similar programming language. 

  • Experience with data handling, including data cleaning, transformation, integration and exploratory analysis. 

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 

  • The ability to work independently and collaboratively in an interdisciplinary research environment. 

  • Good written and spoken English. 

  • A strong interest in sustainability, critical raw materials and supply-chain resilience. 

Experience in one or more of the following areas will be considered an advantage:

  • Material flow analysis, industrial ecology or material systems modelling. 

  • Network, supply-chain or geospatial analysis. 

  • Scientific computing and reproducible research workflows. 

  • Statistics, machine learning, artificial intelligence, optimisation, uncertainty or scenario analysis. 

  • International trade, production facility or corporate ownership data. 

  • Critical raw materials, wind energy, digital infrastructure or data centres. 

Applicants are not expected to possess expertise in all these areas. Prior experience with material flow analysis is an advantage but is not a requirement. Relevant training will be provided according to the candidate’s background and the needs of the project.

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

The application must be submitted in English through the SDU online recruitment system.

Assessment of applicants will be based on the submitted application material. The application must include:

  • Curriculum Vitae. 

  • A motivated application describing the applicant’s research interests, relevant qualifications and motivation for applying. 

  • Documentation of academic qualifications, including bachelor’s and master’s degree certificates and complete transcripts of grades. 

  • Official English translations of documents not issued in English or Danish. 

  • Two letters of recommendation. 

  • A list of publications and up to two examples of relevant publications, if available. 

  • The completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • The completed TEK form for calculation of grade-point average. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • Official documentation describing the grading system of the awarding university, if the degree was not obtained in Denmark. 

  • Examples of relevant thesis work, software, code repositories or other research outputs, where available. 

  • Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

For administrative questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact our email support.

 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.075 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step. The place of employment is in Odense, Denmark and preferred starting date is February 15, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

 

SDU Life Cycle Engineering

The successful candidate will be affiliated with SDU Life Cycle Engineering at the Department of Green Technology. The research environment conducts interdisciplinary research on the global and systemic interactions between materials, technologies, energy, the environment and society.

The Department of Green Technology is located in Odense, the main campus of the University of Southern Denmark. Odense offers an international research environment and an open Scandinavian working culture.

 

Further Information

Further information about the scientific content of the position is available from:

Wu ChenAssociate ProfessorDepartment of Green TechnologySDU Life Cycle EngineeringUniversity of Southern DenmarkEmail: wuc@igt.sdu.dk

For administrative questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact our email support.

  • Work with data engineers, architects, IT operations, cybersecurity and business users to align solutions with user needs and platform standards. 

What you bring: 

  • Experience developing applications or services in Python and working with SQL-based data. 

  • Experience building APIs, back-end services, automation scripts or data-driven applications. 

  • Experience with data pipelines, integrations or orchestration tools such as Dagster, Airflow or similar. 

  • Strong software engineering habits, including readable code, testing, documentation, version control and maintainable design. 

  • Experience using Git, DevOps, CI/CD pipelines or structured release processes. 

  • Ability to investigate technical issues, identify root causes and implement practical fixes. 

  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, containers or Kubernetes is an advantage. 

  • Experience working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders; knowledge of power systems or the energy sector is a plus, but not required. 

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the listed requirements. Your experience and perspective could be exactly what we are looking for. 

Working Environment 

You will join a diverse and enthusiastic team in our office at Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. Nordic RCC is home to over twenty nationalities, with a healthy gender balance and a wide range of ages and backgrounds. We value curiosity, fellowship, respect, and transparency—and we hope you see yourself in these values. 

We offer flexible work arrangements to support a healthy work-life balance, including the option to work from home part of the time. Due to the collaborative nature of our work, physical presence in the office is expected on most days. 

You will report to the Data and Analytics head of team and collaborate regularly with colleagues from the Nordic RCC and occasionally also from the Nordic TSOs. Travel is limited and will not exceed 15 days per year. 

Application & Security Clearance 

Please apply online in English no later than 5 November 2026. Interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis. 

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.   

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.  

Note that as part of the recruitment process, the candidate must undergo a satisfactory background check. The position is also conditioned upon a national security clearance. Both will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.   Nordic RCC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Nordic Logistics ApS – Moving Employee - Flyttemedarbejder søges
description:
Nordic Logistics ApS is looking for a motivated and responsible moving employee who enjoys physical work, customer contact, and a varied working day.

You will become part of a team handling moving and transportation assignments for both private customers and businesses. It is important to us that the work is carried out efficiently and professionally, while ensuring that our customers have a positive and secure experience from start to finish.

About Nordic Logistics ApS

Nordic Logistics ApS provides a wide range of moving, transportation, and delivery services. These include private moves, commercial relocations, transportation and delivery of furniture and equipment, as well as assignments requiring special handling.

We place great importance on our employees treating both customers and their belongings with respect and care. At the same time, we value good teamwork, flexibility, and efficient completion of daily tasks.

With us, you will become part of a workplace where we help each other and share responsibility for ensuring that every job is completed properly.

Your Responsibilities

  • Moving and transporting furniture, equipment, and other belongings

  • Lifting, carrying, packing, and handling customers’ belongings

  • Loading and unloading moving vehicles

  • Correctly positioning and securing goods during transportation

  • Driving and making deliveries in connection with moving and transportation assignments

  • Communicating with private customers and businesses at the work location

  • Using and maintaining relevant moving equipment

  • Working with colleagues to plan and complete assignments efficiently

  • Other practical tasks related to moving, transportation, and delivery

Who Are We Looking For?

We are looking for an employee who:

  • Holds a valid Category B driving licence

  • Is physically fit and comfortable with physically demanding work

  • Is reliable and punctual

  • Is service-minded and communicates professionally with customers

  • Can work both independently and as part of a team

  • Takes responsibility for their tasks

  • Is flexible regarding different types of assignments and working hours

  • Can stay organised and find practical solutions when challenges arise

  • Represents Nordic Logistics ApS professionally when dealing with customers and business partners

Previous experience in moving, transportation, distribution, warehousing, or logistics is an advantage, but not a requirement. What matters most is that you have the right attitude and are willing to learn.

We Offer

  • Thorough introduction and training in your duties

  • A varied working day with different customers and assignments

  • An active and physically engaging job

  • Good colleagues and a strong focus on teamwork

  • A workplace where responsibility and professionalism are valued

  • The opportunity to take on more responsibility as you gain experience and develop your skills

  • Opportunities for professional and personal development within moving, transportation, and logistics

We are looking for someone who would like to become part of Nordic Logistics ApS and contribute to ensuring that our customers receive a professional and positive experience every time.

Send us your application today.

Dansk

Nordic Logistics ApS søger en engageret og ansvarsbevidst flyttemedarbejder, som trives med fysisk

arbejde, kundekontakt og en hverdag, hvor opgaverne varierer.

Du bliver en del af et team, der løser flytte- og transportopgaver for både private kunder og

virksomheder. For os er det vigtigt, at arbejdet bliver udført effektivt og professionelt, samtidig med at

vores kunder får en god og tryg oplevelse fra start til slut.

Om Nordic Logistics ApS

Nordic Logistics ApS arbejder med forskellige former for flytte-, transport- og leveringsopgaver. Det kan

blandt andet være private flytninger, virksomhedsflytninger, transport og levering af møbler og inventar

samt opgaver, der kræver særlig håndtering.

Vi lægger vægt på, at vores medarbejdere behandler både kunder og deres ejendele med respekt og

omhu. Samtidig prioriterer vi godt samarbejde, fleksibilitet og en effektiv løsning af dagens opgaver.

Hos os bliver du en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og tager fælles ansvar for, at

opgaverne bliver løst ordentligt.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

• Flytning og transport af møbler, inventar og øvrige ejendele

• Løft, bæring, pakning og håndtering af kundernes effekter

• Lastning og aflæsning af flyttebiler

• Korrekt placering og sikring af gods under transport

• Kørsel og levering i forbindelse med flytte- og transportopgaver

• Kontakt med private kunder og virksomheder på arbejdsstedet

• Brug og vedligeholdelse af relevant flytteudstyr

• Samarbejde med kolleger om at planlægge og gennemføre opgaver effektivt

• Andre praktiske opgaver i forbindelse med flytning, transport og levering

Hvem søger vi?

Vi søger en medarbejder, der:

• Har gyldigt kørekort til kategori B

• Er fysisk robust og trives med et arbejde, hvor kroppen bruges aktivt

• Er stabil og kommer til tiden

• Er serviceminded og kommunikerer ordentligt med kunder

• Kan arbejde både selvstændigt og sammen med andre

• Tager ansvar for sine arbejdsopgaver

• Er fleksibel i forhold til forskellige arbejdsopgaver og arbejdstider

• Kan bevare overblikket og finde praktiske løsninger, når der opstår udfordringer

• Repræsenterer Nordic Logistics ApS på en professionel måde over for kunder og

samarbejdspartnere

Tidligere erfaring fra flyttebranchen, transport, distribution, lager eller logistik er en fordel, men ikke et

krav. Det vigtigste er, at du har den rette indstilling og er klar til at lære.

Vi tilbyder

• Grundig introduktion og oplæring i arbejdsopgaverne

• En varieret arbejdsdag med forskellige kunder og opgaver

• Et fysisk og aktivt arbejde

• Gode kolleger og fokus på samarbejde

• En arbejdsplads, hvor ansvarlighed og ordentlighed prioriteres

• Mulighed for at få mere ansvar i takt med erfaring og kompetencer

• Mulighed for faglig og personlig udvikling inden for flytning, transport og logistik

Vi søger en medarbejder, der har lyst til at blive en del af Nordic Logistics ApS og bidrage til, at vores

kunder får en professionel og positiv oplevelse hver gang

Send os gerne din ansøgning allerede i dag.

Muud nõuded: Ootame sind, kui:✅ tead, et haamer ei ole alati vägivald — vahel on see diagnostikavahend; ✅ saad aru, et “klõbin ees vasakul” võib tähendada kõike alates kondist kuni täieliku katastroofini; ✅ ei arva, et piduritoru paikamine teibiga on loominguline lahendus; ✅ oskad autot remontida nii, et see pärast ka päriselt töötab; ✅ sul on töötahe suurem kui soov reede pärastlõunal kella vaadata.

Omalt poolt pakume: Ilustuudio Mariell on üle 11 aasta tegutsenud ja pidevalt arenev ilusalongide kett, mille salongid asuvad Tallinnas ja Tartus. Pakume oma iluteenindajatele kaasaegset, mugavat ja professionaalset töökeskkonda ning mitmeid lisavõimalusi: • Kaunid, hubased ja kaasaegselt sisustatud salongiruumid • Valgusküllased ja avarad tööruumid, sh privaatsed akendega kabinetid • Korralik ventilatsioon ning meeldiv sisekliima • Kõik tööruumidega seotud kommunaalteenused • Mugav online-broneerimissüsteem klientide vastuvõtmiseks ja tööaja planeerimiseks • Turunduslik tugi ning võimalus saada nähtavust meie salongide sotsiaalmeediakanalites • Paindlik võimalus oma tööaega planeerida • Sisustatud ühiskasutatavad ruumid ja klientidele mugavad ootealad • Regulaarne üldruumide koristus ja hooldus • Sõbralik ja toetav kollektiiv • Ühised ettevõtte üritused ja koosviibimised • Pikaajalise kogemusega ettevõtte tugi ning stabiilne ja professionaalne töökeskkond Meie eesmärk on luua iluteenindajatele meeldiv ja hästi toimiv töökeskkond, kus iga spetsialist saab keskenduda oma klientidele ja professionaalsele arengule.

title: Breakfast Cook
description:
Work tasks: Kolm Õde boutique hotel (Pikk 71, Tallinn Old Town) is looking for a breakfast chef to join our team. Our breakfast is a buffet focused on Estonian produce and bread and pastries baked on site, and it is open to guests of the hotel and our apartments as well as to outside visitors. Your main duties: - preparing hot and cold breakfast dishes (egg dishes, porridges, hot sides, salads, cold cuts, smoked fish, etc.); - baking bread, buns and morning pastries on site; - setting up the buffet before opening and keeping it replenished during breakfast; - taking care of the taste, freshness and attractive presentation of the food; - preparing for the next day (doughs, prep work, etc.); - monitoring stock, preparing orders and receiving deliveries; - following food hygiene and self-monitoring (HACCP) requirements, checking temperatures and shelf life; - keeping the kitchen, equipment and tools clean and in order; - working closely with the breakfast server and reception, and helping develop the menu. You are responsible for making sure every morning starts with a tasty, fresh and beautifully presented breakfast for our guests.

We offer: - Work in a unique setting: Kolm Õde boutique hotel is housed in three medieval merchant houses in the heart of Tallinn Old Town.- The opportunity to bring your own ideas to the menu. - Morning working hours – your evenings stay free. - Work uniform. - A small, friendly team and international guests. - A central location that is easy to reach by public transport.

Other requirements: - Previous experience as a cook (experience with breakfast service, hotel kitchens or baking is a big plus). - Valid health certificate (tervisetõend). - Willingness to work early mornings, as well as on Saturdays and Sundays. - Cleanliness, accuracy, independence and good time management. - A desire to cook tasty, beautifully presented food and to help develop our new breakfast concept.

Option to work from home: No

title: Perintäasiantuntija
description: Etsimme Tallinnan toimistollemme perintäasiantuntijaa, joka vastaa Suomessa olevien saatavien päivittäisestä hallinnasta ja perinnästä sekä yhteydenpidosta velallisiin ja yhteistyökumppaneihin suomeksi.Tavoitteenasi on löytää toimivia maksujärjestelyjä ja seurata kunkin perintäasian etenemistä sen ratkaisemiseen asti. Työssä yhdistyvät vahva kielitaito, analyyttinen ajattelu sekä rauhallinen ja määrätietoinen neuvotteluote.**Työtehtäväsi**- Hoidat vastuullesi osoitettua Suomen saatavasalkkua, priorisoit työsi ja huolehdit määräajoista sekä kunkin perintäasian seuraavista vaiheista. - Tarkistat saatavien perusteena olevat asiakirjat, saatavien määrät ja maksusuoritukset sekä selvität, mitä lisätietoja tai asiakirjoja asian käsittelyn jatkaminen edellyttää. - Olet yhteydessä velallisiin suomeksi puhelimitse ja sähköpostitse, selität saatavan sisällön ymmärrettävästi sekä vastaat perintää koskeviin kysymyksiin. - Neuvottelet velkojen maksamisesta, selvität maksuvaikeuksien syitä ja etsit tilanteeseen sopivia ratkaisuja yrityksen antamien valtuuksien puitteissa. - Laadit maksusopimuksia ja maksusuunnitelmia, seuraat niiden toteutumista ja reagoit maksuviiveisiin. - Käsittelet velallisten esittämiä vastaväitteitä ja riitautettuja saatavia, kokoat tarvittavan todistusaineiston ja teet vaativissa tapauksissa yhteistyötä juridisten yhteistyökumppaneidemme kanssa. - Valmistelet oikeudelliseen perintään ja ulosottoon liittyviä asiakirjoja. Pidät vastuualueellasi yhteyttä Suomen tuomioistuimiin ja ulosottoviranomaiseen sekä seuraat asioiden etenemistä. Tarvittaessa osallistut oikeuden istuntoihin. - Pidät perintäjärjestelmän tiedot, sopimukset ja yhteydenpitohistorian ajan tasalla. Käsittelet henkilötietoja huolellisesti ja noudatat salassapito- ja tietosuojavaatimuksia. - Noudatat Suomen perintää koskevia säännöksiä ja hyvää perintätapaa sekä pidät tehtävässä tarvittavan osaamisesi ajan tasalla. - Raportoit esihenkilöllesi perintäasioiden tilanteesta, maksusuorituksista ja haastavista tapauksista sekä teet ehdotuksia toimintatapojen kehittämiseksi. **Odotamme sinulta**- **Erinomaista suullista ja kirjallista suomen kielen taitoa.** Pystyt käymään itsenäisesti neuvotteluja puhelimitse, laatimaan huoliteltua kirjeenvaihtoa sekä ymmärtämään saataviin ja perintämenettelyihin liittyviä asiakirjoja. - **Korkeakoulututkintoa**, mielellään oikeustieteen, talouden tai rahoituksen alalta. - Vähintään kolmen vuoden työkokemusta perinnästä tai siihen läheisesti liittyvistä rahoitus- tai oikeusalan tehtävistä. - Hyviä neuvottelutaitoja ja kykyä toimia rauhallisesti haastavissa tilanteissa. Osaat kuunnella toista osapuolta ja päästä selkeisiin sopimuksiin. - Analyyttistä ajattelua, tarkkuutta ja kykyä organisoida työsi itsenäisesti. Osaat arvioida saataviin liittyviä asiakirjoja ja numerotietoja sekä hoitaa useita perintäasioita samanaikaisesti. - Luotettavuutta, vastuuntuntoa ja hienotunteisuutta henkilötietojen sekä luottamuksellisen tiedon käsittelyssä. - Hyvää MS Office -ohjelmien, myös Excelin, käyttötaitoa sekä valmiutta oppia käyttämään perintäjärjestelmiä ja tietokantoja. - Viron tai englannin kielen taitoa, jolla pystyt hoitamaan päivittäisen työasioihin liittyvän viestinnän tiimin kanssa. Eduksi katsomme- **Ruotsin kielen taidon**, jonka avulla pystyt asioimaan ruotsinkielisten velallisten ja yhteistyökumppaneiden kanssa. - Aiemman kokemuksen saatavien perinnästä Suomessa sekä Suomen perintä- ja ulosottomenettelyjen periaatteiden tuntemuksen. - Kokemuksen riitautettujen saatavien, vaativien asiakastapausten tai laajan saatavasalkun hoitamisesta.

description:
Your main responsibility will be to identify industrial companies whose production and packaging processes could be automated or made more efficient using our equipment. Automated packaging lines and packaging equipment.

Work tasks: Alpina Electronics OÜ is expanding its activities in the field of automated packaging equipment and packaging lines and is looking for a Sales Manager for the Estonian and Finnish markets. Your main responsibility will be to identify industrial companies whose production and packaging processes could be automated or made more efficient using our equipment. Our range of solutions includes: Automated packaging lines and equipment in cooperation with the Polish manufacturer RADPAK. Palletizing equipment, including solutions developed by Alpina Electronics. Thermoforming packaging machines for the food industry, primarily for the Finnish market, supplied by Colimatic. Your Key Responsibilities Identifying potential customers and establishing new business relationships in Estonia and Finland. Visiting customers to understand their production processes and packaging requirements. Presenting suitable packaging equipment and automated packaging solutions. Working closely with equipment manufacturers and technical specialists. Managing sales projects from initial customer contact through to order confirmation. Every manufacturing company and project is different. Your role will be to understand each customer's specific needs and work together with our team and the manufacturers' technical specialists to develop the most suitable solution.

We offer: A competitive base salary combined with performance-based bonuses. An independent and responsible position with a high degree of autonomy. Flexible working arrangements, including the opportunity to work from home. A company car, computer, mobile phone, and all other necessary work equipment. Comprehensive technical support from equipment manufacturers and our own specialists. Manufacturer-provided training and opportunities to attend international trade fairs. The opportunity to contribute to the development of a new business area and influence the range of solutions we offer. The position involves regular customer visits throughout Estonia and Finland. Administrative and office-based tasks can be carried out from a home office. We prefer a full-time employee but are also open to part-time arrangements for the right candidate.

Other requirements: This position is ideal for someone who values independence, enjoys planning their own work, and wants to see a direct connection between their efforts and achievements.

title: Office Assistant
description:
Work tasks: The Role:Dal’s Kitchen is looking for an organised and proactive Office & Food Safety Assistant to support our CEO and daily office operations while helping maintain our food-safety and BRCGS compliance systems. This is a varied position divided between office and executive-assistant duties and food-safety administration and internal auditing. It is suitable for someone who is highly organised, comfortable working with documents and systems, and interested in developing a career within food manufacturing and quality management. Office responsibilities: • Provide general administrative support to the CEO and wider management team. • Manage the CEO’s diary, appointments, meetings and reminders. • Organise meetings, prepare agendas, take minutes and follow up on agreed actions. • Maintain accurate customer, distributor and supplier information in the company CRM. • Prepare and issue customer invoices, credit notes and supporting documentation. • Monitor outstanding invoices and coordinate payment follow-ups. • Conduct research for the CEO, including suppliers, customers, distributors, competitors, logistics providers and new markets. • Prepare reports, presentations, spreadsheets and business correspondence. • Manage office documents, digital filing and confidential company information. • Coordinate travel arrangements, visits and external meetings when required. • Assist with purchasing, quotations and communication with service providers. • Support recruitment administration and employee-document management. • Monitor deadlines and ensure important actions are completed on time. Food-safety responsibilities • Support the implementation and maintenance of the Dal’s Kitchen food-safety and quality-management system. • Help maintain BRCGS, HACCP, food-safety, quality and operational records. • Plan, conduct and document scheduled internal food-safety and BRCGS audits. • Support external BRCGS and customer audits by preparing documentation, evidence and follow-up information. • Maintain the internal audit schedule and monitor completion against deadlines. • Record non-conformities and coordinate corrective and preventive actions with responsible team members. • Follow up corrective actions and verify that they have been completed effectively. • Assist with document control, including procedures, work instructions, forms and records. • Review production, cleaning, temperature, traceability, allergen and hygiene records for completeness. • Support traceability exercises, product-recall tests and other compliance checks. • Assist with supplier approval, specifications, certificates and food-safety documentation. • Monitor staff training records and help organise refresher training. • Report food-safety concerns, overdue actions and compliance risks to the CEO. • Help ensure the site remains prepared for announced and unannounced audits. BRCGS Food Safety Issue 9 provides a framework covering product safety, integrity, legality, quality and operational controls within food manufacturing; official certification is completed by an independent certification body, while this position would conduct internal audits and support certification audits.

We offer: What we offer • A varied position with direct involvement in business operations and food safety. • The opportunity to work closely with the CEO and gain experience across multiple business functions. • Practical exposure to BRCGS, HACCP and food-manufacturing compliance. • Training and development relevant to the position. • The opportunity to grow with Dal’s Kitchen as the company develops. • Salary based on experience and qualifications.

Other requirements: • Väga hea eesti- ning inglise keele oskus, vene keel on eelis, kuid mitte kohustuslik. • Kehtiv B-kategooria juhiluba ja valmisolek regulaarseks reisimiseks Eestis ja välismaal. • Suurepärane suhtlemis-, läbirääkimis- ja esinemisoskus. • Tugev ärisuhete loomise võime ning praktiline, tulemustele orienteeritud tööstiil. • Hea MS Office’i kasutusoskus (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) ning kogemus CRM-i või müügiaruandluse tööriistadega. Positsioon sobib Sulle, kui oled: • Proaktiivne ja iseseisev algataja, kes suudab ise uusi kontakte luua ning oma müügitööd juhtida. • Struktureeritud, usaldusväärne ning valmidus töötama eesmärkide ja KPI-dega. • Kirg toidu vastu ning huvi Aasia köögi trendide vastu Eesti turul. • Meeskonnamängija, kes naudib koostööd kolleegidega müügi-, tootmis- ja turundusvaldkonnas.

title: Autonasentaja
description: **Autonasentaja, määräaikainen - hakusessa Laihialle** M. Laulajan Autokorjaamo Oy, LaihiaM. Laulajan Autokorjaamolla on korjattu autoja Laihialla jo **50 vuoden ajan.** Olemme paikallinen Bosch Car Service -monimerkkikorjaamo, ja nyt etsimme porukkaamme yhtä tekijää lisää määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen.Työsuhde on **perhevapaan sijaisuus,** ja se alkaa 2.11.2026. Työtä on tarjolla vähintään **31.08.2027 saakka.****Mitä työ pitää sisällään?** Työ on monipuolista henkilö- ja pakettiautojen huolto- ja korjaustyötä. Päivittäisiin töihin kuuluu osaamisesi mukaan esimerkiksi määräaikaishuoltoja, jarru- ja alustatöitä, jakopäätöitä sekä vianetsintää ja muita korjaamotöitä.Työskentelemme useiden automerkkien parissa, joten arvostamme kykyä tarttua erilaisiin töihin itsenäisesti.**Mitä odotamme sinulta?** Toivomme sinulta autoalan koulutusta ja/tai tehtävään soveltuvaa aiempaa työkokemusta. Tärkeintä meille on käytännön osaaminen, huolellinen työnjälki ja kyky hoitaa annetut työt itsenäisesti.B-ajokortti on tehtävässä välttämätön.Arvostamme erityisesti kokemusta monimerkkikorjaamosta sekä osaamista esimerkiksi vianetsinnästä, alusta- ja jarrutöistä tai moottorin mekaanisista korjauksista.Jos diagnostiikka, sähkö- ja hybridiautot tai jokin muu osa-alue on erityisesti sinun juttusi, kerro siitä meille.Kaikkea ei tarvitse osata, mutta **odotamme, että sinulla on jo valmiudet työskennellä autonasentajan tehtävissä.****Mitä meiltä sitten saa?** Tarjoamme kokoaikaisen määräaikaisen työn pitkään toimineessa paikallisessa autokorjaamossa, monipuoliset työtehtävät, asianmukaiset työvälineet ja kokeneen työporukan tuen.**Palkka**: **15-20 €/h osaamisen ja kokemuksen mukaan, vähintään sovellettavan työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti.**Kyseessä on ensisijaisesti perhevapaan sijaisuus, mutta **mahdollisesta jatkosta voidaan keskustella tilanteen mukaan.****Lähetä hakemuksesi ja kerro lyhyesti aikaisemmasta kokemuksestasi sekä siitä, millaiset huolto- ja korjaustyöt ovat sinulle tutuimpia.****Hakuaika päättyy 31.10.2026** Käymme hakemuksia läpi ja haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana. **Paikka voidaan täyttää heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.****Täytä hakemus lomakkeen kautta, tai lähetä vapaamuotoinen hakemus ja ansioluettelo liitteenä sähköpostitse: laulaja.korjaamo@anvianet.fi****M. Laulajan Autokorjaamo Oy** 50 vuotta paikallista autokorjaamista Laihialla.

title: Service Instructor
description: **Join Us as a Cleaning Services Instructor – Commercial Cleaning -Lahti, Heinola, Hartola / Päijät-Häme**Are you an experienced cleaning professional interested in a supervisory role where you can support the team in its daily work and ensure high-quality service? At N-Clean, we work responsibly as part of a reliable and supportive team.You will work as a Cleaning Services Instructor under the guidance of a manager, playing a key role in ensuring that cleaning operations at customer sites run smoothly and meet quality standards. You will act as a key link between employees, operational management and customers, supporting your manager. Language skills are important in this role to provide guidance, understand work instructions, ensure safe working practices and manage employment-related matters. We value a diverse workforce in which different linguistic and cultural backgrounds are seen as strengths. - If you are not a Finnish citizen, you must have a valid work permit. - A driving licence and access to your own car, as the work covers a wide geographical area and involves travelling between sites **What we offer:**- A permanent, full-time employment contract 37,5 hours per week. - Working hours on weekdays and weekends, with morning, day and evening shifts - A mutually agreed starting date - Comprehensive onboarding through our renewed Onboarding Path and N-Clean Academy - Fair employment terms, a safe working environment and a strong commitment to employee well-being - Competitive pay in accordance with the collective agreement for employees in the property services sector: €2,235 per month **Equality and responsibility**Every employee matters to us. We treat everyone equally and with respect, and we do not tolerate discrimination in any form. In 2025, we placed third in the competition and also achieved third place in the category recognising Finlands most people-oriented workplace initiative. These recognitions reflect our people-focused recruitment approach, where personal interaction, respect and the candidate experience are at the heart of everything we do.**Apply and join our fantastic team!****Please submit your application as soon as possible, but no later than 3 November 2026**.We only accept applications through the application form on our website.

title: Senior Trader
description: Do you want to join us in building a cleaner tomorrow? Gasum is a Nordic energy expert. We welcome applicants from different backgrounds, such as people of different ages, genders, and those belonging to different language, cultural, or minority groups. title: Asumisen ohjaaja, Vammaispalvelut, Someron asumisyksikkö
description: Asumisen ohjaajana olet mukana rakentamassa 14 asukkaan omannäköistä ja mahdollisimman itsenäistä arkea Someron asumisyksikössä. Saat monipuolisen työn, jossa yhdistyvät ohjaus, hoiva, yhteistyö ja asukkaiden toimintakyvyn tukeminen. Tehtäväsi Someron asumisyksikkö tarjoaa ympärivuorokautista palveluasumista täysi-ikäisille vammaisille, kehitysvammaisille, neurokirjolla oleville tai vastaavia haasteita omaaville henkilöille. Vuonna 2023 valmistuneessa yksikössä asuu 14 asukasta, ja se sijaitsee kävelymatkan päässä Someron palveluista. Asumisen ohjaajana ohjaat ja avustat asukkaita päivittäisissä toiminnoissa sekä tuet heidän hyvinvointiaan, toimintakykyään ja itsemääräämisoikeuttaan. Työsi tavoitteena on mahdollistaa jokaiselle asukkaalle mahdollisimman itsenäinen, mielekäs ja hänen omannäköisensä arki. Vastaat yhdessä muun työryhmän kanssa asukkaiden päivittäisen toiminnan toteutumisesta, aktiivisen arjen mahdollistamisesta sekä hyvästä ja laadukkaasta hoidosta. Työhösi kuuluu ohjaus- ja perushoitotyötä sekä tarvittaessa terveydenhuollon tehtäviä, kuten lääkehoidon toteuttamista ja asukkaiden avustamista itsehoidollisissa tehtävissä. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä asukkaiden omaisten ja läheisten sekä muiden yhteistyötahojen, kuten päiväaikaisen toiminnan kanssa. Tehtäviisi kuuluu lisäksi asukkaiden erilaisten hakemusten ja toteuttamissuunnitelmien laatiminen ja päivittäminen sekä niiden toteutumisen seuranta. Työskentelet osana työryhmää, jossa yhteistyö, toisten arvostaminen ja hyvä työilmapiiri ovat keskeisiä. Tarvittaessa työskentelet myös noin kilometrin päässä sijaitsevan Tuulentuvan asumisyksikön tukena. Työ on kolmivuorotyötä. Mitä tarjoamme sinulle Saat tehdä monipuolista työtä, jossa osaamisellasi on konkreettinen merkitys asukkaiden arjen jatkuvuudelle ja hyvälle elämälle. Työn vaihtelevissa tilanteissa pääset käyttämään omaa ammattitaitoasi ja kehittämään sitä edelleen. Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden osallistua työnantajan järjestämiin koulutuksiin ja vahvistaa osaamistasi työn ohessa. Työskentelet vuonna 2023 valmistuneissa nykyaikaisissa tiloissa, ja voit vaikuttaa työvuoroihisi. Mitä odotamme sinulta Toivomme sinulta aktiivista ja kehittämismyönteistä työotetta sekä halua rakentaa yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa asukkaille hyvää arkea. Tehtävässä tarvitset hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja ihmissuhdetaitoja sekä kykyä ymmärtää ja hyväksyä erilaisuutta. Muutosvalmius ja hyvät tietotekniset taidot tukevat onnistumistasi tehtävässä. Arvostamme perehtyneisyyttä kehitysvammaisalaan ja vammaispalveluihin. Eduksi luetaan sosionomin koulutus sekä voimassa olevat lääkehoidon LOVe-suoritukset. Edellytämme sinulta hyvää suullista ja kirjallista suomen kielen taitoa sekä tyydyttävää suullista ja kirjallista ruotsin kielen taitoa. Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on soveltuva sosiaali- tai terveydenhuoltoalan ammattikorkeakoulututkinto tai vastaava aikaisempi opistoasteen tutkinto tai ammatillinen tutkinto. Hae tehtävään ja liity joukkoomme rakentamaan asukkaille parempaa, heidän omannäköistään arkea. Odotamme hakemustasi!

title: Lähihoitaja, Elontien ryhmäkoti (ruotsinkielinen)
description: Etsimme lähihoitajaa Elontien ruotsinkieliseen ryhmäkotiin Helsinkiin vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Työsuhde alkaa sopimuksen mukaan. Työ on jaksotyötä.Elontie on ryhmäkoti aikuisille vammaisille henkilöille, joiden palveluntarpeet vaihtelevat. Useat asiakkaistamme osallistuvat päivätoimintaan arkipäivisin. Ryhmäkodissa on kahdeksan asuntoa sekä yhteisiä tiloja, kuten keittiö, olohuone ja pyykkitupa. Yksikkö sijaitsee Länsi-Pakilassa rauhallisella pientaloalueella hyvien kulkuyhteyksien varrella.Tarjoamme kodinomaista ja asiakaslähtöistä asumispalvelua, joka perustuu jokaisen asiakkaan omiin toiveisiin ja tarpeisiin. Rakennamme yhdessä turvallista ja virikkeellistä kotiympäristöä, jossa asiakkailla on mahdollisuus mielekkääseen tekemiseen.Lähihoitajana olet tärkeä osa asiakkaidemme arkea. Työ on monipuolista ja sisältää hoitoa ja huolenpitoa, kodinhoidollisia tehtäviä, ulkoilua, retkiä ja yhteisiä hetkiä asiakkaiden kanssa. Teet myös yhteistyötä asiakkaiden läheisten kanssa ja kirjaat asiakastyötä.Työskentelymme lähtökohtana ovat asiakkaan osallisuus, itsemääräämisoikeus ja valinnanvapaus. Arvostamme henkilökohtaista soveltuvuutta ja etsimme sinua, joka olet kiinnostunut työskentelemään vammaisten henkilöiden kanssa ja nautit ihmisten parissa työskentelystä. Olet empaattinen, kohtaat ihmiset arvostavasti ja sinulla on avoin asenne. Arvostamme myös myönteistä työotetta ja herkkyyttä asiakkaiden yksilöllisille tarpeille. Tarjoamme sinulle kattavan perehdytyksen työhön.Saat yhteensä 1 000 euron rekrytointilisän: 500 euroa työsuhteen alussa ja toiset 500 euroa, kun työsuhteesi on jatkunut kuusi kuukautta.Mielenkiintoisen ja monipuolisen työn lisäksi tarjoamme sinulle kattavat koulutus- ja kehittymismahdollisuudet. Kaupungin työntekijänä voit hakea Auroranlinnan vuokra-asuntoa, jossa vuokrataso on markkinahintoja edullisempi ja kaupungin työntekijöiden hakemukset ovat etusijalla.Koska elämä on muutakin kuin työtä, haluamme tukea työn ja vapaa-ajan tasapainoa. Saat käyttöösi Epassi Flex -kokonaisuuden, joka sisältää liikunta-, kulttuuri-, työmatka- ja hyvinvointiedut. Edun arvo voi olla enintään 550 euroa kalenterivuodessa, ja käytettävissä olevan saldon määrä riippuu työsuhteesi kestosta. Lisäksi saat lounasedun. Henkilöstöetuna käytössäsi on myös kaupunkipyöräetu, ja halutessasi voit viettää vapaa-aikaa kaupungin henkilöstön omalla virkistyssaarella.KelpoisuusehdotTehtävän kelpoisuusehtona on lähihoitajan ammatillinen tutkinto. Edellytämme rekisteröitymistä Lupa- ja valvontaviraston (entinen Valvira) terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöiden keskusrekisteriin.Kielitaitovaatimuksena on hyvä ruotsin kielen suullinen ja kirjallinen taito sekä tyydyttävä suomen kielen taito.Valittavan henkilön tulee ennen valintapäätöstä esittää työterveyshuollon arvio edellytyksistään hoitaa tehtävää. Lisäksi edellytetään huumausainetestiä koskevaa todistusta, joka tulee esittää työnantajalle ennen työsuhteen alkamista.Tehtävässä edellytetään tartuntatautilain 48 §:n mukaista rokotussuojaa.Edellytämme LOVE/LOP-lääkehoitoluvan suorittamista hyväksytysti viimeistään koeajan aikana.Tehtävään valittavan, vammaisten henkilöiden kanssa työskentelevän henkilön on esitettävä rikosrekisteriote (laki sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta 741/2023, 28 §).
