title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description: **Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi - nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia - saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun - vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;- toiminta uusiin maihin - markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille - elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiäYhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.Odotan yhteydenottoasi!

title: Pipe Fitter
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit.  Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.   Company: Hayes Mechanical Engineering Ltd.  
Location: Drumminoe West, Ballintubber, Claremorris, Co. Mayo,  F12 E540 
Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent  
Working Hours: 39 hours per week  
Annual Salary: €36,605  
Weekly Salary: €703.94  
Hourly Rate: €18.05  
Proposed Starting Date: 13 November 2026  
Sector: Construction  
Career Level: Experienced (Non-Managerial)

Job Description

Hayes Mechanical Engineering Ltd., based in Drumminoe West, Ballintubber, Claremorris, Co. Mayo, is seeking experienced Pipe Fitters to join its team.

Key Responsibilities

- Assemble, install, repair and maintain pipe systems, drains, gutters, ducts and related fittings for water, gas, drainage, sewerage and HVAC systems.
- Examine blueprints and technical drawings to determine system layouts and the materials required.
- Measure, cut, thread, bend, join, assemble and install pipes, fittings and fixtures.
- Lay clay, concrete or cast-iron pipes in ditches to form sewers, drains or water mains.
- Inspect and test installed systems using pressure gauges, hydrostatic testing and visual inspection methods.
- Lay deep foul and surface water sewer pipes and construct foul and surface water manholes.
- Lay HDPE water mains and carry out water-main welding and testing.
- Operate soldering, welding and rigging equipment and use metal-bending techniques.
- Interpret pneumatic and hydraulic specifications for on-site installations.
- Follow health and safety procedures and ensure installations meet safety and production requirements.

Requirements

- Minimum of 2 years' experience as a Pipe Fitter or in a similar role.
- No formal qualifications are required; additional training will be provided on the job.
- Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and isometric perspectives.
- Knowledge of geometry, pipe measurements and pipeline installation techniques.
- Knowledge of health and safety hazards associated with underground work.
- Experience in laying deep foul and surface water sewer pipes and constructing manholes.
- Experience in laying HDPE water mains, including welding and testing.
- Ability to operate soldering, welding and rigging equipment and apply metal-bending techniques.
- Ability to assemble pipeline components, measure parts and identify flows in pipeline infrastructure.
Salary and Working Conditions

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit an up-to-date CV to info@hayesmecheng.com 

Work Location: Hayes Mechanical Engineering Ltd., Drumminoe West, Ballintubber, Claremorris, Co. Mayo.

Baku GLS Limited is a transport, logistics and warehousing company based at Rosslare Harbour, Co. Wexford. We are recruiting professional HGV Class 1 (CE) drivers for domestic work. Responsibilities include the following:

•	Valid digital tachograph card
•	Clean driving record, with no endorsements, penalty points or accidents.
•	Ability to communicate in English

description:

S&W is seeking a Financial Reporting Assistant to join its Financial Reporting Team in the Dublin office. The Financial Reporting Assistant will work directly with client finance teams, with primary responsibility for assisting with the preparation of monthly and quarterly management accounts and statutory financial statements.


The Financial Reporting Assistant's day-to-day duties and responsibilities will include:

Preparing annual financial statements, including statutory accounts under IFRS and FRS 102 accounting standards, partnership accounts, sole trader accounts and trust accounts for tax purposes.
Assisting with the delivery of financial reporting services to a portfolio of clients within agreed timelines and quality requirements.
Visiting client premises to provide on-site accounting support as required.
Preparing and inputting client transactions into accounting systems.
Preparing monthly and quarterly management accounts for clients.
Preparing monthly, quarterly and annual VAT returns using financial information supplied by clients, as well as preparing Intrastat and VIES sales lists.
Supporting tax services, including tax registrations and deregistrations, company secretarial activities and statutory filings.
Keeping the manager informed of any challenges arising and supporting the development of appropriate solutions.
Ensuring work is completed to an agreed standard and maintaining clear and concise records of work carried out.

As part of the role, the Financial Reporting Assistant will gain experience in other areas of Business Outsourcing Services, including Company Secretarial and taxation reporting, filings with the Companies Registration Office (CRO), and the preparation of corporation tax and VAT returns.

Professional Development

Alongside their work, the successful candidate will have the opportunity to receive professional training and support towards completing an Association of Chartered Certified Accountants (ACCA) or Chartered Accountants Ireland (CAI) qualification.

This will provide the opportunity to develop a strong understanding of the technical aspects of accountancy, taxation and financial reporting, as well as broader financial advisory services.

Qualifications and Experience

The successful candidate should have:

Experience with accounting software packages, including cloud-based systems.
A third-level qualification in Accounting, Finance, Tax, Law, Business or a related discipline.
Be pursuing, or intending to pursue, an ACCA or CAI qualification.
A results-oriented approach with a focus on meeting client expectations.
An understanding of relevant accounting standards.
The ability to monitor costs against budget.
Excellent attention to detail.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Strong organisational and time management skills.
The ability to manage multiple priorities.
The ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.

description:

RBK is seeking a high-performing Transfer Pricing Senior to join our International Tax – Transfer Pricing (TP) Team. Manage end-to-end TP projects, including scoping, benchmarking, documentation (local and master files) and financial/economic analysis.

Manage project budgets, billing and WIP, ensuring timely, high-quality delivery.

Support business development through proposals, client pitches and practice growth.

Requirements

2–4 years' relevant TP experience in a professional services consulting firm.

Strong knowledge of OECD guidelines, the BEPS framework and local TP regulations.

Experience in TP documentation, benchmarking, financial modelling and technical report writing. Exposure to audits, dispute resolution or advisory projects (e.g. supply chain, IP or restructuring) is advantageous.

Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with the ability to interpret complex financial and economic data.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including explaining technical issues to non-technical stakeholders.

Experience with TP databases (e.g. Capital IQ, RoyaltyStat or TP Catalyst) preferred.

Proficiency in MS Office, including Excel, PowerPoint and Word.

Ability to manage multiple projects, meet deadlines and maintain high-quality work.

Teamwork, leadership potential and willingness to coach junior colleagues.

Proactive, detail-oriented and committed to keeping up with international tax and TP developments.

Commercial awareness and understanding of how TP interacts with business strategy, risk and cost structures.

This is a full-time position based in Dublin, with a 37.5-hour working week.

Are you a purpose driven individual who is passionate about making a difference and helping some of society’s most vulnerable children? At Barnardos, we pride ourselves on delivering impactful services that make a difference to the lives of children and families across Ireland. 

We believe that childhood lasts a lifetime. As trauma informed specialists our core purpose is to provide the necessary support for children to overcome childhood adversity, embedding a trauma informed ethos and practice into every service we provide. 

What we can offer you?

As a Programme Assistant we appreciate the value of your time when providing essential support to our services, that’s why we have the necessary support structures and network in place that will allow you to make a real impact on the lives of children across Ireland. We also offer the following:

Barnardos offers a competitive salary – recognising the experience you bring to the role
Generous annual leave entitlements plus discretionary Company days
Employee pension scheme with employer contribution/ Company Sick Pay Scheme
Access to regular trauma informed support, supervision, training and many other professional development opportunities
Tax saver and bike to work schemes in operation
Access to the Employee Assistance/Wellbeing programme for employees and their immediate family members 

What’s the role and service?

In your role as a Programme Assistant, you will provide a safe, child centred environment/experience to children in the context of the service in which you work and appropriate to the role. 

What will my day to day look like?

Provide a safe and appropriate environment for children to participate in the service.
Ensure all children attending the service receive an appropriate level of supervision.
Support children attending to play and interact positively with other children.
Be vigilant for signs of physical, sexual and emotional abuse and neglect and any concerns regarding the welfare of children.
Immediately, bring any concerns to the attention of the child’s Key Worker and the Designated Person and in keeping with Barnardos Child Protection Policy.
Record concerns promptly and accurately.
Gather information statistics and prepare reports as required, including administration of databases as appropriate to the role
Supervise students and volunteers where necessary and to ensure they are aware of all Barnardos policies and compile placement reports as appropriate.
Provide a flexible service on a day-to-day basis within the Early Years’ team.
Experience or understanding of working with vulnerable children and families.  

What experience do I need? 

Experience of working with children for a minimum of 6 months is essential
Relevant voluntary work/work experience may be considered

Do I need a qualification?

Recognised qualification (minimum Level 5 on the QQI/ FETAC) that is approved under the Early Years’ (Pre-school) Regulations.

description: Per una PMI italiana in forte crescita nell'ambito dell' automazione industriale, ricerchiamo la figura di un Sales Manager- Automazione Industriale per guidare l'evoluzione dell'area commerciale da modello 'imprenditoriale' a struttura scalabile e data-driven. Chi è il nostro cliente Realtà che opera tra Automazione industriale e sicurezza di macchine/impianti, con un posizionamento da partner tecnico-consulenziale: integra componenti tecnologiche e un portafoglio di servizi specialistici. La sfida Inserimento con affiancamento iniziale alla Direzione Commerciale, pensato come transizione concreta e rapida verso la guida dell'Area Sales. Cerchiamo una figura già strutturata, capace di portare metodo, KPI, organizzazione e leadership positiva, incidendo direttamente su processi, rete vendita e crescita. E' una persona che non si staccherà dal business, al contrario contribuirà direttamente insieme al team alla crescita e allo sviluppo commerciale dell'azienda. Definire (con la Direzione) obiettivi, priorità e piano commerciale; monitorare avanzamento e scostamenti. Gestire e sviluppare direttamente alcuni clienti strategici. Identificare nuovi segmenti, casi d'uso e soluzioni da introdurre (approccio 'business development'). Promuovere l'uso del CRM e la qualità della pipeline (forecast, next step, copertura). Collaborare con Customer Service, area tecnica/servizi e marketing per garantire continuità end-to-end. Partecipare a fiere, eventi e visite presso clienti e partner. Migliorare processi commerciali (pricing, marginalità, standard offerta, governance sconti). Requisiti = 5 anni in ruoli commerciali B2B, preferibilmente in contesti tecnici/industriali o vendita consulenziale. Utilizzo concreto del CRM per pipeline, attività e monitoraggio risultati. Capacità di contribuire a budget commerciale, lettura KPI e attivazione di azioni correttive. Buona padronanza di pricing, gestione offerte, scontistica e condizioni commerciali. Attenzione a marginalità e redditività, bilanciando crescita e tutela dei margini. Esperienza (anche su piccoli team) in coordinamento e leadership. Inglese buono (scritto e parlato). Disponibilità a trasferte nazionali. Plus: provenienza da automazione industriale, componentistica elettrica/elettronica, sicurezza industriale. Cosa offriamo Ruolo strategico con impatto diretto sulla crescita e sulla trasformazione organizzativa dell'area commerciale. Autonomia decisionale e confronto costante con la Direzione Generale. Inserimento nel board aziendale. Contesto giovane, collaborativo, orientato alla qualità e con cultura 'zero frizioni'. Team interno + rete agenti già attivi, da guidare e sviluppare. Addetti/e Decatizzo Conduzione e monitoraggio di impianti di decatizzo per stabilizzare e rifinire il tessuto (mano, aspetto, dimensioni). Impostazione parametri base (temperatura, pressione/vapore, velocità) secondo ricetta e articolo. Controllo qualità in linea (aspetto, lucentezza, difetti, pieghe) e interventi di primo livello. Follonieri Gestione del processo di follatura: avvio e controllo del ciclo, verifica avanzamento e rispetto delle specifiche di lavorazione. Dosaggio/gestione prodotti e parametri di processo (tempi, temperature, azione meccanica), in collaborazione con il reparto. Verifica risultati (compattazione, peso, mano, resa) e segnalazione anomalie. Addetti/e alla Rama Conduzione di ramose per asciugatura, stabilizzazione e finissaggio del tessuto. Carico/aggancio tessuto, regolazione pinze/catene e settaggio parametri (temperatura, velocità, tiraggi) nel rispetto degli standard. Controllo del tessuto in uscita (altezza, stabilità dimensionale, difetti) e compilazione schede di avanzamento/tracciabilità. Attività comuni Preparazione postazione, cambio articolo/lotti, pulizia e ordine area di lavoro. Rispetto delle procedure di sicurezza, qualità e produzione, con collaborazione continua con capoturno e colleghi. Hai queste competenze e caratteristiche? Esperienza anche breve in finissaggio tessuti (decatizzo, follatura, rama) o reparti affini; valutiamo anche profili da formare con buona manualità. title: tecnico della gestione post vendita
description: Per iniziativa -in ambito Space Economy- supportata da una holding di un investitore attivo nell'energy, con forte focus sulla crescita e lo sviluppo, ricerchiamo un/una: Product & Solution Manager IoT (Satellite Connectivity & Wholesale) Il core del ruolo sarà costruire e creare sinergie commerciali a mercato per l'offerta satellite-enabled della venture. Ossia servizi per il monitoraggio e la tracciabilità di asset e sistemi (IoT/asset tracking/remote monitoring) e una linea di business di connettività satellitare in logica wholesale (offerte rivendibili tramite partner, con livelli di servizio e prezzi chiari). La persona lavorerà a stretto contatto con il founder space per trasformare i bisogni dei clienti in scelte di prodotto e di servizio (copertura, prestazioni attese, priorità di sviluppo). Responsabilità principali - Definire roadmap, posizionamento e 'pacchetti' dei servizi commerciali satellite enabled. - Disegnare e lanciare offerte wholesale: modelli di partnership, livelli di servizio (SLA) e pricing. - Raccogliere esigenze da clienti/partner e tradurle in requisiti operativi e deliverable per i team coinvolti. - Identificare verticali prioritari, sviluppare opportunità commerciali e portare i pilot a contratti ricorrenti. - Selezionare e validare componenti e partner necessari all'erogazione del servizio (dispositivi/terminali e servizi di piattaforma/ground). Requisiti - Esperienza solida in product/solution management, business development o solution selling su servizi satellitari e/o soluzioni IoT abilitate dal satellite. - Capacità di valutare la sostenibilità di un'offerta in termini di copertura, livelli di servizio, vincoli operativi e pricing (approccio concreto, orientato al mercato). - Esperienza o forte attitudine al wholesale: creazione di offerte rivendibili e gestione di ecosistemi partner/reseller. - Familiarità con soluzioni IoT e modelli digitali (piattaforme, subscription, integrazioni). - Esperienza in ambito CubeSat (anche lato prodotto/servizio o go-to-market). - Laurea in Ingegneria (Aerospaziale/TLC/Informatica/Elettronica) o Gestionale Location: Milano, Italia Package: RAL 70-100K€ + benefit Contratto: CCNL Commercio #LI-CP Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. N: 39/4903) e si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive. title: ricercatore universitario/ricercatrice universitaria
description: Grafton LifeScience - Valorizziamo il tuo potenziale nel mondo LifeScience Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati, dedicati a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito R&D, Clinical Research, Regulatory, Quality e Operation per il settore Farmaceutico e Medicale. Lavoriamo per accompagnare ogni persona verso le mansioni e i contesti aziendali più coerenti con le sue competenze e aspettative. Per il Gruppo Sterling, sede di Malta, ricerchiamo un/una QP & QA Manager con solida esperienza in ambito GMP, a supporto del mantenimento e del miglioramento continuo del Sistema Qualità aziendale. Costituisce requisito essenziale il possesso dei requisiti di QP eligibility secondo la normativa vigente applicabile (EU/Malta). Perché Sterling e perché Malta? - Internazionalità che arricchisce: un team di 8 nazionalità diverse, dove ogni giorno si impara a leggere situazioni nuove e a crescere anche sul piano personale. - Crescita reale e visibilità: il talento viene riconosciuto, la fiducia è concreta. Chi dimostra determinazione costruisce un percorso rapido e solido. - Formazione continua: programmi pensati per sviluppare competenze tecniche e soft skills, con HR e management sempre presenti. - Esperienza internazionale e qualità della vita: Malta è vicina a casa ma immersa in un contesto globale. Lavorare qui significa investire su se stessi, in un ambiente dinamico che stimola apertura mentale e capacità di adattamento. Does the thrill of troubleshooting a fault, solving the issue, and watching an entire industrial plant scale back up to speed get you excited? You will be the go-to person to ensure plant efficiency and safety through: Pure Problem Solving: Fast diagnosis and corrective maintenance during breakdowns to get the line running safely again. Experience: Already worked in industrial maintenance? Great. If you are a junior profile but have high motivation and a strong technical base, we still want to meet you and invest in your growth. Hard Skills: Ability to read electrical schematics, knowledge of components (sensors, motors, wiring), and a good grasp of mechanics and pneumatics. Soft Skills: Strong teamwork attitude, flexibility, and a result-oriented mindset. Pluses: Basic English and any specific technical certifications are highly valued. title: Industrial Design Engineer (m/w/d) (Industrie-, Produktdesigner/in)
description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Industrial Design EngineerStellenbeschreibung:Gelebte Werte haben für Sie eine Bedeutung?Lebens-Qualität am Arbeitsplatz ist Ihnen wichtig?HOPPE, europaweit Marktführer in der Entwicklung, Herstellung und Vermarktung von Beschlagsystemen für Türen und Fenster, ist mit rund 2.200 Mitarbeitern international tätig. In dem eigentümergeführten Familien-Unternehmen ist die wertebasierte und sinnorientierte Unternehmensführung die Basis unseres täglichen Arbeitens. Wir machen Wohnkultur im Detail. Seit Jahrzehnten schaffen wir hochwertige Beschlaglösungen für Fenster und Türen, die weltweit eingesetzt werden. Jetzt gehen wir den nächsten Schritt: Wir vergrößern unser Team in der Entwicklung / Konstruktion und suchen dafür zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen:Industrial Design Engineer (m/w/d)Bei uns gestalten Sie die Designsprache zukünftiger HOPPE-Produkte aktiv mit und begleiten neue Produktideen von der ersten Handskizze bis zur Serienreife.Zu Ihren Hauptaufgaben gehören:- Begleitung von Designprojekten als Grundlage für die nachfolgende Konstruktion- Erarbeitung innovativer Designkonzepte mittels Handskizzen, digitaler Zeichnungen und 3D-Formstudien- Weiterentwicklung einer konsistenten Designsprache über verschiedene Produktlinien hinweg- Erstellung fotorealistischer Renderings und Visualisierungen für Produktpräsentationen, Marketingmaßnahmen und Kundenprojekte- Aufbereitung von Designvarianten für interne Entscheidungsvorlagen sowie Kundenpräsentationen- Begleitung von Designprojekten von der ersten Idee über die Konzeptentwicklung bis zur Markteinführung- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Produktmanagement, Vermarktung, Werbung sowie Konstruktion und Vorentwicklung- Frühzeitige Abstimmung zur technischen und fertigungstechnischen Umsetzbarkeit neuer Produktideen- Mitwirkung bei Design-Reviews sowie Bewertung von Prototypen und Vorserienteilen hinsichtlich Designqualität und Anmutung- Aktive Rolle im produktbezogenen Freigabeprozess für gestalterische Fragestellungen- Branchenübergreifende Beobachtung von Designtrends und Adaptierung auf HOPPE- Aktive Mitarbeit in Produktentwicklungs-ProjektenWir freuen uns auf ein Gespräch mit Ihnen, wenn Sie – mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung und aufbauend auf einem Studium im Bereich Industrial Design oder Produktdesign – folgendes mitbringen:Wissen- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Industrial Design, Produktdesign oder vergleichbare Qualifikation- Kenntnisse moderner Design- und Visualisierungsmethoden- Verständnis von Werkstoffen, Oberflächen und Fertigungsprozessen- Grundlegendes technisches Verständnis für die Zusammenarbeit mit Produktentwicklung und FertigungstechnologieWollen- Ausgeprägtes gestalterisches Gespür gepaart mit technischem Verständnis - Hohe Kommunikations- und Moderationsfähigkeit zur Vermittlung zwischen gestalterischen und technischen Anforderungen- Leidenschaft für Gestaltung und Produktentwicklung- Eigenständige, strukturierte und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise- Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit- Bereitschaft zu standortübergreifender Zusammenarbeit und gelegentlichen DienstreisenKönnen- Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Industrial Design, vorzugsweise im Bereich Beschläge- Sicherer Umgang mit Design-, Rendering- und Visualisierungssoftware (z. B. SolidWorks, KeyShot, oder vergleichbare Anwendungen)- Erfahrung in der 3D-Formgestaltung und Entwicklung von Designstudien- Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten- Fähigkeit, gestalterische und technische Anforderungen erfolgreich miteinander zu verbinden- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und fließende EnglischkenntnisseDas erwartet Sie bei HOPPE:- Eine verantwortungsvolle Position mit großem Gestaltungsspielraum- Die Möglichkeit, die zukünftige Designsprache unserer Produkte aktiv mitzugestalten- Mitarbeit an internationalen Entwicklungsprojekten- Arbeiten in einem wirtschaftlich stabilen, werteorientierten Familienunternehmen mit echter Wertschätzung- Offene Kommunikation und ein partnerschaftliches Miteinander- Langfristige Perspektiven und persönliche EntwicklungsmöglichkeitenDie Stelle ist grundsätzlich an einem unserer Standorte in Deutschland (Stadtallendorf, Bromskirchen, Crottendorf) oder auch an unserem Standort in Italien (Schluderns) zu besetzen.Bitte senden Sie Ihre vollständige Bewerbung unter Angabe Ihres frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und Ihrer Einkommensvorstellung an lena.dreyer@hoppe.com (https://mailto:lena.dreyer@hoppe.com)HOPPE AGAm Plausdorfer Tor 1335260 Stadtallendorfwww.hoppe.comHomeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung

description: Per azienda leader nel settore fragranze di lusso, ricerchiamo una risorsa da inserire nel team Regulatory & Product Safety come: REGULATORY - Addetto/a agli Affari Regolatori Di cosa ti occuperai? All'interno del team Regolatorio, la risorsa fornirà supporto operativo e amministrativo per garantire la conformità di prodotti, processi e documentazione ai principali quadri normativi applicabili nei mercati di riferimento, contribuendo a mantenere elevati standard di sicurezza e un time-to-market efficiente. In particolare si occuperà di: Controllo e revisione dei testi delle certificazioni dei nuovi prodotti destinati al mercato worldwide. Supporto all'analisi e monitoraggio di leggi, regolamenti, linee guida e standard di settore. Supporto nelle valutazioni del rischio regolatorio e nella documentazione/esecuzione di azioni correttive. Monitoraggio della conformità lungo l'intero ciclo di vita del prodotto (dallo sviluppo alla post-market surveillance). Organizzazione e mantenimento di documentazione regolatoria, dossier e dichiarazioni di conformità. Interfaccia operativa, sotto supervisione, con laboratori esterni, consulenti regolatori ed enti certificatori. Collaborazione trasversale con team R&D, Qualità e Operations. Supporto nella preparazione e gestione di audit, ispezioni e richieste da parte delle autorità competenti. Supporto alla diffusione interna di linee guida e requisiti regolatori. Hai queste competenze e caratteristiche? Laurea in Chimica o laurea in ambito scientifico (valutabili anche discipline scientifiche/giuridiche affini). Preferibile esperienza fino a 2 anni in Regulatory Affairs, Compliance o Qualità in contesti strutturati (plus: luxury/cosmetica/moda/consumer goods). Conoscenza dei principali temi di product safety, standard di conformità e processi di approvazione. Precisione, attenzione al dettaglio e approccio metodico alla gestione di dati e documentazione. Buone capacità organizzative, relazionali e comunicative. Padronanza di MS Office e sistemi di gestione documentale elettronica. Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese (necessaria per la comprensione e gestione di testi tecnici). title: COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2) (Kapitän/in)
description: The MV Louise Michel is a former French Navy boat we’ve customized to perform search and rescue. Measuring 30 meters in length and capable of up to 28 knots, she was bought with proceeds from the sale of Banksy artwork - who then decorated her with a fire extinguisher. She is operated and crewed by a team of international activist rescue professionals.- Main responsibilities: handling the ship, overview, control of the vessel and crew safety- You have the final responsibility for all nautical and technical decisions concerning the operation as well as related crew intructions- responsible for the ship’s administration (bunkering, crew-lists, customs clearance, detailed operational documentation, daily reports and statistics).- shiphandling in harbour and during SAR-operations. Together with the officers you will familiarise the crew on the bridge and introduce them to the watch system.- You will provide the crew with trainings and drills in emergency situations (e.g. what to do in case of fire, POB, ingress of water, unwanted visitors).- You will work closely with the Head of operations during SAR operations, double checking all decisions against crew and ship safety as well as stability (and guest safety in case of guest already on board).- You will work closely with the officers and chief engineerRequired:-EC/EEA-Citizen Passport valid for at least 6 months-Covid certificate with EU QR code needed, latest vaccine or recovery certificate no older than 180 days or a booster (other nationalities can be transferred to EU certificate)-Seafarer Medical Certificate (fitness for sea service) according STCW I/9 (Deck Service)-Proficiency in basic safety (STCW VI/1)-Proficiency in survival craft and rescue boats other than fast rescue boats (STCW VI/2-1)-Proficiency in Advanced fire fighting (STCW VI/3)-Medical First Aid (STCW VI/4-1)-Medical Care (STCW VI/4-2)-GMDSS Radio Operator GOC (STCW IV/2)-COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2)-German Endorsement for COC Master Course-Seafarer's book or the German Seafarer's ID Card-Excellent and fluent English language skills-Confidence in decision-making, strong team leading skills, and the ability to cooperate well within a team of volunteers with various levels of nautical experience and skill.Desired:- Previous SAR experience- Italian, French and Arabic language skills

title: Service Engineer
description:
Voor een internationale speler binnen de chemische industrie zoeken we een Technical Service Engineer voor de Belgische markt. Het betreft een vaste functie bij onze opdrachtgever. Je werkt volledig remote en rapporteert aan het team in Nederland. Eén keer per maand ben je aanwezig op het Nederlandse kantoor voor teamoverleg.

Je maakt deel uit van een klein team van drie collega’s in België. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met een ervaren Account Manager die als mentor zal optreden. Daarnaast stem je regelmatig af met technische experten en het laboratoriumteam in Nederland, wat grotendeels vanop afstand gebeurt. Als Technical Service Engineer ben je de technische partner voor klanten in België. Je ondersteunt hen bij het optimaliseren van processen, adviseert over technische oplossingen en bouwt duurzame relaties uit. Op termijn krijg je de mogelijkheid om door te groeien naar een rol als Account Manager.

Function

  • Bezoeken van klanten en ondersteunen bij technische vraagstukken.
  • Adviseren over procesverbeteringen en technische oplossingen.
  • Testen, implementeren en opvolgen van oplossingen bij klanten.
  • Monitoren en optimaliseren van bestaande processen.
  • Opbouwen en onderhouden van langdurige klantrelaties.
  • Samenwerken met commerciële en technische collega’s in België en Nederland.
  • Signaleren van marktontwikkelingen en opportuniteiten.
  • Bachelor of master in Chemie, Chemische Technologie, Procestechnologie of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
  • Enkele jaren relevante ervaring binnen de chemische sector.
  • Affiniteit met chemische processen en industriële productieomgevingen.
  • Sterke combinatie van technische expertise en commerciële/sociale vaardigheden.
  • Zelfstandig, proactief en zelfsturend.
  • Klantgericht, communicatief sterk en oplossingsgericht.
  • Goede kennis van het Nederlands en Engels. Frans is een plus.

Working with universities, research institutes, and industrial partners across Europe, you will help develop high-performance, multifunctional materials and surfaces for applications ranging from fluid-dynamic surfaces to textile finishing. Your mission and contributions are:• To conduct applied research work on atmospheric pressure plasma deposition of functional materials.• To optimise atmospheric-pressure plasma deposition processes for functional coatings (e.g. barrier, hydrophobic, antimicrobial, or protective layers) on textured, porous, or flexible substrates.• To scale up and transfer processes from laboratory to pilot level, including continuous (e.g. roll-to-roll) configurations, in close collaboration with industrial partners.• To characterize the deposited materials using various surface analytical techniques, together with functional performance testing adapted to project requirements.• To contribute to the preparation of scientific reports, publications, and presentations.Is Your profile described below? description: Description de tâches:SD-25168 - PHD POSITION IN ADVANCED CORRELATIVE MICROSCOPY AND ISOTOPIC IMAGING FOR NEXT-GENERATION LI-ION BATTERIES Fixed term contract | Belvaux | up to 48 months (14 months initial contract) Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us. The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies, LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact. How will you contribute? The PhD project will focus on the development of advanced correlative microscopy and isotopic imaging methodologies to investigate lithium transport and interfacial processes in next-generation silicon-based Li-ion battery electrodes.The candidate will contribute to the development of high-throughput FIB-SIMS workflows, building on methodologies previously developed at LIST, and will adapt innovative sample preparation strategies to preserve the complex porous structure and fragile Solid Electrolyte Interphase (SEI).A major objective of the PhD will be to develop and optimize advanced characterization approaches, including cryogenic sample preparation and analysis, protective capping and lift-out strategies, and automated high-resolution isotopic mapping.The candidate will also contribute to the development of automated acquisition and data-processing workflows, enabling large-area, statistically representative 2D and 3D maps of lithium isotopes and SEI-related species.These datasets will provide quantitative information on lithium distribution and transport at the nanoscale and serve as inputs for predictive modelling of battery behaviour.The doctoral researcher will work closely with experienced scientists, engineers and international project partners in a highly interdisciplinary environment combining battery science, nano-analytics, instrumentation, software development and data science.The position offers the opportunity to gain expertise in cutting-edge FIB-SIMS and correlative microscopy, electrochemical materials characterization, isotopic tracing, automated data analysis and scientific communication.The candidate will take an active role in designing and performing experiments, developing analytical methodologies, interpreting results, publishing scientific findings and presenting the work at international conferences. Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now! description: LA CHAMBRE DE COMMERCE SE PROPOSE D'ENGAGER POUR LA HOUSE OF SUSTAINABILITY : Decarbonisation & Energy Transition Advisorà temps plein et à durée indéterminée La Chambre de Commerce est l'institution phare des entreprises et de l'économie du Luxembourg, regroupant l'ensemble des entreprises luxembourgeoises exerçant des activités industrielles, commerciales, financier/ières, de services et émanant du secteur de l'Horeca. Elle représente aujourd'hui quelques . entreprises, intervenant à raison de % dans le PIB luxembourgeois et occupant % du total de l'emploi salarié.La promotion de l'entrepreneuriat et de l'esprit d'entreprise, le soutien au développement et à l'internationalisation des entreprises, le développement de la formation professionnelle initiale et continue ou encore la promotion d'un cadre législatif et réglementaire propice au développement économique constituent quelques missions légales clés de cet établissement public au service des entreprises et de l'économie. La House of Sustainability est une initiative de la Chambre de Commerce visant à soutenir et à faciliter la transition durable des entreprises luxembourgeoises. Elle informe, sensibilise et accompagne les entreprises sur les enjeux de durabilité au moyen d'une offre de services dédiée. Celle-ci comprend notamment des événements, des ressources, des formations, des programmes d'accompagnement et des aides financier/ières. Au-delà de sa propre offre, la House of Sustainability constitue également un premier point de contact sur les questions de durabilité et oriente les entreprises vers les initiatives et les acteurs pertinents de l'écosystème. Au sein de la House of Sustainability de la Chambre de Commerce, le Decarbonisation & Energy Transition Advisor accompagne les entreprises ressortissant/antes dans leurs démarches de décarbonation et de transition énergétique, dans le cadre du programme Klimapakt fir Betriber (KPB).En tant que point de contact privilégié, il/elle sensibilise les entreprises aux enjeux et opportunités liés à la décarbonation et la transition énergétique. Le rôle consiste ainsi à convaincre les entreprises ressortissant/antes de la Chambre de Commerce des opportunités offertes par la transition énergétique et la décarbonation, afin de réduire leurs coûts d'exploitation, de renforcer leur compétitivité et leur résilience, tout en diminuant leur dépendance aux énergies fossiles. description: Description:RESEARCH ENGINEER IN ATMOSPHERIC PRESSURE PLASMA DEPOSITION OF FUNCTIONAL COATINGSFixed term contract | Belval | 24 MonthsAre you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join usThe Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. Working with universities, research institutes, and industrial partners across Europe, you will help develop high-performance, multifunctional materials and surfaces for applications ranging from fluid-dynamic surfaces to textile finishing. Your mission and contributions are:• To conduct applied research work on atmospheric pressure plasma deposition of functional materials.• To optimise atmospheric-pressure plasma deposition processes for functional coatings (e.g. barrier, hydrophobic, antimicrobial, or protective layers) on textured, porous, or flexible substrates.• To scale up and transfer processes from laboratory to pilot level, including continuous (e.g. roll-to-roll) configurations, in close collaboration with industrial partners.• To characterize the deposited materials using various surface analytical techniques, together with functional performance testing adapted to project requirements.• To contribute to the preparation of scientific reports, publications, and presentations.Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!EducationA PhD (or equivalent experience) in materials science, plasma science, chemistry, or on textile science and technology, with a strong focus on finishing/functionalization.Experience and skills• 3 to 5 years of proven experience in an international R&D environment (public or private sector).• Demonstrated experience in atmospheric-pressure plasma deposition (e.g. DBD, plasma jets, plasma-enhanced CVD, plasma polymerisation, aerosol-assisted plasma deposition), including reactor setup, pilot or semi-pilot operation, and process implementation for functional thin films and coatings.• Ability to evaluate and optimise key process parameters, including power and frequency, gas composition and flow, precursor delivery (vapour or aerosol), electrode gap, and substrate temperature and speed.• Proven autonomy in surface characterization techniques, such as SEM, AFM, XPS, FTIR, ellipsometry, contact angle measurements, and functional performance testing.• Strong awareness of laboratory and process safety, including high-voltage and RF equipment, handling reactive precursors, and management of by-products.• You are committed to a strong data security and confidentiality, with experience in handling sensitive information according to consortium agreements.• You have ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced international consortium environment. Language skills• Fluency in English, both oral and written. • Other relevant languages are an asset. It currently operates in retail, private and corporate banking, as well as on major capital markets. Employing more than 2 000 people, BIL is present in the financial hotspots that are Luxembourg, Switzerland, and China.
