title: Software Test Engineer
description: About Us Ever wondered what powers the products people rely on every day? Chances are, we've helped build it.Our software and development tools help build products used in cars, hospitals, factories, homes, and industries around the world. We help engineers solve complex challenges and create technology people can depend on. Rooted in Nordic values and trusted by innovators worldwide, we combine deep technical expertise with a culture of curiosity, craftsmanship, and collaboration. With decades of engineering experience and a shared passion for technical excellence, we're helping shape the future of software and embedded development. We take pride in building tools for people who build the world around us.IAR is part of Qt Group, operating as an independent business focused on embedded software development. We provide software development tools that help engineers develop, debug, test, and secure embedded software for products across automotive, industrial automation, medical technology, and other industries. About the RoleAs a Software Test Engineer, your primary focus will be on test execution and test automation. You will design, implement, and evolve testing strategies that ensure product quality from early development to release. You will work closely with development teams to improve testability, identify risks early, and build confidence in every release through effective automation and integration testing.You will act as a quality advocate across teams, supporting engineers with best practices, tools, and frameworks while helping shift testing efforts toward scalable, automated solutions.What You'll Do    Perform and contribute to release testing, verifying end‑to‑end functionality and validating that releases meet agreed‑upon quality criteria.    Design, develop, and execute high‑quality test plans and test cases for both manual and automated testing, with strong emphasis on testing across components and services.    Build, maintain, and continuously improve test automation frameworks and contribute to automated testing within CI/CD pipelines.    Supporting development teams in adopting effective testing strategies, including unit and integration testing.    Identifying risks, defects, and quality gaps early, and communicating them clearly to stakeholders.    Collaborating in planning, design, and requirement discussions to ensure quality is built into solutions from the start.    Improving test frameworks, documentation, and processes to enhance long-term efficiency and reliability.    Supporting troubleshooting, debugging, and incident analysis across development and release cycles.What You Bring to the TableYou are a collaborative and quality-driven engineer who works closely with developers and stakeholders to improve outcomes, not just processes. You proactively communicate, share knowledge, and help teams adopt practical and effective testing approaches.You take a holistic view of quality, focusing on integration, system behavior, and real-world usage rather than isolated test cases. You are pragmatic, continuously improving systems step by step instead of waiting for perfect solutions.    Experience in software testing with a strong focus on integration testing and automation.    Hands-on experience with Python and/or Ruby for test automation.    Familiarity with test frameworks such as Pytest, Squish, or similar tools.    Experience working with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins) and development tools like GitLab, Jira, or Artifactory.    Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to identify risks and dependencies early.    Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering teams and influence quality practices.    Conversational Swedish and fluency in English, both spoken and written.Bonus Points For....    Experience testing C++ software and understanding of C++ code.    Familiarity with embedded systems, compilers, or tool chains.    Experience with build systems such as CMake.Build What Matters. Grow Where It Matters. We believe work should support your life, not the other way around. That's why our benefits are designed to be flexible, inclusive, and meaningful across every stage of your journey. From wellbeing and growth to celebrating life's big (and small) moments, we invest in what matters to you, wherever you are.     Flexibility You Can Count On     We offer hybrid working options and flexible hours, empowering you to balance your personal life and professional goals because life outside of work matters, too.     Meaningful Wellbeing Support     From mental health resources to physical wellness programs, we provide practical, accessible support tailored to local needs.     Opportunities to Grow     Whether through hands-on learning, mentorship, or international collaboration, we invest in your development so your career can grow in the direction you choose.     Inclusive by Design     You'll join a team that values different perspectives, encourages collaboration, and creates space for everyone to contribute and succeed.     Rewarding Your Impact     Our compensation and benefits packages are competitive, regularly reviewed, and locally relevant, ensuring your contribution is recognized wherever you are. Bring Your Whole Self The best ideas come from people with different experiences, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels respected, supported, and able to do their best work. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and identities and provide equal opportunities for all. Our technology may be what we're known for, but it's our people who make the difference. We'd love to learn more about you. Tell us about your skills and experience, but just as importantly, tell us what motivates you and what kind of impact you want to make.

title: Application & Physics Specialist
description: RaySearch develops innovative software solutions to improve cancer care. Over 1200 clinics in more than 54 countries use RaySearch software to improve treatments and quality of life for patients. RaySearch was founded in 2000 and is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. The headquarters is located in Stockholm, with subsidiaries in the US, Europe, Asia and Australia &amp; New Zealand. Today we are more than 485 employees with a common vision of improving cancer care with innovative software. Our great staff is crucial for our success and we offer a fantastic working environment in modern offices, flexibility and good opportunities for development. We believe in equal opportunities, value diversity and work actively to prevent discrimination.Clinical experience as a medical physicist, dosimetrist, radiation therapist or treatment planner and ready for a new challenge? Or just graduated and looking for your first job to use your new skills? Join RaySearch in Stockholm and help us help clinics improve their treatments with innovative medical technology software!Location: Stockholm, SwedenWe prefer a candidate who can work from our headquarters in Stockholm. For a strong candidate we are however willing to consider work from a home office in Denmark, Norway or Finland.About the positionAs an Application & Physics Specialist you will join a diverse and dedicated specialist group with clinical experience from different countries. The group is part of the global service organization responsible for the promotion, deployment and support of our products as well as the education of our customers.  The emphasis of the position will be on working with potential and current customers in the Nordic region to introduce them to our treatment planning system RayStation through demonstrations and training. This is done on client sites, in our training center in Stockholm, by webinars and at conferences. Another core task is creating and maintaining training materials on various formats such as interactive e-learning courses, PPT presentations and videos for students.For a candidate with medical physics competence, you will also play an important role in assisting our customers during the beam commissioning process, for example by creating beam models and advising them on measurement requirements.Up to 25% travel is required, primarily within the Nordic region and Europe.Your main tasks    Planning, performing and documenting product trainings for customers and distributors    Demonstrating RaySearch products at trade shows and onsite for prospective customers    Develop and maintain training materials    Answering tenders and explain product functionality    Collaborating with our development department through exploratory testing of new product versions     Assisting and guiding customers during the beam commissioning processYour introductionWhen starting in this position, you will get a mentor and a solid introduction to our products and ways of working following a formal certification program. You will gradually take more responsibility and start working independently.Your profileWe believe that our new Application & Physics Specialist has a great sense for service and customer support and a strong motivation to work in a highly dynamic environment. You are a social and positive person with excellent interpersonal and communication skills and enjoy presenting and teaching to bigger and smaller crowds. Further, you can quickly adapt to new contexts and appreciate various environments as well as a variety of different tasks.  You enjoy facing new challenges and solving complex problems, both independently and in collaboration with your team members. You are comfortable with working proactively, taking initiatives and have the ability to prioritize your work and adapt to sudden changes. Experience & skills    Proficiency in spoken and written English    Swedish/Danish/Norwegian/Finnish skills are meriting    BSc or MSc degree in medical physics/dosimetry/RTT or equivalent, medical physics is meriting    Clinical experience in radiotherapy, especially proton therapy or brachytherapy, is meriting    Ability to travel up to 25%     Medical device industry experience is meritingOur cultureCulture at RaySearch is the driving force behind our organization, where everything we do is driven by a shared passion for innovation and the fight against cancer. Our dedication is reflected in our ability to deliver exceptional results, pay close attention to detail, and consistently go the extra mile. Our employees stand out as experts in their field, driven by a relentless focus on solving problems - no matter how complex. At RaySearch, we take pride in leading the way in cancer treatment, leveraging cutting-edge technology to develop innovative solutions that make a real difference in patient care.Our offerAt RaySearch, we offer a diverse and inclusive work environment, fostering openness, sincerity, and collaboration. Located in Hagastaden, Stockholm's Life Science Hub, our modern and creative workspace includes an in-house gym, yoga, and social activities like ping pong, table football, and regular after-work events. Our bistro serves a fantastic lunch buffet, and we offer morning- and afternoon-fika every day. Our rooftop terrace also provides a stunning 360-degree view of Stockholm, enhancing the work experience. All of this comes attached with a competitive compensation and benefits package.ApplicationPlease apply through the application form below. The selection and interviewing process will be ongoing. title: Finance Systems Business Analyst - Corporate Finance & Tagetik
description: About the jobAs our Finance Systems Business Analyst, you will be the functional expert for CCH Tagetik within Corporate Finance. You will understand how Finance processes should work and ensure that Tagetik supports them effectively. Working between Finance, IT and the platform, you will translate business needs into practical system solutions, support and train users, and help improve the platform over time.  CCH Tagetik is Alfa Laval's strategic Corporate Performance Management platform for Corporate Finance. It supports how financial information is planned, reported, controlled and governed across the Group.  This is part of Alfa Laval's broader Financial Transformation Journey, where we are building a modern and efficient environment for our financial processes. Your scope spans the full breadth of the Corporate Finance capability area at a group wide level, including how financial information is planned, reported, controlled and governed, as well as how Treasury and Tax are supported in our systems. You play a central role in making sure the platform truly serves these needs.  Key responsibilities     Act as system owner and subject matter expert for our Corporate Performance Management platform (CCH Tagetik)     Act as a trusted advisor to business stakeholders, understanding their needs and advising on how this can and should work in the platform, including which data flows and setups are appropriate     Own the functional Finance perspective in discussions with the Product Owner, Solution Architect, IT teams and implementation partners.     Provide Finance expertise to the Solution Architect on business rules, data requirements and how processes should work, while ensuring that proposed solutions fit the overall architecture.     Manage master data, system controls, and user access     Act as the first point of contact for users, providing training, guidance and ongoing support     Stay close to the platform's roadmap and new features, keeping ahead of changes and guiding others through them     Perform advanced support, maintenance and administration within your area of expertise     Contribute to project activities and smaller deliveries, depending on experience, in collaboration with the Product Owner and Solution Architect     Analyze, configure, test and deploy changes to optimize existing solutions, meeting agreed time, cost and quality requirements   Who are youYou are curious, structured and comfortable working between Finance and IT. You build trust by listening carefully to stakeholders, asking the right questions and making complex topics easier to understand. You enjoy turning business needs into practical solutions and are confident challenging unclear requirements in a constructive way. You are collaborative rather than directive, and you bring people together through open dialogue, clear explanations and sound judgement. You are also patient and service-minded when supporting users, while being proactive enough to identify improvements and take ownership of issues through to resolution. What you knowTo be successful in this role, you combine a strong understanding of Corporate Finance with an interest in business systems and digital transformation. We believe our ideal candidate has:     Solid understanding of Corporate Finance processes, rules and terminology at a group-wide level.     Knowledge of Treasury and Tax processes and how they may be supported through finance systems.     Experience translating business needs and financial logic into functional system requirements.     Ability to explain complex financial concepts to non-expert technical and IT teams, and translate technical concepts into clear business language.     Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.     Experience with CCH Tagetik is an advantage, but not a requirement. The most important qualities are your Finance knowledge, motivation and ability to build deep platform expertise quickly.     Experience from an international environment or a larger global company is beneficial, as is familiarity with complex, group-wide processes.     Relevant university degree in Finance, Business Administration, Information Systems or a related field. title: Analysis Engineer to Beyond Gravity Linköping
description: 🚀 Challenge the Impossible​ ​ About Beyond GravityBeyond Gravity, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, is the first space company to combine a startup mindset, agility, speed and innovation with decades of experience and proven quality. Approximately 1800 employees at 12 locations in six countries (Switzerland, Sweden, Austria, USA, Finland and Portugal) develop and manufacture products for satellites and launch vehicles with the goal of advancing humankind and enabling the exploration of the world and beyond. Beyond Gravity is the preferred supplier of structures for all types of launch vehicles and a leading provider of selected satellite products and constellation solutions in the New Space sector. In 2024, the company generated a revenue of around CHF 359 million. More information at: www.beyondgravity.com Your crewYou will become part of the Dispenser organization. Today, we are a team of approximately 60 people with diverse backgrounds and areas of expertise, such as Design Engineer, System Engineer, Analysis Engineer, and Verification and Test Engineer. Together, we form a strong team with a great passion for technology – we are responsible for the development, design, structural analysis, and testing of our products. Alongside us, you will help transform and refine our ways of working within an innovative industry full of endless improvement opportunities. We are currently in an exciting transformation where we are growing a Tech Hub in Portugal and you will become part of a dedicated team with the ambition to revolutionize space! Your mission •  Perform structural analyses by independently conducting static strength and dynamic simulations with minimal supervision, applying relevant industry standards and engineering best practices.•  Execute engineering calculations using hand methods to size components and validate or cross-check numerical analysis results.•  Conduct advanced CAE simulations by performing finite element analysis (FEA) on complex systems and multi-physics problems, defining effective modeling strategies, and balancing accuracy with computational efficiency.•  Develop and enhance analysis tools by designing automation frameworks and leading the creation of custom solutions for model setup, simulation execution, and result interpretation.•  Collaborate across disciplines by integrating inputs from various engineering domains into structural analyses and working closely with subject matter experts to ensure consistency and accuracy.•  Support testing activities by contributing to test planning, predicting structural behavior, assisting with sensor placement and load case definition, and correlating simulation results with physical test data.•  Provide production and quality support by participating in Non-Conformance Review Boards (NRBs), proposing technical solutions, supporting root cause analysis, and contributing to First Article Inspections (FAI) and operator training when required.•  Prepare technical documentation and reports by independently producing high-quality deliverables, maintaining traceability between requirements and outputs, and clearly communicating project status to stakeholders.•  Drive problem-solving and decision-making by applying structured methodologies, evaluating evidence, identifying biases, and making sound technical decisions while considering cost, schedule, and business constraints.•  Contribute to innovation and R&D by gathering and interpreting data, participating in brainstorming sessions, applying research methodologies, and leveraging lessons learned to improve engineering solutions.•  Support business development activities by contributing technical inputs to bids, proposals, Engineering Change Proposals (ECPs), and Contract Change Notices (CCNs).•  Mentor and support team development by assisting in training material creation, coaching junior engineers and interns, and supporting onboarding activities.•  Manage tasks and project progress by tracking budgets and milestones, identifying risks and blockers, and ensuring efficient allocation of resources.•  Support product development and lifecycle activities by maintaining knowledge of the product portfolio, interacting with hardware, and contributing to continuous product improvement initiatives. Your story Must’s:•  B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Aerospace, Mechanical or other engineering, or equivalent experience.•  3+ years of analysis experience in aerospace or equivalent industry.•  Proficiency in FEA tools and standard analysis workflows (MSC Nastran, Hyperworks, NX, Abaqus).•  Experience in linear static and dynamic analysis.•  Experience in writing technical documentation.•  Basic scripting (Python/VBA) for analysis automation. Nice to have’s:•  Knowledge of detailed stress analysis using aerospace methodologies.•  Knowledge of mechanical layout of aerospace structures and materials.•  Familiarity with nonlinear analysis. Why Beyond Gravity •  To work in a growing high technology company with career opportunities within the site or internationally.•  You will be a part of an engaged team with the ambition to innovate space!•  We offer a hybrid work situation, high flexibility and autonomy, and a great team to develop and have fun with!•  Overtime and travel compensation and you have the right to 25 days of vacation/year.•  Wellness allowance of 3000 SEK/year via the benefits portal Epassi.•  Lunch subsidy via Edenred, which means you are offered a card loaded with 1520 SEK/month 🌌Are you ready for lift-off?​Our core values - Passionate, Together, and Curious - transform challenges into opportunities. Embark on a journey to transcend the ordinary with us. Propel your career to new heights by applying before 30/06/2026. We‘re actively reviewing candidates and will promptly select the ideal fit for our team.​​Beyond Gravity is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected categories.​

title: Senior Data Center Technician
description: OverviewAs a Senior Data Center Technician (SDCT) at Microsoft, you will support the deployment, maintenance, troubleshooting, and decommissioning of critical IT infrastructure within our datacenters. You will apply your technical expertise across server and network hardware, diagnose complex issues, and ensure work is completed safely and to required quality standards.As a senior member of the team, you will also provide technical guidance, coaching, and on-the-job training to other technicians, while identifying opportunities to improve processes and operational efficiency.Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) team powers the infrastructure behind services including Azure, Microsoft 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and Bing. Our global datacenter organization operates at significant scale, supporting more than one billion customers and millions of businesses worldwide.At Microsoft, we work with a growth mindset, collaborate to achieve shared goals, and are committed to our mission of empowering every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more.Responsibilities    Apply advanced diagnostic and troubleshooting skills to identify and resolve hardware, server, and network-related issues.    Install, deploy, replace, and decommission datacenter hardware in accordance with documented procedures and standards.    Perform and support complex infrastructure changes, including rack-level hardware upgrades and decommissions.    Provide technical guidance to technicians during hardware preparation, staging, installation, startup, shutdown, and replacement activities.    Coordinate planned work and downtime with relevant stakeholders to ensure quality execution and minimise operational impact.    Assist technicians with complex technical tasks and escalate issues when required.    Complete and oversee post-execution quality checks, ensuring grounding, cabling, staging, and labelling meet deployment and safety standards.    Ensure appropriate security processes are followed when decommissioning equipment and handling data-bearing devices.    Monitor operational performance through Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), dashboards, and performance reviews.    Train, coach, and mentor technicians through on-the-job training and practical technical guidance.    Participate in and support daily safety briefings and required safety training.    Promote compliance with safety procedures including PPE, equipment operation, lifting, electrical safety, and ladder or rolling stair use.    Identify opportunities to improve technical processes, procedures, service quality, and operational efficiency.    Demonstrate accountability for the quality, completeness, and reliability of work delivered.    Embody Microsoft’s culture and values in all aspects of your work.Required Qualifications    High school diploma, GED, or equivalent.    Knowledge of computer hardware, servers, networking equipment, and related components.    Experience supporting, maintaining, troubleshooting, or deploying IT equipment or related technology.    Ability to follow technical procedures and operate safely within a datacenter or similarly controlled environment.    Strong troubleshooting, communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.Preferred Qualifications    Associate degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.    Experience supporting IT infrastructure, server hardware, networking equipment, or related technology.    Experience working in a production or mission-critical 24x7x365 datacenter environment.    Experience coaching, mentoring, or providing technical guidance to other technicians.    Relevant technical certifications such as CompTIA A+, Server+, Network+, Basic Structured Cabling (BSC), Data Center Foundation Certification (DCFC), Microsoft certifications, or vendor-specific networking certifications.Background Check RequirementsAbility to meet Microsoft, customer, and/or government security screening requirements is required for this role.This position requires successful completion of the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire or transfer and every two years thereafter.

title: Service Manager Zinkgruvan
description: Company description:Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.Job description:Servicechef till Zinkgruvan Är du en trygg, närvarande och coachande ledare som trivs med att leda en etablerad verksamhet? Vi söker nu en Servicechef till vår serviceverksamhet i Zinkgruvan – en roll för dig som vill förvalta, skapa stabilitet och bygga långsiktiga relationer med både medarbetare och kund. Här blir du en viktig del av den dagliga verksamheten, nära både människor och maskiner, i en miljö där säkerhet, kvalitet och kontinuitet är avgörande. Ditt uppdrag Som Servicechef i Zinkgruvan har du det övergripande ansvaret för den lokala serviceverksamheten. Du leder och planerar arbetet för servicetekniker, administrativ/lagerfunktion samt supervisor och säkerställer att verksamheten fungerar stabilt och effektivt över tid. Rollen är operativ och närvarande, med stor del av arbetet kopplat till den dagliga driften och kundkontakten. Fokus ligger på att förvalta befintliga arbetssätt, säkerställa god leverans och skapa en trygg och välfungerande arbetsmiljö. Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden: •    Planera, leda och fördela arbetet i den lokala personalstyrkan.•    Vara en närvarande chef som stöttar, coachar och skapar struktur i vardagen.•    Säkerställa ett gott säkerhets-, arbetsmiljö- och förebyggande arbete.•    Vara kundens primära kontakt och bygga långsiktiga relationer.•    Ansvara för serviceverkstad, administration och lagerverksamhet.•    Ekonomiskt ansvar för verksamheten, inklusive budget, uppföljning och rapportering.•    Beräkna och lämna offerter vid behov.•    Arbeta för god samverkan med försäljningsorganisationen.•    Bibehålla och utveckla befintliga serviceavtal samt stötta lokal marknadsföring. Ledarskapsförväntningar På Epiroc förväntar vi oss att våra ledare ska vara inspiratörer, acceleratorer och nytänkare. Vi värdesätter ledare som leder genom att vara förebilder och som har modet att utmana status quo. Säkerhet och hållbarhet är våra högsta prioriteringar, och vi förväntar oss att våra ledare tar en aktiv roll i att främja säkerhet, inkludering och mångfald. Utöver detta värnar våra ledare om våra anställdas välbefinnande och kontinuerliga utveckling. Vi söker dig som vågar tro på nya idéer och ser möjligheter där andra ser utmaningar. Är du den vi söker? Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av ledarskap från arbetsledande- eller chefsroller och har en god förståelse för vad som krävs för att driva en välfungerande serviceverksamhet. Du är praktisk, strukturerad och bekväm med att ta ansvar för både människor och resultat. För att lyckas i rollen behöver du ha: •    Tidigare erfarenhet av ledarskap med arbetsledande- och/eller personalansvar.•    Teknisk bakgrund eller starkt tekniskt intresse.•    Grundläggande kunskaper inom ekonomi, uppföljning och rapportering.•    God datorvana och erfarenhet av affärs-/ERP-system (gärna SAP).•    God kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.•    B-körkort. Placering och resor Denna tjänst är placerad i Zinkgruvan. Resor kan förekomma i tjänsten. Ansökan och kontaktinformation Vi uppmuntrar dig att skicka in din ansökan via vår karriärsida så snart som möjligt, men senast den 10 november. Vi är engagerade i en grundlig rekryteringsprocess som inkluderar intervjuer, referenstagning och tester. Vår process är utformad för att vara rättvis och inkluderande; du kan förvänta dig transparent kommunikation och en balanserad utvärdering av dina färdigheter och erfarenheter.

title: Mechanical Engineer, Lund
description: Mechanical Engineer with passion for product development!At Axis, our passion is to create a smarter and safer world! We have delivered several groundbreaking products and look forward to paving the way for many more. Come join our team and help us in finding smart solutions for fantastic products!We are now seeking a mechanical engineer to join our mechanics team within System Products at Axis HQ in Lund.System Products is responsible for developing a wide and exciting product portfolio, which includes body-worn cameras, video recorders, microphone products, video decoders, sirens, and other system accessories. Your future teamWe who work in your future team are passionate engineers who love technology and tough technical challenges. We highly value creativity, collaboration, and openness. You will be overwhelmed by your colleagues' helpfulness and their willingness to help you develop.We are multiple functions working together to develop, improve, and deliver world-class products! What you'll do here as a mechanical engineerAs a mechanical engineer on System products, you will work on product development in areas such as body-worn cameras, recorders, microphone products, and other system devices. Much of your daily work is in projects where the project team consists of different functions and competencies. The length of a project typically ranges from 6 months to 2 years. In the project, you work closely with electronics, firmware, and many other internal functions such as quality, testing, production, and purchasing. In the projects, you drive the mechanical development together with a few colleagues from concept study to mass production. These tasks include designing the product, creating prototypes, communicating with suppliers, verifying the product, and preparing the product for mass production. To optimize the production of the design, you also have close contact with our suppliers around the world. The portfolio includes both large and small projects, and several of the product types we develop are new to us, so unknown challenges and opportunities for variation are promised. In your work, you will also meet and work together with product managers, project leaders, line managers, and engineers from other departments and competencies. Who are you?We are looking for a team-oriented colleague with a positive mindset. You love challenges and working together with others. You are passionate about product development from the first idea to holding the product in your hand. You like to challenge old truths and develop new innovative products. You are considerate and value good communication. Finally, and most importantly, you love being part of a creative and happy team that delivers outstanding products!In our department, we work with both mechanical designs, electromechanics, and several different types of manufacturing methods. We would like you to have experience or a strong interest in some of these areas (new graduates are welcome to apply):     Knowledge of at least one 3D CAD system, preferably Creo.    Prototype creation    Mechanical engineering background    Windchill/Creo knowledge    Injection molding/diecast/sheet metal    Design for production    Product development in telecommunications (4G, 5G), Wi-Fi, or GPS    Fluent in Swedish and English, both spoken and written. What can Axis offer you?A fantastic team with colleagues who want to succeed together with you. We learn and develop through our work with product development, and we are not afraid to try new things. Internal courses and external education are part of your work life here. From your first day, you will have a mentor colleague who helps you and teaches you how we work at Axis. Axis also has an excellent introduction program for new employees. We strive to give each individual great personal responsibility and opportunity to grow both as a person and professionally. You become part of a well-functioning team with engaged people who like going to work in the morning. We want you to thrive with us. title: Senior Platform Engineer
description: Why Doktor.seDoktor.se is Sweden's largest digital healthcare provider. Our 25-person engineering team has startup autonomy inside a profitable, international organization with 1,000+ employees and over 1B SEK in revenue.We run OpenAI and Anthropic models in production across patient and clinician workflows, and that footprint is growing fast.What you'll doOur infrastructure works, but it was built to solve yesterday's problems. We need someone who can help us get to where we want to be — not maintain what we have, but reshape it. If you want a place where everything is already figured out, this isn't it. If you want to build something better, here's what you'd own:    Build a deployment platform where teams ship their own services without asking you for permission.    Design infrastructure that is secure by default, so teams don't have to think about encryption, network isolation, or data residency. It just works.    Create deployment pipelines where security scanning, policy checks, and compliance happen automatically, invisible when everything is fine, loud when something needs attention.    Support and scale infrastructure for AI workloads, we run models in production across our platform, and that footprint is growing.    Set up observability that gives teams real insight into their own services, useful dashboards, alerts that mean something, not noise that everyone ignores.    Work closely with developers to understand what slows them down, and then fix it. Not by doing it for them, but by making it easy for them to do it themselves.    Maintain and evolve our cloud account structure, networking, and identity management across multiple regions and products.    You will report to to, and work close with, our Head of Product and Technology. You will be the go to person in technical strategical questions and the technical sounding board — advising on complex technical decisions and translating product/business direction into what's actually feasible.Some weeks you'll write infrastructure code. Some weeks you'll pair with a developer to debug a slow service. Some weeks you'll design how a new product gets its own isolated infrastructure. The common thread: you make the teams around you better.Make developers faster, not more dependent on you.What we're looking for    You've built and operated Kubernetes in production. Accounts, networking, IAM, KMS. You can read their code, understand their pipelines, and have meaningful conversations about architecture.    You think about security as something you design into systems, not something you review at the end.    You have opinions, and you can change them when someone makes a better argument.    University degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent experience.Tech stackCloud - AWS (multi-account, multi-region)Orchestration - Kubernetes / EKSIaC - TerraformCI/CD - GitHub ActionsLanguages - Python, TypeScriptAI - OpenAI, Anthropic (in production and tooling)Observability - Datadog / Grafana (you'll shape this)What we offer    Real influence. You'll shape how our platform works, not just operate what someone else designed.    Healthcare context. Patient data, regulatory compliance, and real consequences for getting it wrong. What you build actually matters.    Small team, direct impact. 25 engineers, your work is visible, not lost in a machine.    Autonomy. No micromanagement, no endless approval chains.    AI in production. We're running LLMs in patient and clinician workflows today, the infrastructure needs to grow with that.    Collective agreement, 30 days vacation, wellness allowance, personal development budget.Practical details    Start: As soon as we find the right person. Fridays are flexible.    Language: English is our working language in tech. Swedish is a bonus.    Work permit: You must already have the right to work in Sweden.    Contact: Karin Bergström, Head of Product and technologyWe handle recruitment internally — no agencies, no consultants, no external recruiters.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description: Why Doktor.seDoktor.se is Sweden's largest digital healthcare provider. We combine physical clinics with a digital platform serving millions of consultations per year across Sweden, Germany, and Norway. Our 25-person engineering team has startup autonomy inside a profitable, international organization with 1,000+ employees and over 1B SEK in revenue.We run OpenAI and Anthropic models in production across patient and clinician workflows — and that footprint is growing fast. AI is a working tool here, not a buzzword. We use it daily, we expect you to as well, and we hire people who treat it as a force multiplier.What you'll doOur data platform works, but it was built to solve yesterday's problems. We have data scattered across Postgres databases, Amplitude, S3 file dumps, and a tangle of Python jobs that move it around. The reports get built and the business runs on them. But trust is brittle, reconciliation is too manual, and the foundations need work before we can scale to where we're going.We need someone who can help us rebuild this — not maintain what we have, but reshape it. If you want a place where the warehouse is clean and the pipelines just run, this isn't it. If you want to redesign a data platform from foundations up, with real ownership and the leverage to make it good, here's what you'd own:• Reshape the data foundations — multi-tenancy, retention, and data contracts with backend services.• Decide what the warehouse actually is: self-hosted Postgres + dbt, managed Snowflake or BigQuery, or something else. You'll shape this.• Unify three data sources that don't currently talk to each other: our operational databases, Amplitude product analytics, and a long tail of S3-based partner integrations.• Build observability into the platform — lineage, freshness, and alerting that actually means something.• Own reporting that finance, operations, and the board rely on. Make those reports trustworthy by design, not by manual reconciliation.• Work directly with backend, product, and finance teams. You're not a service desk — you're a peer who shapes how data gets produced upstream, not just consumed downstream.• Use AI aggressively for pipeline boilerplate, schema generation, transformation logic, and exploratory analysis — the same discipline we hold ourselves to.You'll be part of a small data engineering team. That's a lot of ownership and not a lot of cover. The right person sees that as opportunity.What we're looking for• You've designed and run data platforms in production — not just written DAGs. You've thought about what to build vs buy, where transformations belong, and how to keep schemas honest as products evolve.• You're fluent in Python and SQL, with strong opinions about how Postgres should be used as a warehouse (and when it shouldn't).• You've used dbt or equivalent in a real environment and understand data modelling — staging, marts, tests.• You have working knowledge of one or more managed warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) and can evaluate them honestly against self-hosted options.• You're comfortable with orchestration tools — Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, whichever — and know what an orchestrator is for.• You think about data contracts as a product problem, not just a pipeline problem, and can make that case to backend engineers.• You use AI in your daily work and can talk about how. If your answer is "I haven't really tried it yet," this isn't the role.• Healthcare data experience is a plus. GDPR fluency is expected. Patientdatalagen familiarity is a bonus.• You have a relevant university degree or equivalent experience.Tech stack• Sources: Postgres (operational), Amplitude (events), S3 (integrations and dumps)• Languages: Python, SQL• Cloud: AWS, multi-account• Warehouse: Postgres today, open question for tomorrow• Transformation: likely dbt going forward• Orchestration: open question — you'll shape this• AI: Claude and OpenAI in our daily workflowWhat we offer• Real influence. The data platform is being rebuilt and you're at the centre of it.• Small team, direct impact. 25 engineers — your work is visible, not lost in a machine.• Autonomy. No micromanagement, no endless approval chains.• Collective agreement, 30 days vacation, wellness allowance, personal development budget.Practical details• Start: As soon as we find the right person. We'll accommodate your notice period.• Employment: Permanent, full-time. Six month probation period.• Location: On-site, Monday–Thursday at Sveavägen 63, Stockholm. Fridays are flexible.• Language: You'll be working with our entire org so Swedish is a strong plus, but English is our working language within tech.• Work permit: You must already have the right to work in Sweden.We handle recruitment internally — no agencies, no consultants, no external recruiters.

title: Product Sourcing Leader

We secure IWAY requirements, improve materials, strengthen sourcing and keep costs low while helping the IKEA value chain stand strong when the world changes. Within Purchasing Development, Category Area Food is part of the Food total value chain transformation. We are creating simpler and more connected ways of working, with clearer ownership and faster decisions closer to where value is created for our customers. For sourcing, this means using supplier competence earlier, reducing handovers and creating stronger conditions for speed, availability, affordability and growth. You will work closely with Range Areas, Category business teams, Regional Sourcing Specialists, Supply Chain and suppliers to align priorities, plan sourcing activities and follow up segment, sourcing and supplier-base performance. In this role, you will:     Lead sourcing and supplier capability input to product development and portfolio planning.     Use supplier competence early to secure realistic product development, cost and availability preconditions.     Provide sourcing expertise to development teams, decide on development suppliers and secure early supplier alignment and production feasibility.     Evaluate sourcing alternatives, including strategic partnerships and simpler sourcing solutions where relevant.     Secure implementation and on-time sales start together with business teams.     Coordinate product development agreements and sourcing readiness for launches, changes and market expansion.     Lead creation and implementation of segment sourcing strategies in line with Category Business Plans and Purchasing Development Plans.     Identify supplier capability gaps, consolidation opportunities and sourcing setups that support speed, affordability and availability.     Lead or coordinate RFQs, RFPs and RFIs together with Regional Sourcing Specialists when needed.     Drive fact-based decisions through data, risk assessment, scenario planning and clear prioritisation.QualificationsWe are looking for someone who:     Has experience in product development, sourcing, purchasing development, supplier development or food sourcing.     Understands the Food business context and how sourcing choices affect quality, food safety, speed, availability, affordability and growth.     Has strong knowledge of sourcing strategy, supplier capability and sourcing implementation.     Understands product development, portfolio planning and how sourcing input affects feasibility, cost and readiness.     Has good understanding of supplier capability, materials, production techniques and sourcing alternatives.     Uses supplier, cost, risk and performance data to create insight, assess scenarios and support clear decisions.     Can influence and coordinate stakeholders across category, range and development, supply chain and supplier interfaces.     Communicates clearly in English and can connect different perspectives into practical sourcing outcomes. At IKEA, strong sourcing helps good ideas become affordable, sustainable and relevant food products for the many people. You enjoy creating clarity when many needs meet, and you are comfortable making choices based on facts, risks and business priorities. You build trust through simple communication, good listening and close collaboration. You bring energy to development work and help others move forward with confidence. title: Master's thesis in Reconstructing methanotrophic bacteria communities during the Holocene of an alpine lake
description:
Master's thesis in Reconstructing methanotrophic bacteria communities during the Holocene of an alpine lake (m/f/d)  


  











Master's thesis in Reconstructing methanotrophic bacteria communities during the Holocene of an alpine lake (m/f/d)
===================================================================================================================




  










 



Eawag, the Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology, is an internationally networked aquatic research institute within the ETH Domain (Swiss Federal Institutes of Technology). Eawag conducts research, education and expert consulting to achieve the dual goals of meeting direct human needs for water and maintaining the function and integrity of aquatic ecosystems.





The Department of Surface Waters \- Research and Management ([SURF](/)), in Dübendorf (ZH), has a vacancy for a



Master's thesis in Reconstructing methanotrophic bacteria communities during the Holocene of an alpine lake (m/f/d)
===================================================================================================================





 **Background:** Methane\-oxidizing bacteria (MOB) plays a key role in regulating methane emissions from lakes, yet their past community dynamics under changing environmental and climate conditions remain poorly constrained. Our group studies MOB communities in alpine and peri\-alpine lakes using a combination of lipid biomarker analysis and molecular biology tools. We are now looking for a motivated master's student to apply this approach to a 12\-meter\-long sediment core retrieved from the alpine Lac de Taney (VS).



 **Project description:** This MSc project will reconstruct MOB community composition and dynamics in the Lac de Taney sediment record using specific bacterial lipid biomarkers known as bacteriohopanepolyols (BHP), alongside complementary proxies (e.g., TOC, XRF elemental abundances) and relate these findings to the broader evolution of the lake's biogeochemistry during the Holocene. The Sedimentology Group is part of the Department of Surface Waters and is headed by Prof. , Head of the Department of Surface Waters. The project offers the possibility to shape the specific research questions together, depending on the student's interests.



 **What you will do** 





* Process and subsample the Lac de Taney sediment core (\~50 samples)
* Extract and analyze lipid biomarkers via UHPLC\-Orbitrap\-HRMS
* Perform DNA extraction and prepare samples for 16S rRNA amplicon sequencing
* Interpret multi\-proxy data to reconstruct past microbial community dynamics
* Optionally join a fieldwork campaign at Lake Rotsee to see the full workflow of core retrieval firsthand in October 2026



 **You will gain** hands\-on laboratory experience across a full analytical pipeline spanning organic geochemistry and molecular biology. You will have access to state\-of\-the\-art instrumentation at Eawag Dübendorf, including UHPLC\-Orbitrap\-HRMS, and receive close supervision within an active research group.



 **We are looking for** a student enrolled in an MSc programme at ETH in geoscience, environmental science, biology, or a related field. You have an interest in biogeochemistry, (paleo)limnology, and/or microbial ecology and are willing to work with a range of analytical techniques. No prior experience with mass spectrometry or molecular biology is required.



 **At Eawag,** we have a working environment in which people with different experiences, strengths, and perspectives can fully contribute and further develop. Here, you can help us advance! We promote genuine participation, exchange, and mutual understanding. We create structures that enable the compatibility of work and other areas of life, such as care work, and continuously make efforts to reduce barriers.



Do you have specific requirements regarding the application process or the position, or do you need additional information? Talk to us about it\-we will be happy to support you with possible flexible workplace, working hours, and job design solutions. For further information please visit our website about [Eawag](/) as well as our [conditions](/) of employment.



 **The project is scheduled to start** in the fall semester 2026 with the proposal phase (if required, e.g. D\-EAPS at ETH), followed by the project in the semester 2027\. The exact start date can be discussed. The project has a duration of 6 months. The supervisors are Lorenzo Cellino, PhD student, and Nora Richter, SNSF Ambizione Fellow.



 **Deadline for applications is 30 October 2026 or until the position is filled** and will therefore be evaluated on a rolling basis. Applications should include a very short cover letter (. one page) describing your interests and their relevance to this position, as well as a CV.



For more details on the position, please contact [Write an email](<>) or [Write an email](<>) by email.



 **We look forward to receiving your application.** Please send it through this webpage, as any other way of applying will not be considered. A click on the link below will take you directly to the application form.

title: Principal Process Engineering Specialist (H/F/N)
employer: Syngenta Crop Protection AG Production Chimique
description: Company DescriptionAt Syngenta Group, we're a global community of 56,000 innovators across 90 countries, united by a 250-year legacy of agricultural excellence. As the world's most local agricultural technology partner, we create tailor-made solutions that transform farming while protecting our planet, driven by our commitment to innovation, ethics, and integrity. Through our inclusive environment and diverse perspectives, we pioneer breakthrough solutions for farmers, society, and future generations. Join our worldwide teams of agricultural pioneers in creating a more resilient and equitable food system for all. Job DescriptionAs a Principal Process Engineer Specialist, you will provide technical leadership for chemical processes supporting the development, scale-up, introduction and ongoing improvement of intermediates and active ingredients at industrial scale.You will hold and develop process know-how for assigned chemical steps, ensuring that processes are safe, compliant, robust, sustainable and fit for Supply Chain needs. You will work closely with production, project teams, chemists and global technical networks to solve complex technical challenges, improve performance and support strategic initiatives.Accountabilities:Lead the technical development, scale-up and implementation of new or improved chemical processes for intermediates and active ingredients.Define and agree development programmes with relevant stakeholders; plan, oversee and, when needed, carry out laboratory, pilot and full-scale plant trials.Provide technical leadership for complex process-engineering projects, including process simulation, design, sizing and equipment specificationAct as a key technical contact for project teams, providing expertise in process engineering and chemical process development.Support the commissioning and technical start-up of new or modified plants, ensuring design intent is met and production is established safely and effectively.Provide expert technical support to manufacturing teams, including troubleshooting, root-cause analysis and continuous process improvement.Define key process parameters and control strategies to ensure safe, reliable and compliant operations.Identify and lead initiatives to improve capacity, product quality, manufacturing costs, waste generation and energy consumption.Support process transfer and relocation projects to external partners or other Syngenta sites, in collaboration with Technology & Sourcing and Supply Chain teams.Provide technical input to Process Risk Assessments and ensure process design meets internal and external HSEQ and regulatory requirements.Coach and develop less experienced process engineers, sharing technical knowledge and local ways of working.Build and maintain strong connections with internal technical networks and contribute to the identification and implementation of innovative technologies.QualificationsMaster’s degree or PhD in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry or a related discipline.At least 8–10 years of relevant industrial experience, ideally within the chemical industry; experience in active ingredient or intermediate manufacturing would be a strong advantage.Demonstrated expertise in chemical process development, process design, scale-up and industrial manufacturing support.Practical experience in process simulation and modelling.Experience with Aspen Plus is preferred. Experience with other process simulation and modelling tools, such as Aspen HYSYS, gPROMS, Pro/II or CHEMCAD will also be considered.Practical experience with laboratory work, pilot trials and/or full-scale plant trials.Strong knowledge of process safety, reaction hazards, HSEQ requirements, Management of Change and regulatory constraints in an industrial chemical environment.Experience in commissioning new or modified processes and supporting technical start-up activities, including participation in Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and collaboration with automation and process-control teamsAbility to work autonomously on technically complex projects with significant business impact, while collaborating effectively across multidisciplinary teams.Strong problem-solving, communication and stakeholder-management skills.Experience in coaching or mentoring junior colleagues is an advantage.This is a senior individual contributor role focused on technical leadership and expertise. It does not include direct people-management responsibility.Professional fluency in English is required. Knowledge of French is an asset, and support will be provided to candidates who wish to further develop their French language skillsAdditional informationWhat We OfferA competitive salaryA profit-sharing bonus (option to invest in a company savings plan with employer matching)Works Council benefitsHealth insurance with 60% employer coverageA supplementary retirement plan (option to contribute unused RTT and vacation days)Career opportunities as well as possibilities for individual development and continuous trainingSpecial attention to your work-life balance with flexible working conditions and flexible hoursA work environment that promotes agility, diversity and teamworkResponsible and varied work in a forward-thinking companyOn-site company restaurantSyngenta is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion or any other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

Cost Control Chief
==================




  








 **Department:** **Project Controls**

 **Start Date:**

ENKA Investment AG is seeking a Cost Controls Chief for its planned data center project in Beringen, will lead implementation and maintenance of the project cost controlling system, working closely with the Swiss project organization and ENKA’s headquarters in Istanbul.



  ***Required Knowledge and Qualifications***



* Degree in Engineering, Quantity Surverying, Construction Management, or Economics
* 5\+ years cost control / project controls experience on major capital projects; experience on mission\-critical or data\-center facilities strongly preferred

* Proven ability to control committed and realized costs across a large supplier and subcontractor base
* Solid grasp of change and claims management and of internal/external benchmarking for cost estimating

* Strong communication, reporting and stakeholder\-coordination skills


  ***Main Duties and Responsibilities***



* Develop, implement and maintain the project cost controlling system
* Control and report project cost and budget across design, procurement, construction, and commissioning
* Prepare cost estimates and programme cost plans supported by consistent internal and external benchmarking data
* Control committed and realised invoices from manufacturers, suppliers, and subcontractors
* Monitor and control project cash and bank movements
* Work with project teams to forecast out\-turn cost, identify cost\-reduction opportunities and drive value\-engineered solutions
* Evaluate Change Notices and Claims together with project teams
* Ensure the coding structure for material requests complies with project requirements
* Maintain back\-up documentation for daily/weekly/monthly cost reports
* Ensure all works comply with QA procedures
* Ensure all works comply with HSE procedures

80-100%

Full-time, Part-time possible

Permanent

Research \& Development

Professionals

Stäfa, Switzerland

Develop equipment and special-purpose machinery for our sensor production and shape the production standards of tomorrow.

**This is Sensirion**

Sensirion is one of the world's leading developers and manufacturers of environmental and flow sensors that improve efficiency, health, safety and comfort in automotive, industrial, medical and consumer electronics applications.

[sensirion.com](https://www.sensirion.com/)

**Our culture**

Sensirion embodies the same start-up spirit it has had from the very beginning, while still offering you stability and security as a market leader with around 1,000 employees.

* You develop equipment and special-purpose machinery for assembly, testing and calibration
* You drive industrialization projects from initial concept to production launch
* You shape the next generation of our machinery and calibration platforms
* You advance technical standards and foster knowledge sharing across the team



**What awaits you**



* Exciting equipment projects and technical challenges for R\&D and production
* An agile, global environment with freedom to shape solutions and take ownership
* A strong, supportive team with broad technical expertise
* Close collaboration with R\&D, product and process development, and production



**What you bring along**



* At least B2 German knowledge and an Engineering degree (FH/ETH) with several years of experience
* Enthusiasm for automation technology and new technical challenges
* Initiative, teamwork, hands-on mindset and drive to create
* Experience in equipment development and special-purpose machinery



**Your benefits**



* You can receive your bonus in cash or enjoy a slice of Sensirion's success with shares.

* You can make free calls to Switzerland and abroad while enjoying unlimited data with the discounted mobile phone contract.

* Together, we make the world better. Contribute your ideas, make a difference and take responsibility.

  ***Required Knowledge and Qualifications***

* Fluency in Turkish and English or German

title: Manager / Senior Manager SAP S/4HANA Technical Transformation, Integration and Clean Core
description: We are looking for a senior SAP technical transformation leader with deep hands on S/4HANA solution design, integration, data replication and Clean Core experience. In this role, you will shape and deliver complex SAP transformation programs across multinational ERP landscapes, bridging business, functional and technical teams while guiding global delivery teams from assessment and planning through implementation and stabilization. You will act as a trusted advisor to senior clients, helping them define robust SAP S/4HANA landscapes, make sound architecture and integration decisions, improve development quality, and deliver measurable transformation outcomes with practical use of SAP BTP, cloud, automation, analytics and AI enabled SAP capabilities. Your Impact - Lead S/4HANA technical transformation and upgrade programs: Own technical assessments, readiness checks, impact analysis, retrofit strategy, risk strategy, test planning, cutover support and delivery governance for SAP S/4HANA implementations and upgrades. - Shape complex integration and data replication solutions: Design integration concepts between SAP and non SAP systems, including Central Finance, MDG, BW or BW/4HANA, external finance, tax, planning, reporting and CRM applications, using technologies such as SLT, SAP CPI, SAP PO, MuleSoft, IDoc, RFC, AIF and related middleware. - Drive Clean Core and extensibility decisions: Define pragmatic Clean Core approaches for custom code, RICEFW, Fiori, CDS views, AMDP, ABAP developments, SAP BTP extensions, integration patterns and code remediation. - Lead finance transformation technology streams: Support S/4HANA Finance and Central Finance programs across Record to Report, Procure to Pay, Project to Delivery, tax, group reporting, central payments, reconciliation and financial close topics. - Manage global teams and delivery quality: Lead multidisciplinary teams of consultants, developers, architects, client IT and technology partners, including offshore and nearshore delivery models. Establish code guidelines, review processes, quality gates and performance tuning practices. - Bridge stakeholders across business and IT: Align enterprise architects, process owners, functional leads, system owners and program leadership across multiple ERP landscapes and geographies. Create clear decision materials and drive structured issue and escalation management. - Bring innovation into practical SAP delivery: Assess and prototype useful applications of SAP BTP, SAP Business AI, Joule, automation, analytics and data services in real transformation contexts. - Contribute to commercial growth: Lead or support solution shaping, effort estimation, proposal preparation, sales materials, client presentations and commercial discussions for complex SAP opportunities. - Strengthen thought leadership and talent: Develop reusable assets, points of view, technical accelerators, training material and mentoring approaches for SAP technical transformation topics. Your Skill Set - This opportunity is aimed at hands on senior SAP transformation professionals who combine deep technical architecture expertise, consulting leadership and delivery ownership. The profile is suitable for Manager and Senior Manager level candidates who have already led large SAP S/4HANA technical and integration streams in complex client environments. Expected Qualifications - Education: Bachelor or Master degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Informatics, Business Administration with technology focus, or a related field. - SAP technical transformation experience: 10 or more years of experience in SAP technical solution design, S/4HANA implementation, S/4HANA upgrade, ERP modernization, enterprise application advisory or SAP enabled business transformation. - S/4HANA track record: Experience across multiple SAP S/4HANA implementations, upgrades or conversion programs, ideally covering several S/4HANA releases and recent releases such as 2021, 2023 or 2025. - Technical solution design depth: Strong SAP ABAP, RICEFW, CDS, AMDP, Fiori, HANA, performance tuning and debugging expertise, with the ability to review solution quality, guide development teams and define technical standards. - Integration and replication expertise: Proven experience with SAP and non SAP integration, data replication and technical connectivity using SLT, SAP CPI, SAP PO, MuleSoft, IDoc, RFC, AIF, BODS, Information Steward or comparable tools. - Central Finance and finance process exposure: Strong experience in S/4HANA Finance or Central Finance, including FI and CO replication, reconciliation, central payments, tax reporting, group reporting, FSCM or related finance transformation topics. - Clean Core, BTP and cloud mindset: Practical knowledge of Clean Core principles, SAP BTP capabilities, extensibility, cloud adoption and AI enabled SAP innovation. - Large program leadership: Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary teams, ideally including 20 or more consultants, across geographies, workstreams and delivery partners. - Stakeholder and consulting maturity: Experience managing senior client stakeholders, system owners, architects, functional leads and delivery partners, with clear communication, storytelling, estimation and presentation skills. - Commercial and proposal experience: Ability to support RfPs, solutioning, effort estimates, commercials, client presentations and account growth. - Language skills: Excellent written and spoken English. Desirable Qualifications - SAP certifications such as ABAP, SAP Enterprise Architecture, SAP BTP, SAP Integration Suite, S/4HANA Finance or comparable credentials. - Experience with S/4HANA Public Cloud, SAP Business AI, Joule, SAP Activate and agile delivery approaches. - Experience in multinational SAP landscapes with multiple ERP source systems, ideally more than 10 source ERPs and several countries. - Experience integrating SAP with applications such as Ariba, Salesforce, ONESOURCE, Longview, Bloomberg, CRM, tax reporting or financial consolidation platforms. - Experience in manufacturing, pharma, construction, real estate, finance or complex industrial environments. - German or French skills are a strong plus. - MBA, advanced technology degree or equivalent advisory leadership experience is beneficial. What We Offer - A platform to lead technical transformation in large SAP S/4HANA programs with leading organizations. - The opportunity to shape integration, Clean Core, Central Finance, SAP BTP and AI enabled SAP outcomes. - A collaborative environment with access to SAP, cloud, data, AI and business transformation expertise across PwC. - A role with clear client impact, team leadership responsibility, mentoring opportunities, asset development and contribution to market growth.

title: Health Safety Environment Manager / Deputy Health and Safety Manager
description:
Health Safety Environment Manager / Deputy Health and Safety Manager  


  











Health Safety Environment Manager / Deputy Health and Safety Manager
====================================================================




  








 **Department:** **HSE Management**



 **Reports to:** **Project Manager / Deputy Project Manager**



 **Responsible for:** **providing professional and technical HSE expertise, direction and guidance to the project**



 **Location:** **Construction site office in Beringen**



 **Start Date:**  



 **Employment: Type** **Full time / On\-Site**



ENKA Investment AG is seeking an HSE Manager for its planned data center project in Beringen, Schaffhausen. You will lead site health, safety, and environmental management across construction and commissioning, working closely with local project leadership, subcontractors and ENKA’s headquarters HSE team in Istanbul.



  ***Required Knowledge and Qualifications***



* A degree or recognized professional diploma in occupational health and safety, engineering or a related field.
* At least 10 years of construction HSE experience, including at least 3 years in a leadership role managing HSE personnel and coordinating multiple subcontractors on a major project.
* Experience in energization or commissioning while construction activities were still in progress. A clear understanding of the transition from construction to live systems is essential.
* A working understanding of Civil, Structural and Architectural (CSA) and Mechanical, Electrical and Plumbing (MEP) construction risks, risk assessment, work permits and hazardous energy controls.
* Proven ability to lead investigations, challenge unsafe practices constructively and secure corrective action from project teams and subcontractors under programme pressure
* Professional working proficiency in English and Turkish, spoken and written. (German is a plus for local site coordination), English the international project team, and Turkish daily meetings and reporting with Istanbul headquarters.
* Strong reporting and document management skills, with experience using digital HSE systems and practical performance measures. A site\-based approach and the ability to coach a multicultural workforce are essential.


  ***Main Duties and Responsibilities***



* Lead the project Health, Safety and Environment programme from site mobilization and civil works through mechanical, electrical and plumbing (MEP) installation, energization, commissioning and handover, working with project leadership and ENKA’s headquarters HSE team.
* Develop and maintain the site HSE plan, responsibilities, risk registers and assurance arrangements in line with Swiss requirements, project procedures and applicable client obligations.
* Work with the Design Manager and construction leads to review design and sequencing risks, temporary works interfaces and safe access for installation and maintenance.
* Coordinate subcontractor HSE plans, competence checks, inductions and method statements. Verify that each party controls its own activities and that interfaces between trades are addressed before work starts.
* Monitor high risk construction activities, including excavations, temporary works, lifting operations, work at height, floor openings, steel and façade erection, hot works and confined space entry where applicable.
* Work with electrical and commissioning leads on permit to work, hazardous energy control, lockout/tagout, access restrictions and the separation of live systems from ongoing construction.
* Check that safety arrangements cover heavy plant installation, generators, UPS and battery systems, cooling equipment, pressure testing and associated fuel or hazardous substances, as applicable to the design.
* Maintain a strong site presence through inspections, audits and workforce engagement. Stop unsafe work, escalate significant risks and verify effective corrective action before authorized work resumption.
* Lead incident and near miss investigations, identify underlying causes and track corrective actions to closure. Maintain reliable records and report trends that support prevention and open reporting.
* Coordinate occupational health controls, welfare arrangements and environmental measures, including dust, noise, heat, waste, site water, spill prevention and relevant permit conditions.
* Develop emergency arrangements with site teams and relevant local services; organise drills and confirm that plans remain suitable as construction and commissioning conditions change.
* Coach HSE personnel and subcontractor supervisors, deliver practical briefings and ensure that safety instructions are understood across a multilingual workforce.
* Attend daily coordination meetings with ENKA’s Istanbul headquarters HSE team in Turkish and provide daily risk and action updates, together with regular project performance reports.

title: Data Center Design Manager
description:
Data Center Design Manager  


  











Data Center Design Manager
==========================




  








 **Department:** **Design Group**



 **Reports to:** **Project Manager/Construction Manager**



 **Responsible for:** **Design Coordination and Development throughout the Project including Coordination of shop drawings**



 **Location:** **Construction site office in Beringen**



 **Start Date:**  



 **Employment Type:** **Full time / On Site**



ENKA Investment AG is seeking a Data Center Design Manager for its planned data center project in Beringen, Schaffhausen. You will lead coordinated design delivery across the building and its critical systems, working closely with the Swiss project organization and ENKA’s headquarters design and procurement team in Istanbul.



 **Data Center Design Manager**



The role combines technical leadership, design delivery management and close support to procurement, construction and commissioning.



  ***Required Knowledge and Qualifications***



* A degree in electrical, mechanical, civil, or building services engineering, architecture or a related discipline, or equivalent demonstrable professional competence
* At least 10 years of relevant design or construction experience, with proven responsibility for leading multidisciplinary design delivery, including detailed design, construction, commissioning and handover
* Strong knowledge of CSA and critical MEP interfaces, power and cooling resilience, and practical construction requirements.
* Demonstrated ability to lead consultants and specialist designers, manage design deliverables and approvals, and resolve complex interfaces in an international EPC, main contractor or comparable project environment.
* Practical BIM coordination, model review and document control experience, using Navisworks or Solibri, Revit/IFC models and common data environment such as ACC, Aconex or equivalent.
* Commercial and programme awareness, including design scope, procurement interfaces and change control. Sound judgment, clear reporting and the ability to close decisions under construction deadlines.
* Professional fluency spoken and written Turkish, English are essential. Turkish is required for daily technical meetings and reporting with ENKA’s Istanbul headquarters; (German is a plus for local coordination); English for the international project team and technical documentation.


  ***Main Duties and Responsibilities***



* Lead civil structural, architectural and MEP design delivery from the current design stage through procurement, construction, commissioning and handover, coordinating ENKA’s consultants and specialist designers.
* Work daily with ENKA’s headquarters design team in Istanbul. Lead technical meetings in Turkish and provide daily reports on progress, outstanding decisions, design risks and actions.
* Maintain the design management plan, responsibility matrix, deliverables register and programme. Align releases with procurement lead times, construction sequencing and the integrated project schedule.
* Coordinate excavation, temporary works interfaces, foundations and piling where required, concrete, steel, architecture, façades and roofing with equipment loads, installation sequences and building services.
* Integrate critical power and cooling systems, including utility interfaces, transformers, generators, UPS, distribution, cooling plant, pumps and CRAH/CRAC units, together with controls, fire protection, security and ICT pathways.
* Close interfaces for openings, sleeves, shafts, plinths, embedded items, support and fire stopping before construction release. Coordinate structural approvals, maintenance access and equipment replacement routes.
* Lead multidisciplinary reviews and BIM coordination. Resolve technical and spatial issues, record decisions and maintain controlled models, drawings and specifications in the common data environment.
* Manage consultant scopes, technical submittals, RFIs and review comments. Coordinate approved construction information and track overdue inputs, revisions and approvals.
* Integrate vendor and subcontractor design, including employer supplied equipment where applicable. Coordinate technical procurement inputs, long lead equipment interfaces and vendor changes.
* Coordinate compliance reviews and permit submissions with Swiss consultants, authorities and utilities, addressing applicable SIA standards, fire safety requirements and project obligations.
* Assess changes and value engineering with Commercial and Project Controls teams, identifying effects on cost, programme, resilience, safety and operating performance before approval.
* Support side teams with buildability and design issue resolution. Manage design risks, safe access, construction interfaces and incorporation of approved site changes.
* Coordinate with commissioning and operations teams on testability and maintainability. Close design issues arising from factory and site acceptance tests and integrated systems testing.
* Track completion of as\-built records and operation and maintenance documentation. Report design progress, unresolved risks and required decisions through handover.

description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Chief of Staff (a) (80-100%)--- Chief of Staff (a) (80\-100%)=============================**Technology \& Leadership – dafür steht Consult \& Pepper.
